dsh-session-rescue

When a turn ends badly, the session picks itself back up: auto-resume after transient failures, auto-continue after truncation, catch-up for open todo lists — plus manual recovery actions above the input box and at the turn tail.

**A [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin: three automatic user-role injections when a turn ends badly (transient failure / max-tokens truncation / an open todo list), a request-level last-resort rate-limit retry, and a client dock with manual recovery actions and a settings card. Zero model tools, zero HTTP routes of its own.** ## Contents - [What it does](#what-it-does) - [How a decision is made](#how-a-decision-is-made) - [Install](#install) - [Shared version floor](#shared-version-floor) - [Verify it is live](#verify-it-is-live) - [What it does not provide](#what-it-does-not-provide) - [Enabling it in dsh](#enabling-it-in-dsh) - [The three automatic actions](#the-three-automatic-actions) - [Settings](#settings) - [Public interface](#public-interface) - [Data and privacy](#data-and-privacy) - [Known boundaries](#known-boundaries) - [FAQ](#faq) - [Development](#development) - [License](#license) ## What it does - **Three automatic injections when a turn ends badly**, each with its own delay / cooldown / quota gates (`lib/resume-scheduler.ts`, cooldowns tracked per kind): - **resume** — `agent/error` whose failure `classifyFailure` (`lib/failure-classify.ts`) judges transient; the message lands after `resumeDelayMs`. - **continue** — the turn ended with `reason.kind === "max-tokens"`; "continue from the truncation" lands after `continueDelayMs`. - **unfinished** — the turn ended `completed`, but the todo list **that turn itself wrote** still holds open items (`lib/turn-review.ts`, a purely structural signal, no text guessing); the catch-up message lands after `unfinishedDelayMs`. - Every injection is a `role: "user"` message with `source: { kind: "plugin:session-rescue" }` sent through `agent.followup()` — the model keeps running, so tokens and quota keep being spent. - **A request-level last-resort rate-limit retry**: it listens on `agent/request-error` (waterfall) and **asks downstream first, taking over only when nobody answers** (the same shape as the official `llm-retry`'s `always` mode). A retry decision coming back from downstream — failures the official policy is willing to retry — is adopted verbatim; only when downstream passes (failure code outside the policy's code table — the default table excludes `QUOTA` — retries exhausted, `Retry-After` above the policy ceiling) does this plugin return `{ kind: "retry" }`, so the host re-sends that request inside the same turn. On a profile without `dsh-llm-retry` mounted, this ladder is the only request-level recovery for rate limiting. - Fixed backoff ladder (defaults 2 s / 5 s / 10 s / 20 s / 30 s, at most `requestRetryMax` retries per turn cycle — deployment values); a provider `Retry-After` wins over the ladder, and anything above the cap (default 30 s) is not waited out — the request settles terminally. The counter resets when the turn closes. - "Did the host resolve a `retryPolicy`" cannot be the dividing line: the llm registry backstops unconfigured providers with a default policy, so that condition is always true. The real division of labor is the downstream waterfall decision itself. - **Two manual recovery surfaces**: a per-turn action row on `conversation.chat.turnTail` (the same stack as first-party deliverables / plan / schedule) carries edit-resend (this session) / fork-resend (new branch) / manual retry / send-continue, plus a **manual-only** "resume interrupted turn" button where the host's crash repair appended an `interrupted` closer to an orphaned turn; the dock above the input box keeps only the session-level trio — the countdown banner / stop-and-reask / a per-session switch. Stop-and-reask queues your re-ask first and then cancels, so the message survives the cancel, and you can edit the re-ask text first (prefilled with your last message); while the host's built-in retry is in progress the retry button is hidden entirely — the composer primary button is already "Continue generating" at that moment. - **Rescue-exhausted escalation**: quota exhaustion is no longer log-only — a frame-wide floating toast names the exhausted kind once, and clears itself once a turn completes normally (or the todo list closes for catch-up); a later exhaustion reports again. - **Optional steer continuation (off by default)**: when enabled on the settings card, a turn about to close while the todo list it wrote itself still has open items is continued **in the same turn** via `agent.steer` instead of being closed and re-run; it shares the `maxUnfinished` quota with catch-up, so the anti-runaway semantics are one track. - **Connection-aware**: an injection whose send failed (transport trouble) is suspended instead of dropped, shown as a reconnecting banner, and re-armed with its remaining delay once the connection returns. - **`/state` polling is a self-scheduling two-tier loop**: 1 s while a pending exists (the banner counts down by the second), 5 s otherwise; the next hop is armed only after the current one lands, so an in-flight request neither overlaps nor strands the loop. After three consecutive unreadable polls the cached snapshot is discarded — the banner and the per-session switch fall back to their neutral state instead of counting down from a value nobody confirmed — and polling backs off by doubling up to 30 s. - **A settings card** with the recovery knobs and per-provider 429 retry presets written into the official `llm-pi-ai` namespace. - Host read surface: `agent/error`, `agent/status`, `agent/request-error`, `agent/disposed` (cleanup). Turn facts (`turn/start`, `turn/end`, `user/message`, `tool/call`, `todo/write`) fold incrementally through `ctx.sessionProjections`; on profiles without that registry, or on shapes the fold cannot vouch for, it falls back to a full `session.snapshotEvents()` scan with identical verdicts. ### How a decision is made - Classification (`classifyFailure`) is a fixed ladder. Permanent failure codes veto first (`CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` / `AUTH` / `INVALID_CREDENTIAL` / `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` / `INVALID_REQUEST` / `INVALID_ARGS` / `NO_ADAPTER` / `INVALID_MODEL_CONTEXT` / `INVALID_PREPARED_CALL`). The `QUOTA` code is then split by evidence: HTTP 429, `Retry-After` or rate-limit wording means transient; balance-exhausted wording means permanent. HTTP 401/403 and billing status 402 are permanent; the explicit transient codes (`RATE_LIMIT` / `SERVER` / `TIMEOUT` / `TRANSPORT` / `EMPTY_RESPONSE`), HTTP 408/425/429/5xx and rate-limit wording are transient; `PI_AI_ERROR` with an unrecognized `finish_reason` or empty-response wording is transient. Everything unrecognized is permanent — conservative by design. - An `error` without a `.failure` face counts the same as permanent; the classifier unwraps host-wrapped `AggregateError` before giving up. - Classification is built-in safety logic; the card deliberately exposes no way to change it. - **Standing down:** non-root (subagent) sessions; `providerExcludes` hits `resume` only; the last `turn/end` says `aborted` (a user/parent/hook cancel — you stopped it, nothing is injected, no quota spent) or `interrupted` (a closing marker the host's crash repair writes for an orphaned turn, appended by the agent-loop resume path and never emitted live — state after a crash is unknown, so nothing is auto-injected either); the turn called `ask_user_question` (no catch-up); the turn was opened by the official Schedule reminder (all three kinds stand down). - A `"goal"` turn is decided **at fire time** from the official goal service, not unconditionally: `active` + `armed` (the driver is still driving) → stand down; `active` + `disarmed` (the driver gave up — by its own design it never auto-retries) → this plugin takes the round over; `paused` / `blocked` / `complete` are human or lifecycle decisions and are never overridden; an unreadable goal state stands down too. - **Pre-fire check** (`preFireCheck`): the agent is gone, the status is not `idle`, the inbox holds queued messages, or a newer turn already started → the pending injection is silently voided, without counting or entering cooldown. - **Quota is consecutive**: one `completed` turn zeroes `resume` / `continue`; `unfinished` only refills once the todo list closes (otherwise inject → still open → inject again would self-oscillate). ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @jayyuen66/dsh-session-rescue ``` Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @jayyuen66/dsh-session-rescue`. The package is on the public npm registry, so installation needs no credentials and no scoped-registry line. - **Requires Node.js `>= 24.9`.** This is an ESM-only package; that Node floor is what makes `require()` of an ESM entry work at all, which is why `engines.node` is declared. - **Requires host `dsh` at the `0.2.1-rc.5` or `0.2.2-alpha.3` line.** The requirement the host reads is `engines.dsh` (`^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3`), and it **decides alone**: once that branch answers, `peerDependencies` is not consulted. Prereleases take part in the range comparison (the host calls it with `includePrerelease: true`). The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers carry the same window; the exact `devDependencies` pins are the compile-time discipline, not an install gate. The support window rolls: this package is verified against every released host version inside the window at publish time and re-verified once the window moves, so the version number in this bullet is not a standing promise. - **No `@deepseek-ai/*` under `dependencies`, by contract** (`test/publish-manifest.test.ts` enforces it). Consumer profiles install with `nodeLinker: hoisted` and `autoInstallPeers: false`, so a host package under `dependencies` is materialized as a real directory next to the copy the running host already loaded — native tool calls then throw while build, typecheck and coverage stay green. The host packages `host.js` imports for value (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-brand`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol`, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`) are required peers repeated under `devDependencies` at the same pin, so the bundler externalizes them instead of inlining official function bodies. - **What ships**: the `prepare`-rebuilt `host.js` and `client.js`, `types/`, `cordis.patch.yml`, plus `README*`, `LICENSE`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `icon.svg`. Artifacts are not committed, and are not minified on purpose — the bare cross-package specifiers must survive for the externalization assertions to mean anything. - Install fails with 404: that version was never published (check `dist-tags.latest`). It usually means the sibling library package `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared` is not on the registry yet — `host.js` value-imports its `lib/locale`, `lib/record`, `lib/errors` and `lib/lesson-bus`, and `client.js` value-imports `client`, so a missing one surfaces as `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`. ### Shared version floor If your profile pins `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared` with a pnpm `overrides` entry, that pin must be at least the version this package declares. A lower pin installs a copy without the names imported at runtime, and the host then reports `N entries did not activate` together with `does not provide an export named ...` at boot — the package installs fine and never loads, and no per-repository CI run can see it. ## Verify it is live 1. **Mounted**: `dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows this package's layer. - That command is the only accepted "it is in the layer stack" signal, and it is **not read-only** — it rewrites the profile's root assembly file. Read layer lines from stdout **and** check stderr separately: an unmatched patch target appears only on stderr, so the exit code alone proves nothing. - A layer line may read `# == ` or `# == , patched by `; accept both forms. 2. **Both surfaces render**: with a session open, the recovery dock sits above the input box — the per-session switch row and stop-and-reask while a turn is running; the latest completed turn (failed / truncated / crash-interrupted) carries the action row at its tail — edit-resend / fork-resend / retry / send-continue. 3. **The settings card renders live data**: the plugin page lists the session-rescue card, and its 429 preset section loads your `llm-pi-ai` providers (name, retry mode, quota coverage). A permanently "unavailable" readout means the layer is mounted but the Remote namespace did not reach the browser. 4. **A live rescue**: make the model call fail transiently mid-turn (for example by cutting the network); the banner appears and counts down by the second, and the log carries `[session-rescue]` lines naming the kind and the gate. Counter-check: a turn you stop yourself (`aborted`) injects nothing, by design — "no injection" there is not a broken install. ## What it does not provide - **It registers no model tools.** The surface is host events plus the Remote namespace; there is no `session_rescue` tool for the model to call. - **It opens no HTTP route of its own.** The data plane is the official Typert Remote namespace `sessionRescue`, reached through the host `/api` gateway; authentication, Host / DNS-rebinding / Origin checks and body limits are all the gateway's. - **It adds no CLI subcommand.** - **It renders no queued-message UI of its own**: the official conversation package already docks the queue with per-item edit / delete / interject, and this package does not duplicate it. - **The host half writes no file and makes no outbound request** (see Data and privacy). - What it *does* consume optionally: the `lessonLoop` bus (facts and passes), `sessionProjections` (fast turn facts) and the goal service (fire-time takeover verdict). A profile without them keeps rescuing — it just falls back to the full log scan, and goal turns are left alone. ## Enabling it in dsh - Bundle form: `dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json` points at `cordis.patch.yml`, a list of operations whose `insert:` block carries a single `- id: session-rescue` entry with `name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-session-rescue"` — the host scans `dsh.client` on bare-name entries only. The card components are bundled into `client.js` (only `react` / `zod` stay external to the host's module table), so the card does not depend on a second package being loaded. `dsh plugin add/remove` maintains the assembly layer. - The host half hard-depends on `timer` and `settings` (`inject: ["timer", "settings"]`); the read surface is registered through an injected child fiber into the host `remote` gateway. It does not depend on `webServer`, so a host without that service (TUI) keeps auto-recovery working and only loses the settings card's data plane. - The settings card lives in `plugins.bundle.config` on the plugin page, keyed by the **bundle package name**; `configForms.get()` and the settings namespace stay the bare entry id `session-rescue`. Edits are staged, Save writes them into settings, Revert discards. - Without UI, deployment defaults go on the registration line's `config:`; precedence = card runtime value > line `config` > schema `.default()`, and an invalid `config` fails the plugin load loudly. ## The three automatic actions | Kind | Trigger | Default delay / cooldown / quota | |---|---|---| | `resume` | `agent/error`, failure classified transient (`lib/failure-classify.ts`) | 10 s / 120 s / 3 | | `continue` | Turn ended `max-tokens` (output truncated) | 3 s / 60 s / 3 | | `unfinished` | Turn ended `completed`, its own todo list still open (`lib/turn-review.ts`) | 5 s / 120 s / 2 | - `resumeOnOpenTodos` is the catch-up kind's own switch; `providerExcludes` gates `resume` only and touches neither of the other kinds nor the request-level 429 retry. - A resume-opened turn that fails again transiently **bypasses the cooldown** and re-schedules at `chainResumeDelayMs` (default 60 s): `resumeDelayMs` plus failure time always sits inside the 120 s cooldown, so without this exception a failing chain would be silently swallowed. - The injected text comes from the fixed bilingual templates in `lib/messages.ts` and follows the official locale preference (Chinese when that entry is not projected); no session content is interpolated. ## Settings Namespace `session-rescue` = the entry id (implicit registration — the package does not call `settings.register`). The settings form and the line `config` share one `Config` schema in the host entry; the `.volatile()` fields are the card's editable face. Times in ms. | Field | Type / range | Default | Card | Purpose | |---|---|---|---|---| | `enabled` | boolean | `true` | yes | Master switch; `false` stops all three injections and the request-level 429 retry, the manual dock stays | | `providerExcludes` | string[] | `[]` | yes | Providers whose `resume` never auto-fires (e.g. ones with a dedicated retry policy) | | `resumeDelayMs` | 1000–300000 | `10000` | yes | Wait after a transient failure | | `resumeCooldownMs` | 5000–3600000 | `120000` | yes | Minimum interval between two resumes in one session | | `maxResumes` | 0–20 | `3` | yes | Per-session resume quota (consecutive semantics) | | `chainResumeDelayMs` | 1000–300000 | `60000` | yes | Re-schedule delay when a resume-opened turn fails again (cooldown bypassed) | | `continueDelayMs` | 500–300000 | `3000` | yes | Wait after a max-tokens truncation | | `continueCooldownMs` | 5000–3600000 | `60000` | yes | Minimum interval between two continues | | `maxContinues` | 0–20 | `3` | yes | Per-session continue quota | | `resumeOnOpenTodos` | boolean | `true` | yes | The catch-up kind's own switch | | `unfinishedDelayMs` | 1000–300000 | `5000` | yes | Wait after an open-todo turn | | `unfinishedCooldownMs` | 5000–3600000 | `120000` | yes | Minimum interval between two catch-ups | | `maxUnfinished` | 0–20 | `2` | yes | Catch-up quota; refills only when the list closes | | `unfinishedSteerMode` | boolean | `false` | yes | Steer continuation (experimental): continue in-turn via `agent.steer` before a turn closes; shares `maxUnfinished` with catch-up | | `requestRetryMax` | 0–20 | `5` | no | Request-level 429 retry cap | | `requestRetryBackoffMs` | number[] (≥ 1 entry) | `[2000, 5000, 10000, 20000, 30000]` | no | Backoff ladder for the request-level retry | | `requestRetryBackoffCapMs` | ≥ 1000 | `30000` | no | Longest this plugin will wait; a longer `Retry-After` delegates back downstream | The three `requestRetry*` rows are deployment values: not `.volatile()`, so the card has no row for them — they go on the registration line's `config:` only (plain values, applied on restart). ## Public interface Six methods on the official Typert Remote namespace `sessionRescue`. Parameters go through strict codecs; results use `src-json`. | Method | Input | Reply | |---|---|---| | `state` | — | `ok` plus a per-session snapshot: pending kind, remaining-ms countdown, chained / suspended flags, fire counters, the per-session switch | | `cancel` | `{ sessionId }` | Cancels that session's pending injection, suspended ones included | | `toggle` | `{ sessionId }` | Flips the per-session switch; switching off also cancels pendings. 409 when the toggle ledger is full with no dead session to evict | | `resume` | — | Restores suspended injections after a reconnect; `ok` plus the restored count | | `retryProviders` | — | The official `llm-pi-ai` providers with retry mode / count / quota coverage; 503 when that namespace is unavailable | | `retryPolicy` | `{ provider, preset }` | Writes `providers..retryPolicy` (presets `default` / `enhanced` / `always` / `off`) via `settings.mutate`; a revision conflict answers 409 | - A refusal's `status` is a retained semantic code, not an HTTP status of a route of this package — there are no routes. - The only model-visible artifact: one `role: "user"` message through `agent.followup()`, with an id like `session-rescue--` and text from the fixed templates. This package keeps no second retry configuration of its own. - Optional `lessonLoop` bus: when present it receives the `transient-failure`, `unclassified-failure`, `max-tokens` and `unfinished-turn` facts, and one `pass` once the same provider genuinely finishes a `completed` turn. An absent or throwing bus only warns; the main path never depends on it. ## Data and privacy | Aspect | Content | |---|---| | Nothing written, nothing fetched | The host half uses no `node:fs` and makes no network calls; apart from the exit path below, the only output surfaces are `console.*` lines and the injected message | | In memory, bounded | At most 200 session records in the scheduler, 64 suspended pendings and 64 pending-pass entries; those three trim the oldest first. The per-session toggle ledger also holds 200 entries, but when full it evicts only sessions with no live agent, and `toggle` returns 409 if none can be evicted — a live session's off-switch is never dropped, which would silently re-enable its recovery. Timers are released on `agent/disposed` and on plugin unload | | Persisted, exactly two places, both through official settings | This namespace `session-rescue` and the `llm-pi-ai` retry presets, stored under the dsh data directory and surviving restarts | | Per-session switch | Process memory only; a restart falls back to the global `enabled` | | Language | The injected text follows the official locale preference; Chinese when that entry is not projected | | The only exit path | Content leaves only towards lesson-loop, and only when it is installed: it receives the failure code / status / message verbatim, the session id and the session's `cwd`, and lesson-loop alone decides where that is written. Without it nothing is recorded | ## Known boundaries - **Unknown failure shapes are permanent, by design.** Everything the classifier cannot recognize is left alone; the card exposes no override. A mis-guessed "transient" would re-open turns that can never succeed. - **`providerExcludes` gates `resume` only** — `continue`, `unfinished` and the request-level 429 retry do not consult it. - **Subagent sessions are never touched** — only root sessions are rescued. - **The catch-up kind has a structural precondition**: the turn must have written a `todo/write` list that still holds `pending` or `in_progress` items. The current contract asks downstream first — failures the official `llm-retry` accepts (inside the code table, retries left) belong to it, and this plugin takes only what it passes (outside the table such as `QUOTA`, retries exhausted, `Retry-After` over the ceiling). - **The official `llm-retry` is not always downstream**: while its abort signal is fired or its entry is disposed it returns without delegating — in those windows this plugin's adoption step simply observes that it declined to participate; in `always` mode it asks downstream before retrying, so the two decisions do not collide. - **While the read surface stays unreachable the dock degrades instead of pretending**: the banner and the per-session switch fall back to neutral and polling backs off. The turn-relative actions keep working — they read live session state, not the read surface. ## FAQ | Question | Answer | |---|---| | Does it silently spend money? | Yes. The injections are user-role messages, so the model continues and keeps consuming tokens and quota. | | I want one switch off. | The card's master switch (`enabled = false`) stops all three injections and the request-level 429 retry while keeping the manual UI. | | Narrower exits? | The dock's per-session switch, `resumeOnOpenTodos` (catch-up only), `providerExcludes` (resume on one provider only). | | The model stopped but nothing resumed. | Look for `[session-rescue] : auto- skipped (pending/cooldown/max-resumes)` or `vetoed at fire time ()` in the log. # betterloading

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

A **frosted-glass pouring loader** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) (dsh) web UI.

The most familiar slow-network scene: the shell UI has already rendered, but the session list, workspaces and jobs are still in flight, leaving a blank area — you cannot tell loading from frozen. This plugin covers the unfinished part with a pane of frosted glass, **raises the water line with real load progress, lets the frost recede with it, and fades the page into clarity**. At the end the plate fades out and the overlay is removed.

> It does not fake progress. The water level is driven by real events: static resources completing, the app mounting, and every `/api` request starting and finishing.

## Features

- **Causal physics**: each finished load drops one invisible blob of water from a **random horizontal position** above the surface. It splashes, and its volume is poured in continuously (smoothstep, with ease-in/ease-out) so the level rises by exactly how much that blob carried.
- **A real water surface**: a 1-D damped wave equation integrated every frame. Waves travel, reflect off both edges, and interfere. Not a scrolling texture.
- **The blur boundary *is* the water surface**: the frost layer's clip geometry is regenerated from the wave curve every frame (`clip-path: path(...)`), not a horizontal line.
- **Two frost modes** (below): real `backdrop-filter` blur (default) or a static noise fallback with no real blur.
- **Compositor-only highlights**: the glow boxes animate `opacity` and position via `translate3d`, never `box-shadow` — measured near-zero frame cost.
- **Theme aware**: follows dsh's `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` for both palette and plate styling.
- **Never touches your business requests**: `fetch` is wrapped for counting only and returns the original promise; no dsh package file is modified.
- **Never traps you**: removed on content-ready, with a fallback check and a hard timeout.


## Settings

The plugin registers its own page in **Settings → Plugins → Better Loading**
(`plugins.bundle.config`, keyed by the package name — and the same card is
also listed through `plugins.item`). All 17 options are editable there and
take effect immediately: `mode`, `blur`, `noise`, `tintLight`, `tintDark`,
`locale`, `texts`, `icon`, `iconSize`, `glowColor`, `glowMax`, `maxBlob`,
`waveSpeed`, `damping`, `amplitude`, `idleTimeoutMs`, and the master
`enabled` switch.

`mode` defaults to `realtime`: the area above the water is a real
`backdrop-filter` blur with a tint, and everything below the waterline is fully
transparent — that contrast is the whole point of the effect. Measured 60fps
during load on the reference machine (same as with no overlay).

`static` is a fallback for constrained devices: it paints a static noise tile and
tint instead, so **there is no real blur** — the area above the water just looks
milky. Use it only when `realtime` measurably costs you frames.

## Package metadata

- Display name: `locale/en.json` / `locale/zh.json` → `meta.title`
- Description: same files → `meta.description`
- Icon: `package.json` → `"icon": "./icon.svg"` (relative path; dsh inlines
  it as a data URL, ≤256 KiB, SVG/PNG/JPEG/WebP)

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-betterloading
```

The CLI reads the `dsh.bundle` declaration and registers it in `dsh.profile.bundles` — no manual patch editing.

Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-betterloading
```

## Two frost modes (`mode`)

| | `static` | `realtime` (default) |
|---|---|---|
| Implementation | Sample the page's base colour once + tile a generated noise texture | Real `backdrop-filter: blur()` |
| Look | Frosted film (grain) | Real glass — you can see blurred shapes behind it |
| Compositing cost | **No realtime filters** | Blurs only the band |
| Measured fps | 60 | ~36 (while the frosted area is nearly full-screen early on) |

In earlier builds `realtime` dropped to 34fps because **a full-screen `backdrop-filter` sat underneath a full-screen canvas repainting every frame**, forcing the compositor to re-blur the whole backdrop each frame. A layered structure fixes it — both modes now measure 60fps:

```
above + middle │ ONE frost layer whose clip-path follows the wave
───────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────
below          │ transparent (nothing drawn; the page is sharp)
```

**A single `backdrop-filter` element is deliberate**: two adjacent blurred
layers each clamp their backdrop sampling at the edge, which always shows up as
a visible seam; and `mask` + `backdrop-filter` is unreliable in Chrome (the fade
does not apply, the tint double-stacks). One layer costs more per frame but is
visually seamless.

Switch to `static` when you want 60fps and can accept a frosted film instead of
real blur:

```yaml
- id: betterloading
  config:
    mode: "realtime"
    blur: 12
```

## Configuration

Override in your own profile patch layer (`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` or the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; both apply after every bundle layer):

```yaml
- id: betterloading
  config:
    mode: "realtime"     # realtime (default) | static
    noise: 13            # static-mode grain strength, 0-100
    tintLight: "rgba(250,252,255,.55)"
    tintDark: "rgba(14,18,26,.62)"
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `locale` | `"auto"` | `auto` follows the browser language; `zh` / `en` force one |
| `texts` | `{}` | Override any string; keys listed below |
| `icon` | `"whale"` | Plate icon: `whale` (dsh's own), `none`, an inline `<svg>…</svg>`, or an image URL |
| `iconSize` | `30` | Icon edge length in px |
| `mode` | `"realtime"` | `static` = sampled frost; `realtime` = real backdrop blur |
| `blur` | `10` | Blur radius for `realtime` mode (px), 0-60 |
| `noise` | `13` | Grain strength for `static` mode, 0-100 |
| `tintLight` | `rgba(250,252,255,.55)` | Frost tint on light theme |
| `tintDark` | `rgba(14,18,26,.62)` | Frost tint on dark theme |
| `maxBlob` | `0.04` | Max volume of one blob (fraction of screen). Caps how much a single load advances |
| `waveSpeed` | `200` | c² of the wave equation. Higher travels faster |
| `damping` | `0.35` | Damping. Too high and waves die before reaching the edges; too low and they ring |
| `amplitude` | `46` | Surface amplitude in px |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Idle timeout (ms): removed only after this long with **no network activity** (requests start/finish, resources complete, content advances). A slow-but-moving load is never cut. Range 2000–180000 |

### Text keys

Keys accepted by `texts` (missing ones fall back to the built-in pack):

`title` `connecting` `prep` `waiting` `resources` `requests` `downloading`
`resourcesReady` `uiReady` `loadingTopic` `contentLoading` `contentReady`
`done` `totalRequests` `timeout`
`tSession` `tWorkspace` `tSettings` `tJob` `tAccount` `tTerminal` `tAttachment` `tContent`

`{n}` / `{topic}` are substituted. Example:

```yaml
- id: betterloading
  config:
    locale: "en"
    icon: "whale"
    texts:
      title: "Loading my harness"
      connecting: "Waking up…"
```

The default icon is dsh's own whale (single path, `currentColor`, so it follows
the light/dark theme). A URL also works:

```yaml
  icon: "https://example.com/my-logo.png"
```

### Tuning hints

- Water fills too fast / a single load nearly fills the screen → lower `maxBlob`
- Cannot see the waves → raise `amplitude`, or lower `damping` so they travel further
- The surface twitches → raise `damping`
- Weak machine, want it cheaper → keep `mode: static` and lower `noise`

## How it works

Exactly three injections, all via dsh's `webserver/index-inject`:

1. `<style>` — overlay, frost layer and plate styling
2. a `<div>` at the top of `body` — the overlay structure
3. a synchronous `<script>` at the top of `body` — it runs before the `type="module"` scripts in `head`, so it can install the fetch wrapper and `MutationObserver` before dsh issues its first `/api` call

Water-level state machine:

```
0%      start
 →0.42  static resources (one blob per newly finished resource)
 →0.10  app mount (#root gains child nodes)
 →…     one small blob per /api request start and finish
 100%   content ready → plate fades, surface recedes, node removed
```

## Known limitations

- **Does not work in dsh Desktop (Electron) out of the box.** The overlay is injected through
  `webserver/index-inject`, which only affects the index served by
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver` / `dsh-host-frontend-static`. Desktop is an
  Electron shell around the same Web app: it *does* run a Web Host (on an
  OS-assigned port) but the page itself is loaded from `dsh-app://app/` out of
  the packaged build, and only app HTTP/WebSocket traffic is forwarded to that
  Host. `renderIndex` is not used there, so injected rows never reach the
  document. Upstream `docs/subsystems/web-server` states it directly: "the
  server serves browsers only: Electron loads built files over `file://` and
  sends fetch requests through an IPC bridge, and does not use this server."
  A client bundle would not help either: `dsh-client-modules` rejects any
  `dsh.client.platform` other than `"web"`
  (`if (decl === void 0 || decl.platform !== "web") return null`).
- A client bundle would not help either, so making it work there requires patching the
  desktop build. [`docs/desktop.md`](docs/desktop.md) is an instruction sheet written for a
  coding agent: how to locate the packaged `index.html`, transplant the injection rows with
  [`scripts/patch-desktop-index.mjs`](scripts/patch-desktop-index.mjs), or make Electron call
  `renderIndex` so the settings page keeps working — plus the conditions under which it should
  stop and report it as impossible.
- Affects the dsh **web UI** only; server behaviour is unchanged.
- Depends on dsh's `webserver/index-inject` event and the `#root` structure. A major dsh change may require follow-up.
- dsh's own boot screen is hidden via a **structural selector** (class contains `_boot_`) because its class names carry build hashes. The failure card is deliberately left visible.
- "Content ready" is a combination of the official list phases (`sessions` and `workspaces` both `ready`), so it means *data arrived*, not *DOM looks full*.
- The water level advances on every completed load (each completion adds a blob whose
  volume is a share of the remaining gap, so the level never parks at a fixed cap and
  never fully fills before the page is actually ready). While a load is in flight but no
  completion event has arrived — the normal state of a 6 MB `/plugins` bundle on a slow
  link, since native `<script type="module">` exposes no progress — a small trickle keeps
  the surface moving. The trickle is bounded, always yields to real completion events, and
  stops when the document finishes loading or the browser reports offline.
- The timeout is an **idle** timeout, not a wall-clock one: a 30 kbps link that keeps making progress is never cut off, while a dead connection is released after `idleTimeoutMs`.

## License

MIT

# dsh-doc-review

这个仓库想解决一件很具体的事：AI 审完文档，交回来的东西得能由机器校验，而不是一段自由发挥的评语。我把「什么样算合格」写成固定判据和结构化报告，审查放在独立会话里跑，每一轮的目标文档、问题清单和裁决记录都留档。代码由 AI 协作实现；我负责定判据、收敛口径和验收方式，存疑项单列交人决定，再逐版装机实测。我原本做飞机型号的数据分析，习惯先定合格判据与误差阈值再评估，这套习惯也带到了 Agent 输出上。

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek)（DSH）的文档审查插件。挂载后注册一个 `/doc-review` 斜杠指令：用户在会话中手动执行后，插件向当前会话注册 `doc_review` 工具。主 Agent 需要审查文档时，插件经 TypertGateway 开一个独立审查会话、用后台 job 盯着结果，按固定判据做结构化审查，返回机器可校验的问题清单（issues）、裁决表模板与下一步指引，并把每一轮的文档与报告落盘归档。

审查在独立会话中进行，不污染主会话上下文；主 Agent 只消费结构化结论，可据此逐轮修订文档，形成「审查 → 修订 → 复审」的多轮收敛链。

自 v0.2.0 起工具不再全局常驻，必须在会话里执行 `/doc-review` 才会在当前会话注册。未激活的会话零暴露，重复执行幂等，会话关闭后失效，新会话需要重新激活。

运行时要求 Node.js ≥ 20，DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`；依赖宿主提供 commands / tools / typertGateway / jobs / sessions / skills；许可证 MIT。

## 特性

- 隔离审查：独立审查会话 + 后台 job 监视，输出经 JSON Schema 强校验；解析不了的自由文本走降级路径，不把脏数据抛给主 Agent。审查会话默认不授予外部工具，只有显式打开事实核查才开放联网检索，以保证结论只来自文档本身与给定参考资料。
- 固定判据：事实 / 完整性 / 必要性 / 格式四维，可逐维开关。
- 三种文档输入：内联全文、指向主会话某条消息、工作区相对路径（大文件推荐，不必把全文塞进工具参数）。
- 多轮收敛：用 `chain_id` 串联，自动读回上一轮归档文档做变更比对、跨轮对齐问题、复算新增与解决数并判定是否收敛。
- token 成本闸门：派审查会话前先做保守预估，超阈值时不派会话，让主 Agent 向用户给出确认/取消二选一，确认后才放行，确认按链生效。
- 分级审查：全文四维、等距抽样粗筛、仅事实维三档，用于低成本先看一遍。
- 全程归档：每轮落盘目标文档、结构化报告、裁决记录，链根另记成本与审查会话账本。

## 怎么收敛、怎么算成本

收敛不让模型自己说「改好了」。插件读回上一轮文档，先做行级再做字符级的变更比对，按非空白字符算出变更率；问题清单跨轮按稳定 ID 与位置对齐，新增与解决数由插件复算，不采信审查员自报。变更率足够低，或本轮没有高危问题且复算新增为零，就判定收敛，或已达轮次上限。

成本上，派审查会话前先按输入包体积做保守预估，超阈值先要一次确认；同一条链的累计预算另算，一次确认只在链内持续有效，避免同一轮反复确认。

每轮在工作区 `.doc-review/<chain_id>/round-N/` 下留目标文档、结构化报告与裁决记录。超时未拿到结论时，带同一 `chain_id` 重调会自动续取那个审查会话的结论，不用手工粘贴。

## 安装与挂载

本插件是 bundle patch 插件，`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 [cordis.patch.yml](./cordis.patch.yml)。

方式 A，overlay 挂载（推荐，免安装、可随时移除）：克隆仓库后，用 `--patch` 在一个独立端口的 DSH Web 实例上叠加加载，不写入任何 profile：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JiewiW/dsh-doc-review.git
dsh web --port <自定义端口> --patch "$PWD/dsh-doc-review/cordis.patch.yml"
```

Windows PowerShell 下换成：

```powershell
dsh web --port <自定义端口> --patch (Resolve-Path <插件目录>\cordis.patch.yml).Path
```

方式 B，作为插件长期安装：

```bash
dsh plugin add github:JiewiW/dsh-doc-review#v0.3.4
```

## 审查判据与验收

判据写在 [skills/doc-review-generic/SKILL.md](./skills/doc-review-generic/SKILL.md)，含通用纪律与四个维度共 23 条，附「症状反查表」与输出前自查清单；文件缺失时插件用内置默认文本降级，返回里会标注。另一种文档类型另有 [skills/doc-review-task-prompt/SKILL.md](./skills/doc-review-task-prompt/SKILL.md)。

测试用 Node 内置测试运行器，零 LLM 调用、零网络：

```bash
node --test
```

Windows 下请用自动发现形式，不要把目录路径作为位置参数传入。覆盖 Schema 合法性、上下文组装、成本判定、收敛与对齐算法、工具层端到端（网关与 job 全 mock，含成本闸门、多轮归档读回、链断裂、路径防护、抽样）、审查会话结论抢救与分片续等，以及 host 入口装配冒烟。实现见 `lib/`，判据见 `skills/`，各版本改动见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

## 已知边界

- 激活是会话级的：`/doc-review` 只在执行它的那一个会话内生效，新开会话或会话关闭后必须重新激活，这是预期行为而非缺陷。
- 依赖宿主提供 TypertGateway 与 jobs 服务；缺失时降级为 same-session，审查不再与会话隔离。
- 参考资料不接受 URL，只接受内联文本与工作区内文件。
- 多轮链要求上一轮文档可从归档读回，或显式提供兜底全文；两者皆无会返回结构化错误且不派审查会话。
- 大文档建议用工作区相对路径：把整篇全文内联进单个工具调用参数会显著增大单次请求体。
- 长思维链审查默认总超时 900 秒，可上调至 1800 秒；超时未收敛时带同一 `chain_id` 重调会自动续取结论。
- 部分文档类型还没配上独立判据文件，会降级到内置默认文本，返回里同样会标注。
- 本插件随 0.2.0 预览版 DSH 开发，宿主内核 API（服务名、工具注册约定）在稳定版前可能变动。

# @local/dsh-lazy-plugins

按需加载市场插件的 Host 插件（v3.14.4）。本地没有的插件，在任务需要时由 agent 从市场索引解析、安装、**当场可用**；用完可以卸载移除。
默认激活方式为 `proxy`：插件真正生效，但它的工具**不进模型可见的 tools[]**，因此不会打碎提示词前缀缓存。

## Claude 式形态（v3.14）

常驻只注入一句（152 字符 / ≈38 tokens），细节在注册的 **skill** 正文里，模型需要时才加载：

- `skills/lazy-plugins/SKILL.md`：frontmatter（name/description/whenToUse）+ 正文（何时用、三个动作、判定规则、示例、注意）；
- 插件 apply 时读文件并 `ctx.get("skills").register({ name, description, whenToUse, content, invocation, provider, source: "runtime" })`；
- 实测：工具描述 **936 → 152 字符（234 → 38 tokens）**，skill 出现在模型技能目录并能按需加载（`advise.skill = ["lazy-plugins:runtime"]`）。

## 工具（模型可见面）

只有一个工具 `lazy_plugin`：

| 动作 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `ensure` | **给一句需求**，自动挑出最匹配的插件并在判定明确时直接安装（默认走 proxy） |
| `suggest` | 任务句 → 候选排序（IDF 加权，可翻页） |
| `search` | 关键词检索（可翻页，去重 + 隐藏装不上的条目） |
| `resolve` | 看一个包的版本、安装目标（npm / git）、兼容性 |
| `load` | 安装指定版本并激活（已装则只做启用） |
| `reload` | 停用→启用，让新版本模块生效（不重启 dsh） |
| `unload` | 停用但保留安装 |
| `release` | 停用并移除 |
| `uninstall` | 直接移除 |
| `list` | 已装清单、懒加载记录、常驻判定与使用分、索引缓存状态 |
| `refresh` | 立刻刷新索引（条件请求）并预热常驻插件 |
| `advise` | 体检：工具面 tokens、缓存命中率、使用分、隐藏工具、建议 |
| `invoke` | 调用被 proxy 隐藏的工具（`{tool, arguments}`） |

## 模型调用准则

1. **有需求先 `ensure`**：一句话描述要做什么，它负责挑；判定不明确时才回候选让人选。
2. 想自己挑就用 `suggest` / `search`，按「描述最匹配」优先，其次热度；可 `offset` 翻页。
3. **优先最新版本**：不传 `version` 就是索引默认（最新）版本。
4. **一次装一个**，用完 `release`，不要囤。
5. `load` 回 `installable:false` 说明该条目任何 registry 都装不上（索引里有这类幽灵条目），换候选，别重试同一个。
6. 没有 `force` 参数：base bundle 一律拒绝停用/移除，常用插件只提示不阻断。

## 激活方式与提示词缓存

工具是 API 独立字段 `tools[]`、按名字排序，缓存断点在最后一个工具，所以**可见工具集一变，前缀就重建**。

| `activate` | 当场能用 | 前缀缓存 | 做法 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `proxy`（默认） | ✅ | ✅ 不变 | 插件激活，工具被 **per-agent `tools.restrict`** 藏起来，经 `invoke` 调用 |
| `now` | ✅ | ❌ 重建一次 | 工具原生进入 `tools[]` |
| `session` | ❌ | ✅ | 只安装，之后 `load` 一次启用（无下载，约 0.1–0.5 s） |

`invoke` 之所以能调用隐藏工具：`tools.execute()` 在 host 作用域执行，而 `restrict` 只作用于 agent 作用域（实测：`visibleForAgent: false` / `visibleGlobally: true` / `executeWithoutAgent: ok`）。
屏蔽落盘在 `hidden.json`，启动时重新打上；插件卸载后失效名字会自动剔除；插件异步注册的工具由 1.2 s / 3.5 s / 7 s 三次补扫兜住。

## 检索与自动选取

- **候选池**：`limit × 3`，先按相关性排序，再 `enrich`、过滤不可装、按安装目标合并近重复（`dsh-voice-7` / `dsh-voice-13` → `dsh-voice`，带 `variants`）。
- **IDF 加权**：`idf = ln(1 + N/(1+df))`，命中按 `idf × 字段权重`（name 3 / title 2 / description 2）累加，`dsh`/`plugin` 这类全库词不再决定排序。
- **自动选取守卫**：`ensure` 只在 `top ≥ autoSelectScore(40)` **且** `top ≥ 第二名 × autoSelectMargin(1.5)` 时才装，否则回 `needs-choice` + 候选；`auto:false` 只报告不装。
- **阈值是实测校准出来的**（31 条真实需求语料）：`40/1.3` 的自动安装精度只有 **0.636**（11 次装错 4 次），`40/1.5` 提升到 **0.80**（recall 0.367→0.167）；没有参数组合能到 0.90，所以默认偏保守，模型多看候选是更便宜的错误。
- **git-pinned 条目**（当前占 52.5%）判为可装、不走 npm 探测；`source` 字段直接回 `npm` / `git`。

## 常驻（resident）怎么算

三路来源（社区做法见 CREDITS.md）：

| 来源 | 判定 | 效果 |
|---|---|---|
| `base` | `availability !== 'profile'` 且**当前启用**的 bundle | 硬拒绝 `unload/release/uninstall` |
| `explicit` | `config.resident` | 只加提示，不阻断 |
| `auto` | `score >= residentScore(3)` | 只加提示，不阻断 |

```
score = 1.0·Σ_loads + 0.3·Σ_manualEnables + (base ? 1000 : 0)   每项 × 0.5^(Δ/14天)
```

只写本机 `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-lazy-plugins/usage.json`，不联网、不上报。

## 索引与缓存

- **拉取**：单次尝试只等首字节 3 s，失败转镜像；源顺序 = profile 索引 → `indexMirrors`。
- **缓存优先**：磁盘副本直接返回，后台条件请求热更新（304 = 0 字节）；断网时旧副本仍可用。
- **描述表**：索引自身描述覆盖率 ≥80% 时**直接投影**（零额外请求）；否则按 `descriptionSources` 拉 sidecar/旧文档。
- **刷新触发**：启动一次、**打开插件面板一次**（client 半调用 `GET /lazy-plugins/refresh?src=panel`，60 s 节流）、每天保底一次、手动 `refresh`。
- **client 半**：`client.js` + `package.json` 的 `dsh.client{platform:web,immediately:true}` + `exports['./client']`，用 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})` 形态（无需构建）。页面挂载即调 `GET /lazy-plugins/refresh?src=mount`，点进插件面板再调 `?src=panel`，页面侧 60 s 节流 + `sessionStorage`，失败只 `console.debug`。
- **自愈（重要，给后续维护者）**：`link:` 安装的包在**主机进程启动早于 `dsh.client` 声明**时，会被上游 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 的 `ClientModuleRegistry.pkgMeta` 缓存成 `null`（该缓存**没有任何失效路径**，`set_bundle false/true` 命中缓存、不够）。本插件在**启动后 `bootDelayMs` 自动一次**、以及显式 `POST /lazy-plugins/repair-client`（或 `GET /lazy-plugins/state?repair=1`）时自愈：删掉陈旧 `null` → 强制 `reconcile` 报变更 → `flush()`（内部 `compose()` + 通知）→ 图里出现本行。`GET /lazy-plugins/state` 本身**纯读、无副作用**。
- **自愈返回值**：`repair.attempted:false` + `why:"already in graph"` 是**幂等 no-op（已在图中，不是失败）**；真正的失败看 `repair.errors` 或 `repair.compose.error/failures`。
- **自愈的退出条件（必须遵守）**：这是**上游缺陷的 workaround**，不是本插件的功能。一旦 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 让 `pkgMeta` 的 key 带上 `package.json` 的 mtime/size、或暴露 `invalidate()`、或 `flush()` 前对 dirty 行强制重解析 —— 就**整段删除** `ensureClientRow` 及其三个触发点（启动定时器、`POST /lazy-plugins/repair-client`、`GET /state?repair=1`），此 README 对应段落一并删除。依据与建议修法见 `_tmp/panel-trigger/UPSTREAM-ISSUE.md`；`clientHalf.lastRepair.upstream` 字段也带同一句提示。
- **验证计数**：`state.panelPings`（过闸执行的刷新数）、`clientRequests`（含被节流的客户端调用）、`browserPings`（带 `Sec-Fetch-Mode`+浏览器 UA 的调用，`curl` 伪造不了）+ `lastBrowserPingFingerprint`、`lastBrowserPingSource`（`mount`/`panel`），以及 `clientHalf{inGraph,rows,graphRev,url,clientPath,lastRepair}`。
- 索引现状（2026-11-07 实测）：10,559 条、99.96% 带 zh 描述、52.5% git-pinned、166 个后缀名条目。

## 装前探测与别名

- npm 条目：并行 HEAD `<registry>/<name>/<version>`（命中 26–230 ms）；全 404 直接回 `installable:false`；超时/网络错判为未知，不挡安装。
- 别名：索引把重名条目改名成 `dsh-voice-8`，真实包名在 `title`。`load` 用 `title` 作第二候选，探测通过就装真名并回 `installedAs`。

## 可配置项

`cordis.patch.yml`（全部有默认值）：`defaultActivate`、`autoSelectScore`、`autoSelectMargin`、`autoSelectEnabled`、`resident`、`halfLifeDays`、`residentScore`、`fetchTimeoutMs`、`bodyTimeoutMs`、`refreshIntervalMs`、`dailyRefreshMs`、`panelThrottleMs`、`bootDelayMs`、`indexMirrors`、`descriptionSources`、`descriptionTtlMs`、`descriptionSearch`、`enrichDescriptions`、`enrichTimeoutMs`、`enrichRegistries`、`verifyInstall`、`probeFastMs`、`probeTimeoutMs`、`deferLoading`、`diskCache`、`cacheTtlMs`。

## 性能（本机实测）

| 场景 | 耗时 |
|---|---|
| 已装再 `load`（快路径） | 75–490 ms |
| 冷装小包（含探测+安装+激活） | 1.9–2.6 s |
| 冷装大包 / registry 抖动 | 3–5 s（个别 38 s，属上游 installBundle 抖动） |

## 失败恢复

`reload` 是「先停用再启用」，启用失败会停在停用态 → 现在失败自动重试一次并回传 `diagnostic` + 修复提示（最常见成因：`cordis.patch.yml` 里 `@scope` 未加引号）。

## 数据边界

只做三件事：读市场索引、调 profile 的 `pluginManager`、返回结果。不写日志文件、不上报、不采集会话内容。

## 加进 DSH

「插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源」，两个都加（互为主备）：


> 为什么主源选 GitHub Pages：2026-11-02 本机直连实测 **3/3 成功，0.61–0.81 s**；同一份索引走 Cloudflare Pages 自定义域名时 **3 次里 1 次卡在 25 s 只收到 538 B**、其余 3.8–17.5 s（CF 边缘境内无节点，直连不稳；走代理 2/2 成功 1.9–2.9 s）。DSH 的 fetch 超时是 15 s，所以把 Pages 当人读站点、把 GitHub Pages 当机器源，两边都不丢。

## 它是什么 / 不是什么

- 是：从 **npm 公共源**爬到的、**声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`** 且 `engines.dsh` 满足当前运行时的包的元数据清单（分类、多语言描述、图标直链、精确版本）。
- 不是：不是代码托管，不镜像任何包，不对任何插件背书。装什么、跑什么，以包本身为准。

## 爬取与准入（`crawler/crawl.mjs`，零依赖）

```

node crawler/crawl.mjs                # 爬取并生成 dist/
```

两段式，先便宜后贵：

1. **发现**：`registry.npmjs.org` 关键词检索（`keywords:dsh-plugin`、`keywords:deepseek-harness`、`keywords:dsh`）。
2. **初筛**（每包 1 次 `/<name>/latest`）：必须声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`；不得含 `preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`。
3. **定版**（入选包再取完整 packument）：取**最新稳定版**且满足 `engines.dsh`；未声明 `engines.dsh` 的一律**不收**（不猜"应该能跑"）；发布不足 `MIN_AGE_DAYS`（默认 3 天）的不收（pnpm 的 `minimumReleaseAge` 会扣住它们，写进索引用户也装不上）；许可为空或 `NOASSERTION`/`UNLICENSED` 的不收。

产出：

### 已知的爬取坑（踩过）

- **npmmirror 不支持 `keywords:` 语法**：`registry.npmmirror.com/-/v1/search?text=keywords:dsh-plugin` 返回 `total=0`，而 npmjs 返回约 11.9k。所以**发现阶段固定用 npmjs**；manifest 阶段可换镜像加速。
- **不能信 latest**：一个包可能同时有多个兼容版本，`latest` 未必兼容当前运行时，所以定版要读完整 packument。
- **未声明 `engines.dsh` ≠ 兼容**：DSH 的安装侧会用真实包的 `engines` + `peerDependencies` 再判一次，索引里谎报兼容比不收更伤口碑。

- 每个插件都有 `{en, zh}` 标题与简介，并被归到一个声明过的类别（9 类：safety / ui / media / integrations / memory / models / automation / devtools / other）。

## CI（三段流水线）

| 工作流 | 触发 | 做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `crawl.yml` | 每 3 小时 + 手动 | 三分片采集 → 合并目录 → 生成多语言/浏览分片/资源 → **离线 + 在线发布门禁** → Git Data API 提交 `main` → 显式触发 `deploy` |
| `ci.yml` | 每次 push / 每个 PR | 门禁自测 → 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` 校验 → 页面预算与引用检查 → registry 回查 → `--dry-run` 冒烟（守住 main 与人工 PR） |
| `deploy.yml` | main 的 `site/**`、`dist/**` 变化，或由 crawl 派发 | 双端发布：GitHub Pages + Cloudflare Pages（`wrangler`） |
| `dependabot.yml` | 每周 | GitHub Actions 版本升级 PR（人工审） |

**发布纪律**：`crawl` 和 `translate` 共用 `catalog-publish` 并发组，避免两个写入者同时基于旧 `main` 创建提交；完整发布门禁在写入 `main` 前执行，push 触发的 `ci` 作为发布后回归检查。

**两个必须知道的 GitHub 行为**（都已在代码里绕过）：

1. **用仓库 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 写入 `main` 不会触发其它 workflow**（防递归）→ 所以 `crawl` 提交后显式 `gh workflow run deploy.yml`，不指望 push 事件。
2. 当前 `crawl` 走 Git Data API 直接写 `main`，不再创建 crawl PR；因此发布门禁必须在写入前执行，不能依赖 push 后才运行的 `ci` 来阻止错误版本上线。


`ci` 里的检查（`crawler/validate.mjs`）：

1. `parseMarketIndex()` —— 与 DSH 运行时同一份校验器，不是自己重写；
2. `site/index.json` 必须与 `dist/index.json` **逐字节一致**（防止发布物与验证物脱节）；
3. `site/index.html` < 1024 B，`style.css` 存在；
4. 页面里不允许出现 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `file://` / 内联图片字体；
5. 每条 plugin 的 `name@version` 在 registry 上真实存在、仍声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，且 `engines.dsh` 与索引里写的一致（防止**索引漂移**——DSH 安装侧会用真实包再判一次兼容性）。

本地复现（不需要网络可加 `--offline`）：

```bash
npm i --no-save @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index@0.2.1-rc.5
node crawler/crawl.mjs --selftest
node crawler/validate.mjs
node crawler/crawl.mjs --dry-run
```


## 已知限制

- **索引没有签名**：format 1 里没有 signature / digest 字段，DSH 不验签。篡改只能靠外部核对 `dist/index.json` 的 sha256（见每次提交与 `stats.json`）。
- **没有 upgrade 流程**：DSH 侧「有新版」只显示 `update-available`，升级 = 卸载 + 重装。
- **索引是单文档全量读**：超过 ~5k 条要考虑拆多源（官方口径：20k 条 ≈ 7.6 MiB，反序列化约 35 ms）。
- **只覆盖 npm**：不发布到 npm 的插件（只在 GitHub 的）暂不收录；后续可加 `source.type=git` + commit 固定。
- **不做安全审计**：门禁只保证「是个能装的 bundle、版本兼容、许可清楚、不跑安装脚本」，不代表代码安全。

# @local/dsh-session-reader

读取**其他** DSH 会话：列出来、跨会话检索、把某个会话的完整对话读出来。只读，无遥测。

## 为什么需要它

官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-search` 提供 5 个工具（`session_search` / `session_event_search` /
`session_trace` / `session_event_trace` / `session_event_read`），但它们依赖 `ctx.sessionQuery` 的**抽象 FTS 方法**
（`searchSessions` / `searchEvents`），而：

1. 该 FTS 后端在默认 profile 上不可用（本机实测 `~/.dsh/session-query.sqlite` 不存在，profile 也没有 `session-query` 行）；
2. 它的 SQLite FTS5 用 `unicode61` 分词器，**不切连续中文**，中文全文检索会漏。

本插件用**字面子串**在 JS 侧匹配：中文天然正确、英文大小写不敏感，且服务路径与磁盘回退共用同一条代码路径。

## 一个工具，三个动作

| action | 做什么 | 主要参数 |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | 最近会话：短 id、标题、创建/更新时间、agentPreset、消息数、cwd、live/origin/parent | `limit`（默认 10，最大 30） |
| `search` | 跨会话字面子串检索，返回命中会话 + 前后各 60 字片段 + 事件序号 | `query`（必填）、`session`（只搜这一个）、`limit`（默认 10，最大 30） |
| `read` | 读某个会话的完整对话 | `session`（必填，支持 8 位短 id / 唯一前缀 / `session-<uuid>`）、`limit`（尾部消息数，默认 20，最大 60）、`window`、`role` |

参数共 6 个（`action` / `session` / `query` / `limit` / `window` / `role`），工具描述 370 字符。

### `window` 的两种写法

- `"120-180"` 或 `"150"` —— 按**事件序号**取窗口（`read`）。
- `"offset:N"` —— 从 `nextCursor` 续读（任何动作）。`read` 的语义是「已从最新往回看过 N 条」。

### 输出上限

单次结果序列化后 ≤ **20 000 字节**；超出时从尾部裁剪，给 `truncated: true` + `nextCursor`（`offset:N`）。
`read` 里单条消息 > 2000 字会被截断并标记 `textTruncated: true` + `fullChars`（原始字数）。

## 数据来源（按优先级，代码里同样注释）

1. **Host 服务 `sessionQuery`**（可选，用 `ctx.get('sessionQuery')` 拿，没有也能加载）：
   - `listSessions(signal?)` → `SessionRecord[]`
   - `readSession(sessionId)` → `SessionLogSnapshot{session, inheritedEventCount, events}` —— **完整原始日志**
   - `readTitleSnapshots(ids, signal?)` → 标题
   - `listEvents(sessionId)` → 轻量事件记录（用于消息数与最后活动时间）
2. **磁盘回退**：`~/.dsh/sessions/<cwd-slug>/<sessionId>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd`
   该文件是**多帧拼接的 zstd**（实测一例：74 帧 / 727 578 B / 126 事件），`zstd -d` 只会吐出第一条记录。
   本插件按魔数 `28 b5 2f fd` 逐帧贪心解压，再按行解析 `{type, seq, time, data}`。
3. 两者都不可用 → 返回 `{ unavailable: true, reason, tried }`，不抛裸错。

### 刻意不用 `readSurface()`

`readSurface()` 返回的是**模型当前视图**，compaction 会把旧事件替换成 `compaction/summary`，原文在 surface 上会消失。
只有 `readSession()`（完整日志）才拿得到被压缩掉的内容。这一判断借鉴 `dsh-archive-viewer@1.1.5` 的
`docs/INTERNALS.md:44`，见 CREDITS.md。

## 只读保证

- 只调用 `readSession` / `listSessions` / `listEvents` / `readTitleSnapshots` 这类读方法，以及 `node:fs` 的 `readFile` / `open(r)` / `readdir` / `stat`。
- 源码里没有任何 `writeFile` / `unlink` / `rename` / `mkdir` 调用（有机械测试断言，见下）。
- 没有网络调用、没有遥测、没有上报。

## 自测

机械验收（本机真实会话数据 + 服务桩）：

```bash
node _tmp/session-audit-session-plugin-audit/test-reader.mjs   # 磁盘路径 + 服务路径
node _tmp/session-audit-session-plugin-audit/test-edge.mjs     # 20KB 预算 / 截断 / 游标 / id 形态 / 无损 JSON / 无遥测
```

证据与真实返回片段：`_tmp/session-audit-session-plugin-audit/VERIFY.md`。

**PENDING**：真正装进 profile 后的端到端（真机）验证——那一步由 Lead 装载后执行；截至交付，服务路径只在镜像
`sessionQuery` 签名的桩上验证过（方法名、入参、出参形状一致，但未连真实服务）。

# dsh-market · DSH 插件市场索引（自动爬取）

为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的「插件 → 发现」提供一份**自动生成、格式合规**的索引源。

- 主源（GitHub Pages，实测最稳）：`https://jingjiangze.github.io/dsh-market/index.json`
- 品牌域名（Cloudflare Pages）：`https://dsh.jiangjiangze.icu/index.json`
- 两个地址内容同源：都来自本仓库 `site/`，由 CI 生成后提交

## 加进 DSH

「插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源」，两个都加（互为主备）：

```
https://jingjiangze.github.io/dsh-market/index.json
https://dsh.jiangjiangze.icu/index.json
```

> 为什么主源选 GitHub Pages：2026-11-02 本机直连实测 **3/3 成功，0.61–0.81 s**；同一份索引走 Cloudflare Pages 自定义域名时 **3 次里 1 次卡在 25 s 只收到 538 B**、其余 3.8–17.5 s（CF 边缘境内无节点，直连不稳；走代理 2/2 成功 1.9–2.9 s）。DSH 的 fetch 超时是 15 s，所以把 Pages 当人读站点、把 GitHub Pages 当机器源，两边都不丢。

## 它是什么 / 不是什么

- 是：从 **npm 公共源**爬到的、**声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`** 且 `engines.dsh` 满足当前运行时的包的元数据清单（分类、多语言描述、图标直链、精确版本）。
- 不是：不是代码托管，不镜像任何包，不对任何插件背书。装什么、跑什么，以包本身为准。
- 索引里**只有元数据**：`source.type = npm`，安装走你本机 pnpm + 你自己的 registry 配置。

## 爬取与准入（`crawler/crawl.mjs`，零依赖）

```
node crawler/crawl.mjs --selftest     # 门禁自测（正例 + 反例）
node crawler/crawl.mjs                # 爬取并生成 dist/
```

两段式，先便宜后贵：

1. **发现**：`registry.npmjs.org` 关键词检索（`keywords:dsh-plugin`、`keywords:deepseek-harness`、`keywords:dsh`）。
2. **初筛**（每包 1 次 `/<name>/latest`）：必须声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`；不得含 `preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`。
3. **定版**（入选包再取完整 packument）：取**最新稳定版**且满足 `engines.dsh`；未声明 `engines.dsh` 的一律**不收**（不猜"应该能跑"）；发布不足 `MIN_AGE_DAYS`（默认 3 天）的不收（pnpm 的 `minimumReleaseAge` 会扣住它们，写进索引用户也装不上）；许可为空或 `NOASSERTION`/`UNLICENSED` 的不收。

产出：

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `dist/index.json` | format 1 索引（DSH 唯一读的东西） |
| `dist/index.sidecar.json` | format 1 装不下的东西：`dist.integrity`、provenance、体积、生效的门禁 |
| `dist/rejections.json` | 每个被排除的包 + 原因（可复盘，不静默丢） |
| `dist/stats.json` | 候选数 / 初筛数 / 收录数 / 拒绝原因分布 / 索引字节数 / 耗时 |

环境变量：`NPM_REGISTRY`、`SEARCH_REGISTRY`、`DSH_RUNTIME_VERSION`、`MIN_AGE_DAYS`、`MAX_PLUGINS`、`MAX_CANDIDATES`、`CONCURRENCY`、`SEARCH_QUERIES`。

### 已知的爬取坑（踩过）

- **npmmirror 不支持 `keywords:` 语法**：`registry.npmmirror.com/-/v1/search?text=keywords:dsh-plugin` 返回 `total=0`，而 npmjs 返回约 11.9k。所以**发现阶段固定用 npmjs**；manifest 阶段可换镜像加速。
- **不能信 latest**：一个包可能同时有多个兼容版本，`latest` 未必兼容当前运行时，所以定版要读完整 packument。
- **未声明 `engines.dsh` ≠ 兼容**：DSH 的安装侧会用真实包的 `engines` + `peerDependencies` 再判一次，索引里谎报兼容比不收更伤口碑。

## 站点（`site/`）

- 首页第一屏是**索引源卡片**（渐变描边 + 外发光，纯 CSS）：「由 DSH 制作」徽章、**全部 / 国内 / 国际**三个索引源切换、源地址 + 一键复制。
- `index.html` 690 B；`style.css` / `app.js` 为**同源**资源（Pages 直接提供，部署即生效）。第三方图标仍走 jsDelivr 的 npm 直链（npm 版本不可变，不存在缓存问题）。
- 页脚：交流 QQ 1689170897。
- **多语言**：右上角切换 中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어 / Русский；ja/ko/ru 由 CI 里的 Google Translate 生成（`crawler/translate.mjs`，按内容哈希缓存，失败即跳过不发布）。
- 卡片**点击打开详情**：中英对照 + 类别/版本/作者/发布/来源/包名 + 安装命令一键复制；卡片本身不再放「主页」按钮（链接在详情里）。

## 索引源：一个链接就够了

| 索引源 | 内容 | 国内实测 |
|---|---|---|
| **`index.zh.json`** | 全部 1 万余条，中英双语（推荐加这一个） | 4.3 MB，**gzip 后 1.08 MB / 1.8 秒** |
| `index.<lang>.json` | en / ja / ko / ru，同一份目录的其它语言 | 各 4.3–4.8 MB |
| `index.json` | 五语合并文档（站点与工具用，最大） | 11.6 MB，gzip 2.2 MB / 24 秒 |

**关键事实（实测）**：GitHub Pages 对 JSON 走 `Content-Encoding: gzip`，所以 4.3 MB 的文件实际只传 1.08 MB。用不带 `Accept-Encoding` 的 `curl` 测会得到「40–88 秒」的假象。

不建议、也不需要的做法（都验证过不可用）：
- ModelScope 数据集 URL：`/resolve/` 与 API 都 **302 → cdn-lfs-cn-1**，DSH 的加载器拒绝重定向；
- 品牌域 `dsh.jiangjiangze.icu`：国内被限速到约 4 KB/s；
- jsDelivr 镜像：该路径返回 **403**；
- 分片（多链接）：能满足速度，但配置要写 6 条，已撤掉；
- Cloudflare Worker：明确不使用。

## 双语与分类

- 每个插件都有 `{en, zh}` 标题与简介，并被归到一个声明过的类别（9 类：safety / ui / media / integrations / memory / models / automation / devtools / other）。
- 中文来源优先级：**包自带 `locale/zh.json`** → **本仓库 `data/zh-overrides.json`**（可按 `version` 钉版）→ 兜底英文并标 `zh-fallback`（当前 0）。当前 38/38 双语：`zh-native` 13 + `zh-override` 25。
- 标签写明来源（`zh-native` / `zh-override` / `zh-fallback`），数量统计进 `dist/stats.json`。
- 分类规则在 `crawler/crawl.mjs` 的 `CATEGORY_RULES`，**必须带词边界**——裸子串会把 `inspired` 命中 `ide`、把主题插件误判成开发工具。
- 不编造翻译：没有机器翻译，全部来自作者 locale 或仓库内人工整理。
- **不在本机跑任何服务**：爬取、校验、发布都在 GitHub Actions；本地 `node crawler/crawl.mjs --dry-run` 只是一次性脚本。

## CI（三段流水线）

| 工作流 | 触发 | 做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `crawl.yml` | 每 3 小时 + 手动 | 三分片采集 → 合并目录 → 生成多语言/浏览分片/资源 → **离线 + 在线发布门禁** → Git Data API 提交 `main` → 显式触发 `deploy` |
| `ci.yml` | 每次 push / 每个 PR | 门禁自测 → 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` 校验 → 页面预算与引用检查 → registry 回查 → `--dry-run` 冒烟（守住 main 与人工 PR） |
| `deploy.yml` | main 的 `site/**`、`dist/**` 变化，或由 crawl 派发 | 双端发布：GitHub Pages + Cloudflare Pages（`wrangler`） |
| `dependabot.yml` | 每周 | GitHub Actions 版本升级 PR（人工审） |

**发布纪律**：`crawl` 和 `translate` 共用 `catalog-publish` 并发组，避免两个写入者同时基于旧 `main` 创建提交；完整发布门禁在写入 `main` 前执行，push 触发的 `ci` 作为发布后回归检查。

**两个必须知道的 GitHub 行为**（都已在代码里绕过）：

1. **用仓库 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 写入 `main` 不会触发其它 workflow**（防递归）→ 所以 `crawl` 提交后显式 `gh workflow run deploy.yml`，不指望 push 事件。
2. 当前 `crawl` 走 Git Data API 直接写 `main`，不再创建 crawl PR；因此发布门禁必须在写入前执行，不能依赖 push 后才运行的 `ci` 来阻止错误版本上线。


`ci` 里的检查（`crawler/validate.mjs`）：

1. `parseMarketIndex()` —— 与 DSH 运行时同一份校验器，不是自己重写；
2. `site/index.json` 必须与 `dist/index.json` **逐字节一致**（防止发布物与验证物脱节）；
3. `site/index.html` < 1024 B，`style.css` 存在；
4. 页面里不允许出现 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `file://` / 内联图片字体；
5. 每条 plugin 的 `name@version` 在 registry 上真实存在、仍声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，且 `engines.dsh` 与索引里写的一致（防止**索引漂移**——DSH 安装侧会用真实包再判一次兼容性）。

本地复现（不需要网络可加 `--offline`）：

```bash
npm i --no-save @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index@0.2.1-rc.5
node crawler/crawl.mjs --selftest
node crawler/validate.mjs
node crawler/crawl.mjs --dry-run
```


## 已知限制

- **索引没有签名**：format 1 里没有 signature / digest 字段，DSH 不验签。篡改只能靠外部核对 `dist/index.json` 的 sha256（见每次提交与 `stats.json`）。
- **没有 upgrade 流程**：DSH 侧「有新版」只显示 `update-available`，升级 = 卸载 + 重装。
- **索引是单文档全量读**：超过 ~5k 条要考虑拆多源（官方口径：20k 条 ≈ 7.6 MiB，反序列化约 35 ms）。
- **只覆盖 npm**：不发布到 npm 的插件（只在 GitHub 的）暂不收录；后续可加 `source.type=git` + commit 固定。
- **不做安全审计**：门禁只保证「是个能装的 bundle、版本兼容、许可清楚、不跑安装脚本」，不代表代码安全。

## 许可

本仓库的爬虫与站点代码 MIT。索引里的条目版权归各包作者；本仓库只写元数据，不再分发任何包。

# dsh-plugin-custom-profile

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

Your own name and avatar, on the account row at the bottom left. Only what this machine shows changes. The account is not edited, and nothing is uploaded.

> Package: `dsh-plugin-custom-profile` · Plugin id: `plugin-custom-profile`

Change it at **Settings → Profile**.

![How the name and avatar show up](.archify/architecture-plugin-custom-profile-20261104-195425/plugin-custom-profile.en.gif)

## Install

Four ways in. None of them needs a build step. Pick one.

**1. From npm.** The package is published as `dsh-plugin-custom-profile`. In a terminal:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-custom-profile
```

The app's **Settings → Plugins → Install** search lists npm packages once the market index has picked them up. Installing by package name works now.

**2. From GitHub.** No npm involved:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:JonyFang/dsh-plugin-custom-profile
```

**3. From a local checkout.** Clone this repository, then open **Settings → Plugins → Install → Local directory** in the app and select the directory. Or quit the app and run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-custom-profile
```

**4. By hand.** Symlink this directory into the profile's `node_modules`, then append this to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: plugin-custom-profile
      name: dsh-plugin-custom-profile
```

`desktop` is the profile name, so change it for another profile. Restart the app if **Profile** does not appear.

## Use

![Profile saved with a custom avatar and the name Jony. The account row at the bottom left shows the same.](docs/use-en.png)

Set a name and an avatar, then **Save**. An empty name keeps the account name. **Reset**, then **Save**, puts the account name and avatar back. **Cancel** drops unsaved edits.

PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, or AVIF, up to 10 MB. Cropped to a square and stored as 128×128 WebP, or PNG if that fails. A GIF stays a single frame. Names are at most 32 characters.

## Also

- Signed out, the row is left alone. A collapsed sidebar gets the avatar only.
- The custom row follows this device, not the account. Clearing site data or changing devices removes it.
- Do not run another plugin that paints the same row. This one will not import that plugin's saved values.
- Written against client `0.2.2-rc.1`. If the account-row markup changes, the plugin stops painting instead of breaking the page.

## Development

Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. `npm test` runs 59 tests. `lib/index.js` does nothing. `lib/client.js` is the browser bundle. A daily GitHub Action watches the [Harness page](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). A newer client opens an issue for the `dsh-compat` agent.

## License

MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-pocket-ios（DSH 插件） 在 DSH 的**设置 → 手机访问**里加入 iOS 客户端下载二维码与连接引导，把「手机访问」和 [DSH Pocket iOS](https://github.com/jqlong17/dsh-pocket-ios) 串起来。 当前版本：**0.1.3**（npm `dsh-pocket-ios`）。卡片主按钮与二维码指向 **App Store**（）， 并保留「GitHub Release（自签）」与「直接下载 IPA」作为备用渠道。 ## 它做什么 - 设置页新增「iOS 客户端」入口（`settings.section` 插槽，原生渲染）； - 在「手机访问」页的**局域网访问上方**尽力插入一张 iOS 卡片：App Store 下载二维码 + App Store / GitHub Release / IPA 三个入口（DOM 注入，插入失败不影响上面的原生入口）； - `dependencies` 带 `dsh-pocket`，安装本插件会一并安装手机访问所需的 dsh-pocket。 ## 安装 ```bash # 从 npm 安装（会自动带上依赖 dsh-pocket） dsh plugin add dsh-pocket-ios ``` npm: 安装后重启 DSH（或按提示重启），打开 **设置 → 手机访问** 即可看到 iOS 入口。 > 为什么依赖 dsh-pocket 而不是复制它的 patch：复制上游 patch 会在上游变更时失真，且用户 > 单独安装 dsh-pocket 时会产生重复插件行；依赖 + 官方安装命令更稳。 ## 手机端 iOS App 已上架 App Store（免费）： 没有 App Store 的地区仍可从 [GitHub Release](https://github.com/jqlong17/dsh-pocket-ios/releases) 下载 IPA 自签安装。装好后在 App 里扫描 dsh-pocket 的二维码即可连接本机 DSH。 ## 许可 GPL-2.0（与上游 dsh-pocket 一致），见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 注意：本仓库根目录的 `LICENSE`（MIT）只覆盖 `DSHPocket/` iOS 客户端，不覆盖本插件目录。 # DSH Pocket iOS 把 **DeepSeek Harness** 装进口袋 —— 一个原生 SwiftUI 的 iOS 客户端。 > 本项目是 [shaobeichen/dsh-pocket](https://github.com/shaobeichen/dsh-pocket) 的 **iOS 原生版本**。 > dsh-pocket 让手机通过浏览器访问电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness；我们沿用它的连接协议与思路， > 用 SwiftUI 重写了移动端体验：手机可以通过**局域网**或**公网隧道**连回自己的电脑， > 查看会话、收发消息，随时继续电脑上的 AI 编程。

     

会话列表 · 对话详情 · 连接电脑上的 DSH

## 这是什么 DSH Pocket iOS 让你用 iPhone 直接操作电脑里的 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**： - 电脑上跑项目、跑测试，手机上看进度、发指令、收结果； - 通勤、外出、躺在床上，AI 都在继续干活； - 和电脑端共享同一份会话与历史，消息**约 1 秒**内实时出现； - 会话列表的可见性与 DSH 桌面端一致：已归档、subagent 子会话、空会话都不会显示。 它不是网页套壳，而是原生 SwiftUI App：原生导航、系统键盘与安全区、可复制的诊断记录。 ## 功能 - 🔌 **两种连接方式**：局域网 `http://<电脑IP>:<端口>`（dsh-pocket 默认 **3081**，可在其 `settings.json` 的 `proxyPort` 改成别的端口），或 dsh-pocket 生成的公网隧道（HTTPS）；**扫码会自动填入地址和端口**，不需要自己记。 - 🔑 **PIN 登录**：走 dsh-pocket 的 `/pocket-login` 协议；登录态用 cookie 保持，**PIN 不会保存在手机上**。登录失效时回到连接页，重新输入即可。 - 📋 **会话列表**：与桌面端同样的可见性规则，下拉或回到前台自动刷新。 - 💬 **历史 + 实时**：进入会话直接定位到底部（无滚动动画），历史快照之后由 `session/follow` WebSocket 实时推送增量消息。 - ✍️ **发送消息**：本地即时回显 → 服务端确认 → 实时/轮询收到回复；失败自动恢复输入。 - 🧭 **过程时间线**：每轮的工具调用折叠成一行「过程 · N 步 · 执行了命令、查看了图片」，点开看细节；助手工作时顶部显示「深度求索中 · 已用 X 秒」。 - 🖼 **图片**：对话内直接显示缩略图——你发送的图片、助手工具读取的截图都能看；支持从相册选图或拍照发送。 - 📝 **Markdown 渲染**：保留换行，列表、代码块、标题、加粗、行内代码都能正确显示。 - 🔁 **断线重连**：实时流中断后指数退避重连，会话页顶部显示连接状态。 - 🩺 **诊断**：会话页可一键复制连接、收帧、渲染的时间线，便于排查问题。 - 🎬 **演示模式**：连接页可进入内置示例（会话、对话、过程、图片），没有电脑也能体验界面；演示数据不联网。 ## 工作原理 依赖电脑端已安装并启用 [`dsh-pocket`](https://github.com/shaobeichen/dsh-pocket) 插件。它把 DSH 反代到局域网（默认监听 **3081**，端口可在插件 `settings.json` 的 `proxyPort` 里改），并负责 PIN 登录与公网隧道。 | 环节 | 实现 | | --- | --- | | 登录 | `POST /pocket-login`（表单 `token=`）。正确 → `302` + `dsh_pocket_token` cookie；错误 → `200` 登录页 | | 会话列表 | `POST /api/session/list`，`type: "client-request"` RPC | | 历史分页 | `POST /api/session/page`，取 `records` | | 实时消息 | `WebSocket /api/remote.mux`，`open` 一个 `session/follow` 流；帧为 `{type:"item", streamId, value}`，`value` 是 `snapshot` 或 `event` | | 归档状态 | `workspace/follow` 首帧 baseline 的 `archivedSessionIds`（旧版服务端回退路径） | | 发送 | `POST /api/session/prompt` | > 一个容易踩的坑：`URLComponents.url` 在 path 不以 `/` 开头时会返回 `nil`，而 `appendingPathComponent("api/remote.mux")` 对空 path 恰好拼出 `"api/remote.mux"`——曾导致实时流静默不启动。代码里已用 `webSocketURL(from:path:)` 显式补斜杠。 ## 环境要求 - iPhone，**App Store 版 iOS 17.0+；最新源码 iOS 18.0+** - 电脑上运行 DeepSeek Harness，并安装启用 `dsh-pocket` 插件 - 构建：Xcode（Swift 5.9+），已在本机 iPhone 17 Pro / iOS 26.3 真机验证 ## 安装 **方式 A（推荐，App Store）**：在 App Store 搜索「DSH Pocket」或打开 下载安装（免费）。 **方式 B（GitHub Release + 自签）**：从 [Releases](https://github.com/jqlong17/dsh-pocket-ios/releases) 下载 [DSHPocket.ipa](https://github.com/jqlong17/dsh-pocket-ios/releases/latest/download/DSHPocket.ipa)， 用 [AltStore](https://altstore.io/)、[Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io/) 等工具自签安装。 免费 Apple ID 签名 7 天有效，开发者账号（$99/年）签名一年有效，到期重签即可。 **方式 C（开发者）**：下载源码，用 Xcode 打开 `DSHPocket.xcodeproj`，选择自己的 Team 与 Bundle ID 后运行到 iPhone。 > 自签 IPA 是开发签名包；自签工具会用你的证书重签后再安装。 > 没有 App Store 的地区（如部分账号区）仍可用自签方式安装。 ## 构建与运行 1. 用 Xcode 打开 `DSHPocket.xcodeproj`； 2. 在 Signing & Capabilities 里选择你自己的 Team，并按需修改 Bundle Identifier； 3. 选择已连接的 iPhone 运行。 命令行构建（真机）： ```bash xcodebuild -project DSHPocket.xcodeproj -scheme DSHPocket -configuration Debug \ -destination 'id=<你的设备 UDID>' \ -derivedDataPath /tmp/dsh-pocket-ios-derived \ DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=<你的 Team ID> CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic build ``` ## 自测入口（仅 Debug） Debug 构建支持通过环境变量自动连接，方便在模拟器/真机上做回归： ```bash SIMCTL_CHILD_DSH_SERVER='http://192.168.1.10:3081' \ SIMCTL_CHILD_DSH_PIN='' \ SIMCTL_CHILD_DSH_OPEN='session-xxxx' \ SIMCTL_CHILD_DSH_SEND='你好' \ xcrun simctl launch --terminate-running-process com.ruska.dsh-pocket-ios ``` - `DSH_SERVER` / `DSH_PIN`：自动登录 - `DSH_OPEN`：连接后自动打开指定会话 - `DSH_SEND`：进入会话后自动发送一条消息 - `DSH_CONNECT=1`：停留在连接页（用于截图/排查） 诊断记录同时写入沙盒 `Documents/diagnostics.log`，真机可用 `xcrun devicectl device copy from` 拉取。 ## 项目结构 ``` DSHPocket/ └── DSHPocketApp.swift # 连接模型、RPC/WebSocket、消息解析、全部视图（SwiftUI） DSHPocket.xcodeproj # Xcode 工程 Info.plist # 本地网络权限、ATS 局域网例外 docs/screenshots/ # README 截图 ``` ## 配套 DSH 插件（可选） 仓库里的 [`plugin/`](plugin/) 是一个 DSH 插件 `dsh-pocket-ios`：在 **设置 → 手机访问** 里加入 iOS 客户端下载二维码与连接引导，并依赖 `dsh-pocket`（一条命令装齐电脑端）。 ```bash # 已发布到 npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pocket-ios dsh plugin add dsh-pocket-ios ``` 安装后打开 **设置 → 手机访问**，即可看到 iOS 客户端下载二维码与安装引导。 详见 [plugin/README.md](plugin/README.md)。 ## 已知限制 - 文本与图片已支持；工具执行细节以折叠的"过程"行呈现，审批卡片等更复杂的富内容尚未接入。 - 不保存 PIN；服务器重启导致 cookie 失效时需要重新输入 PIN。 - 旧版 DSH 桌面端不支持 `session/list` 的 `excludeArchived` 参数，iOS 会回退到 `workspace/follow` 拉取归档列表再本地过滤。 ## 版本 当前版本 **0.0.1**（首个公开版本）。 ## 隐私与支持 - 隐私政策： - 支持页： - App 不收集任何数据、不运营服务器；详见隐私政策。 ## 许可证与独立实现声明 本项目**按目录使用不同许可证**： | 目录 / 产物 | 许可证 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `DSHPocket/`（iOS App） | **MIT**，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) | 独立 Swift 实现，可分发到 App Store | | `plugin/`（DSH 插件 `dsh-pocket-ios`） | **GPL-2.0**，见 [plugin/LICENSE](plugin/LICENSE) | 与上游 dsh-pocket 生态一致 | **iOS 客户端是独立实现**：它依据 DeepSeek Harness / dsh-pocket 公开可观察的 HTTP、WebSocket 协议与行为编写，没有复制或翻译上游源代码；协议端点、字段、帧格式属于接口事实，不构成版权表达。 完整声明见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。 ## 致谢 - 协议与设备接入思路来自 [shaobeichen/dsh-pocket](https://github.com/shaobeichen/dsh-pocket)（GPL-2.0）； - 上游 DSH 为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)； - "DeepSeek Harness"、"DeepSeek"、"dsh-pocket" 等名称归各自权利人所有。 本项目为非官方客户端，与 DeepSeek Harness、dsh-pocket 的维护者无隶属关系。

# dsh-butler-panel · 大管家面板

> ### 这是什么
> **一页看清"今天该看什么"的面板**：在 DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏挂一个「大管家」，把看板在途卡、重启后被打断的会话、最近的变更流水、记忆条数、健康水位、待处理告警，拼成一块首屏。
> 它原本是一个长期自动运维的管家身上天天被打开的那一屏，现在把**这一屏**单独拿出来开源。
>
> ### 它解决什么
> 程序自己跑起来之后，真正的麻烦不是"跑得慢"，是**没人知道它此刻在干什么、卡在哪、要不要人接手**。
> 这块面板的取舍就三条：
> 1. **只读优先**：绝大多数卡片只是把权威状态**照原样读出来**，判定一律不在这里算——面板自己算一套，就会和命令行查出两个答案。
> 2. **缺数据就说缺**：读不到就显示「不可探测」并写原因，**绝不用 0 冒充"没有数据"**。
> 3. **能关**：每个模块都有开关，关掉就是真关（改动带"谁改的、为什么"）。
>
> ### 一条命令跑起来
> 先确认你的 DSH 能装上插件（需要 `pnpm`），然后：
> ```powershell
> npm i @kira905/dsh-butler-panel
> # 或者装进某个 profile 后重启 dsh，侧边栏底部会多一个「大管家」入口
> ```
> 装完**先设一个变量**告诉它你的大管家在哪（见下一节）——不设也能起来，但大部分卡片会显示「不可用」。

> ### 它不附带什么（先看清楚，省得装完失望）
>
> 1. **它自己要读的那套工具目录**。本仓只有**面板本身**；看板判据、告警判定、日报生成器、角色与人设、通知通道都在别处。没有那套目录，面板能启动、但只剩空壳。
> 2. **调度内核**（定时、锁、放行矩阵）。那是另一个包 `@kira905/dsh-butler-engine`。
> 3. **任何"喊到人"的通道**：企业微信、微信、语音播报这类绑定具体账号与私人日程的，**不随开源发布**。
> 4. **视觉回归的基线图**。仓里留下采集与比对脚本，但一张图都没带——那些截图是面板当天的真实画面，印着主线名、本机路径、会话 id。你自己跑一次就有了。
>
> 所以你装到的是一块**仪表盘**，不是一个会自己上班的管家。

## 接上你自己的大管家

面板找库**分四路，前命中即用**：

| 路 | 来源 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| ① | `BUTLER_ROOT` / `DSH_BUTLER_LIB_DIR`（还认 `BUTLER_LIB_DIR`） | 你显式指了就以你指的为准，优先级最高 |
| ② | `<工作区>/tools/dsh-butler/lib` | 工作区约定位置（`DSH_WORKSPACE` 不设时 = `<用户主目录>/DSH`） |
| ③ | **已安装的 `@kira905/dsh-butler-engine` 包** | 依次试包内 `lib/` → `src/dsh-butler/lib/` → `src/lib/` → `jobs/lib/`。定位包根按「显式 env `DSH_BUTLER_ENGINE_ROOT` → Node 模块解析 → 全局 npm 前缀」三档走 |
| ④ | 都落空 | 占位 + 一行**可照做**的指引（见下） |

为什么要第 ③ 路：不是每台机器都有「大管家工具目录」——那本来是自己工作区里的东西。
但 `@kira905/dsh-butler-engine` 是**能装的包**，装上就有同一批库。于是最省事的接法变成：

```powershell
npm i -g @kira905/dsh-butler-engine
```

环境变量仍然有用（放在最前面，压过包）：

| 变量 | 含义 | 不设时 |
|---|---|---|
| `BUTLER_ROOT` | 大管家工具根（即 `<工作区>/tools/dsh-butler`） | `<工作区>/tools/dsh-butler` |
| `DSH_WORKSPACE` | DSH 工作区根（`tools/` 与 `docs/` 所在那层） | `<用户主目录>/DSH` |
| `DSH_HOME` / `BUTLER_DSH_HOME` | DSH 数据根（会话、看板账本、状态文件） | `~/.dsh` |
| `DSH_BUTLER_LIB_DIR` | 只覆盖"共享库目录"这一项 | 跟随 `BUTLER_ROOT` |
| `DSH_BUTLER_ENGINE_ROOT` | 直接点名 engine 包根（装了但找不到时的逃生口） | 自动探测 |

```powershell
# 例：工具目录放在你自己的某个工作区下
$env:DSH_WORKSPACE = '<你的工作区>'
```

**接不上会怎样**：面板不会崩。缺的那几段退化成「不可用」，并在控制台留一行**告诉你怎么补**：

```
[butler-panel] 缺 store.mjs：装 npm i -g @kira905/dsh-butler-engine@^0.5.0，或设 BUTLER_ROOT=<你的大管家工具目录>
```

（那行里的版本号是读**装在盘上的包**得来的，不是写死的；包完全没装时就不带版本号。）
这样设计是因为插件是整棵加载的 —— 任一模块顶层 `import` 失败会把整个插件树拖死、
连带 `dsh web` 起不来，那比"少显示一段"严重得多。

## 它挂在哪里

- **宿主侧**（`exports["."]` → `lib/index.js`）：起 HTTP 端点 `GET /api/dsh-butler/state`，
  按 `?parts=` 分片返回；面板**从不调用大模型**，建议文案只从已有报告里读。
- **浏览器侧**（`exports["./client"]` → `lib/client.js`）：在侧边栏底部区渲染那块面板。
- 声明在 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch`），装包后由宿主自动挂载。

## P5 写入守门人（可选，默认跟随配置）

面板另带一道**写入前闸**：`fs/write-intent` + `fs/edit-intent` + `tools/pre-execute` 三个前置钩子，
按"一次性凭证"判定这次写入是否被授权，写前备份、写后审计、违规可回滚。

**诚实边界**（别当成安全边界用）：
- 它只覆盖 DSH 的 `write` / `edit` 工具。`pwsh` 里手写文件、或 `node fs.writeFileSync` 完全绕过。
- 它是**防手滑 + 事后可追**，**不防**本机恶意进程。
- 守门人挂不上时策略是 **fail-open + 告警**（拦死比放过一次更糟）——但必须让你知道"它不在岗"。

## 视觉回归（自己采基线）

`_test/visual-baseline/` 里是五个脚本，**不含任何图片**：

| 脚本 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| `static-render.mjs` | 离线把面板渲染成固定样例的静态页（不需要真宿主） |
| `visual-baseline-capture.mjs` | 连真宿主抓整页（需要 `bsk` 浏览器工具） |
| `visual-diff.mjs` | 两张图做像素差 |
| `allow-list-lint.mjs` | 校验"允许差异清单"与逐色对账 |
| `proof-red.mjs` | 反向证明：故意改坏一处，判据必须变红 |

```powershell
node _test/visual-baseline/static-render.mjs --out .tmp\baseline --theme dark
```
`static-render.mjs` 默认按仓库布局找 `lib/client.js`；要渲别的版本用 `--butler <path>`。
生态面板那半默认找相邻目录的 `dsh-ecosystem-panel`，也可以用 `--eco <path>` 指定。

## 环境要求

- Node ≥ 18.17（用到顶层 `await` 与 `node:` 前缀导入）
- DeepSeek Harness ≥ 0.1.1-rc.1
- 浏览器侧依赖 `dsh-host-adapter-client`：本包用 npm alias 声明成依赖
  （`npm:@kira905/dsh-host-adapter-client`），装包时会一起带上。

## 许可

AGPL-3.0-only。见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

# dsh-nextsteps

English · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-nextsteps)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-nextsteps) [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/klaus-2/dsh-nextsteps)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-e5484d)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

**Every finished agent turn ends with ready-to-click next steps.**

`dsh-nextsteps` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that prompts the model to suggest about three followup prompts at the end of every turn, renders them as clickable cards under the completed turn, and sends the clicked prompt as your next message — one click, zero typing.

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-nextsteps
```

## Product tour

![Nextsteps demo loop](docs/assets/demo.svg)

1. Ask anything. The model works, answers, and calls the native `suggest_followups` tool right before its final answer.
2. The completed turn renders its own suggestion cards — attributed to that turn, never repeated across messages.
3. Click a card: the prompt is sent verbatim as your next queued message and the card flips to a sent state.
4. Everything survives restarts: cards, their turn attribution, and which ones you already clicked.
5. Open the dsh settings → **Nextsteps** to pick the generation language (15 languages or Auto), how many suggestions you get per turn (1–6), and whether the small header shows.

## Features

- Per-turn attribution — suggestions stay attached to the turn that produced them, across reloads and app restarts.
- One-click send through the session's own conversation controller, with a composer fallback.
- Persistent captures: clicked cards stay marked after restarts (content-addressed keys, turn backfilled from history).
- Model-supplied labels, with automatic truncation when absent; strict payload validation with corrective model feedback.
- Settings page inside the dsh settings — language, followups per turn, header visibility, updates.
- Followups generated in the selected language — 15 languages or Auto, which follows the conversation.
- In-app updater — version check, one-click install, release notes, restart prompt.
- UI in English, Português (Brasil) and 简体中文.

## Settings

Open the dsh settings and find the **Nextsteps** section:

| Setting | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Language | The language the model writes followups in. `Auto` follows the conversation. |
| Followups per turn | How many suggested prompts the model produces (1–6). |
| Show header | The small label above the cards. |

## Updates

The same settings page checks GitHub for new releases. When a newer version is published on npm, **Update now** installs it through the dsh plugin manager and asks you to restart. Updates only ever install the `dsh-nextsteps` npm package — a renamed or development copy is detected and left alone.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (desktop, web profile).
- Node.js 20+.
