evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-prompt-weaver

A framework-aware prompt enhancement plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It rewrites a composer draft into a clearer, executable prompt while checking that slash commands, file references, URLs, versions, constraints, and the draft language are preserved.

It is designed to work as a DSH Web bundle and as a zero-dependency offline CLI. The plugin is independent software and is not affiliated with DeepSeek, Claude, or WorkBuddy.

## Highlights

- **Mixed drafts are supported.** `/command`, `@file`, `src/app.ts`, URLs, and versions are detected as protected items. Only a bare slash command is rejected.
- **Original-intent gate.** The engine rejects an enhanced prompt if it loses a protected item, an original constraint, or the draft language.
- **No unverified assumptions.** Model output that declares assumptions is rejected instead of silently replacing the draft.
- **Framework library.** Built-in general, concise, engineering, debugging, review, testing, research, and writing frameworks; custom frameworks can be imported, exported, and selected.
- **Context awareness with budgets.** The Host can sample project files and recent user messages under strict byte, file, depth, and message limits.
- **Privacy by default.** Secrets are redacted in context, high-confidence secrets in drafts block enhancement, assistant messages are excluded unless explicitly enabled, and nothing is auto-sent or persisted by the plugin.
- **Quality reporting.** Deterministic heuristic scores and before/after comparison metrics are exposed to the UI. They measure preservation and structure, not a promise of model performance.
- **Iteration and comparison.** Feedback becomes a constraint for the next round; the panel keeps a small in-memory undo stack and can show a unified diff.
- **Zero runtime dependencies.** The Host, Web client, core engine, and CLI run without installing third-party packages.

## Improvements over the original bundle

Compared with the public `dsh-prompt-enhance` bundle used as a compatibility reference, this project adds:

- **Mixed-draft handling.** Slash commands are no longer a blanket rejection. They are preserved as protected items, and attachments are counted/preserved instead of blocking enhancement.
- **A customizable framework system**, including validation, conflict policies, import/export, optional persistence, and task-type selection.
- **An original-intent gate**, including protected-item, constraint, language, invented-reference, and length checks before a draft is replaced.
- **Assumptions surfaced, not swallowed** — `standard` returns them with the result, `strict` refuses them.
- **Deterministic quality metrics**, before/after comparison, diff summary, and bounded multi-round feedback.
- **More explicit privacy controls**, including sensitive-draft blocking, context redaction, metadata-only results, and no enhancement-history persistence.
- **A zero-dependency CLI** for offline enhancement, comparison, framework/config management, and reproducible test workflows.
- **Publishable project hygiene**: schemas, examples, compatibility documentation, security policy, CI, release workflow, and 52 automated tests.

This is not a claim that one model or prompt style is universally superior. The plugin's quality metrics measure preservation and structure; actual enhancement quality still depends on the selected model and context.

## Status

- Core engine, Host service, Web composer control, CLI, examples, and 83 automated tests are included.
- The original-intent gate, mixed-draft parser, framework store, config import/export, privacy handling, context collector, and Host/LLM integration are covered by tests.
- Compatibility was implemented against the public plugin API shape used by existing DSH bundles and the official Web input contract (`draft`, `phase`, `occurrences`, `attachmentIds`). It has **not** yet been smoke-tested against a live DSH release; see [docs/compatibility.md](docs/compatibility.md).

## Requirements

- Node.js `>=22.19.0`
- DeepSeek Harness with a Web profile for the composer plugin
- A configured model route for model-backed enhancement

The CLI does not call a model; it uses a deterministic local provider and never scans the filesystem implicitly.

## Install into DSH

Clone the repository, then install the bundle through DSH's plugin manager rather than editing profile files by hand:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Knowledgeseekerch/dsh-prompt-weaver.git
cd dsh-prompt-weaver
npm run check
npm test
```

In DSH Web, use `install_bundle` with the absolute path of the cloned directory. For repeatable installs, pin a commit:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Knowledgeseekerch/dsh-prompt-weaver#v0.2.4
```

Refresh the Web client. The sparkle button appears in the composer tool row. It does not send messages, listen for keystrokes, or modify project files.

## Use in the composer

1. Enter a normal prompt, a slash command with arguments, a file reference, or any mix of them.
2. Open Prompt Weaver.
3. Choose a mode and framework.
4. Enhance, inspect open questions and quality metrics, edit if needed, then replace the draft.
5. Send the draft yourself.

Example mixed draft:

```text
/prompt 请阅读 @src/app.ts 和 https://example.com/spec ，在 Node.js 22.19 下修复登录问题。不要引入新的依赖，只能修改 src/login.ts。
```

Prompt Weaver preserves the slash command, file reference, URL, version, and constraints. Attachments remain attached, but their bytes are not read by the enhancement request.

## Use the CLI

```bash
# Deterministic offline enhancement
node bin/dsh-prompt-weaver.js enhance --input examples/input/basic.txt

# With an explicit, user-provided JSON context
node bin/dsh-prompt-weaver.js enhance \
  --input examples/input/mixed.txt \
  --context examples/context/workspace.json \
  --json

# Framework management
node bin/dsh-prompt-weaver.js frameworks validate examples/frameworks
node bin/dsh-prompt-weaver.js frameworks export --frameworks examples/frameworks/store.json

# Configuration import/export and prompt comparison
node bin/dsh-prompt-weaver.js config export --config examples/config/dsh-prompt-weaver.config.json
node bin/dsh-prompt-weaver.js compare examples/input/basic.txt examples/input/basic.txt
```

The CLI reports failures without echoing detected secrets. It writes files only when `--output`, an import, or an export is requested.

## Configuration

Host configuration lives in the bundle's `cordis.patch.yml`. All fields are validated; unknown fields fail loudly. Key defaults:

| Setting | Default | Purpose |
|---|---:|---|
| `mode` | `standard` | `minimal`, `standard`, or `strict` |
| `defaultFramework` | `auto` | `auto` or a framework ID |
| `maxDraftChars` | `20000` | Draft length limit |
| `maxResultChars` | `40000` | Enhanced result limit |
| `timeoutMs` | `45000` | Model request timeout |
| `maxIterations` | `5` | Iteration rounds per enhancement |
| `includeAssistantMessages` | `false` | Include assistant replies in conversation context |
| `context.maxFiles` | `10` | Maximum project files sampled |
| `context.maxTotalBytes` | `98304` | Total file/tree/conversation budget |
| `privacy.redactSecrets` | `true` | Redact secrets before context leaves the Host |
| `privacy.blockSensitiveDraft` | `true` | Reject drafts containing high-confidence credentials |
| `persistFrameworks` | `false` | Persist imported frameworks to `frameworksFile` |

See [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md) and [schemas/config.schema.json](schemas/config.schema.json).

## Security and privacy

- The plugin never writes to the session log, submits a message, or modifies project files.
- Project indexing is bounded and skips common dependency/build/cache directories, binary content, and sensitive filenames such as `.env`, private keys, certificates, and credential files.
- Context is redacted before it is passed to the model provider.
- Drafts with high-confidence secrets are blocked by default; turn off `privacy.blockSensitiveDraft` only if you understand the provider will receive them.
- Export bundles contain preferences and custom frameworks only. They do not contain drafts, project content, session history, model credentials, or provider routes.
- The plugin stores no enhancement history. The Web panel keeps a small undo stack in component memory only.

Read [docs/security-and-privacy.md](docs/security-and-privacy.md) before changing context limits.

## Development

```bash
npm run check
npm run lint
npm test
npm run test:coverage
npm run cli:smoke
npm run frameworks:validate
npm run pack:dry-run
```

Tests use Node's built-in test runner. The Host integration test uses in-memory service doubles for `ctx.llm`, `ctx.fs`, `workingDirectory`, `agentDefaultModel`, and `typert`, so no API key is needed.

## Project layout

```text
.
├── index.js                 DSH Host plugin entry
├── client.js                Web composer control
├── src/core/                Engine, frameworks, analysis, quality, privacy, context, providers
├── src/host/                Host service and Typert descriptor
├── bin/                     Offline CLI
├── schemas/                 JSON schemas
├── examples/                Configs, frameworks, mixed inputs, explicit context
├── tests/                   Node built-in test suite
└── docs/                    Architecture, compatibility, privacy, configuration, release
```

## License

Apache-2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

# dsh-mcp-kychnet KychNet 站点的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：安装后把 `https://kych.net/mcp` 登记为 MCP 服务， 由 [`dsh-mcp-oauth-client`](https://github.com/fangzaozao/dsh-mcp-oauth-client) 负责 OAuth 2.1 授权（401 发现 → 动态注册 → 授权码 + PKCE → 刷新令牌），首次调用时在浏览器里 用 KychNet 账号确认授权即可。 插件本身是纯配置 bundle：不含 Host/Client 代码，不保存凭据，也不发送静态 `Authorization` 头。 ## 前置条件 - DSH 版本支持 bundle patch 与 Web 客户端扩展。 - 已安装 `dsh-mcp-oauth-client`（`>= 0.3.0`）。本插件通过 `peerDependencies` 声明该依赖， 由 profile 提供同一份实例，避免同一个 MCP 客户端被装成两份。 ## 安装 本地目录安装（开发时）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile add /absolute/path/to/plugins/dsh-mcp-kychnet ``` 或从插件市场 / npm 安装（发布后）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-mcp-kychnet ``` 安装后在「设置 → 插件」里应看到 **KychNet 站点**，在「设置 → MCP」里应看到 `mcp-kychnet` 这一条已连接的服务。 ## 首次授权 第一次调用任一 `mcp__kych-net__*` 工具时，客户端会收到 401 并按资源元数据自动完成发现与 动态注册，然后打开 KychNet 授权页。用现有账号登录、确认四项权限即可： | 权限 | 覆盖的工具 | | --- | --- | | `content:read` | `list_pages`、`get_page`、`search_content`、`site_info` | | `content:write` | `save_content`、`delete_content` | | `project:read` | `list_projects`、`list_project_files`、`read_project_file` | | `project:write` | `write_project_file`、`delete_project_file` | access token 一小时过期，refresh token 最长 30 天；令牌只保存在插件进程内存中，不写入 profile。站点侧撤销全部授权见仓库 README 的「撤销授权」一节。 ## 工具 安装后工具以 `mcp__kych-net__` 出现，与 README「MCP 服务器 → 工具」一节列出的 `list_pages`、`get_page`、`search_content`、`site_info`、`save_content`、`delete_content`、 `list_projects`、`list_project_files`、`read_project_file`、`write_project_file`、 `delete_project_file` 一一对应。 ## 配置 需要换资源地址（例如指向自建实例）时，覆盖 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那一行的 `config.resourceUrl`；`scope` 也可按需收窄，例如只读场景： ```yaml - insert: - id: mcp-kychnet name: dsh-mcp-oauth-client config: entryId: mcp-kychnet manager: false serverName: kych-net transport: streamable-http resourceUrl: https://kych.net/mcp authType: oauth scope: content:read project:read ``` 注意 `resourceUrl` 必须是站点 README 里给出的公网地址 `https://kych.net/mcp`； `api.kych.net` 只是回源 Host，不是客户端地址。 ## 故障排查 - `401`：尚未完成授权或 access token 过期，客户端会自行刷新；浏览器没弹出授权页时， 在「设置 → MCP」里对该条目执行重新连接。 - `403`：请求的 `Host` 不是 `kych.net` / localhost，常见于反向代理没透传 Host。 - 工具名重复：profile 里如果还留着旧的手写 `kych-net` MCP 条目，会与本插件重复连接同一 服务。删掉旧条目，只保留 `mcp-kychnet` 这一条。 ## 开发与校验 ```sh # 校验 patch 与语言资源 node -e "require('js-yaml').load(require('fs').readFileSync('cordis.patch.yml','utf8'))" node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('locale/zh.json','utf8'))" ``` 安装后重新组合 profile 检查： ```sh dsh --profile --dump-config ``` ## 许可证 与 KychNet 仓库一致：AGPL-3.0-or-later。 # KychNet 新版个人网站。 ## 架构 前后端分离,后端使用最高性能的方式. 前端分为内容前端和管理前端: - 内容前端是纯静态站,由后端编译输出 html,通过 EdgeOne 发布. - 管理前端是 React SPA,通过 EdgeOne Pages 发布,以 JSON API 读写内容. 后端为单一二进制 `kych-net`,同时提供 HTTP 服务、Git smart HTTP、MCP 和命令行管理能力,共用同一套 service 层.中英文命令行是同一个二进制的两个入口:中文命令先被翻译成英文参数,再交给同一个 clap 解析器. ## 域名与入口 | 地址 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `kych.net` | 公网 API:`/api/*`、`/git/*`、`/mcp`;裸域其余路径 301 到内容站 | | `api.kych.net` | **仅 EdgeOne 回源 Host / 静态源站**,不是给客户端使用的 API 地址 | | `c.kych.net` | 内容站公开入口,EdgeOne 加速回源 | | `m.kych.net` | 管理端,EdgeOne Pages | | `origin.kych.net`、`src.kych.net` | 静态源站/实验入口,不作为 API 地址 | 管理端的 `VITE_API_BASE_URL` 必须是 `https://kych.net`,不能写 `api.kych.net`. ## 内容格式 每篇内容在数据库中记录一种主格式: | 格式 | 渲染方式 | | --- | --- | | markdown | pulldown-cmark,保留 raw HTML 透传 | | html | 原样注入模板,不做转义与过滤 | | typst | typst 编译为 HTML,并同时输出 PDF 供下载 | | wikidot | ftml 解析 Wikidot 语法并渲染 HTML,支持 `[[include]]`;项目因此按 AGPL-3.0 分发 | | css | 原样写入 `/css/*.css`,供页面显式引用 | 这些格式均不做内容限制,内容作者均为邀请注册的可信用户,因此允许存储型 XSS 是项目明确的取舍. 内容不保存单独的标题字段:页面标题直接在正文里写,例如 HTML 的 `

…

`、Markdown 的 `# …`、Wikidot 的 `+ …`、Typst 的 `= …`.页面 ``、目录树、首页回退列表、API/MCP 的展示名统一使用源文件名. 必须注意:**子域隔离本身并不能阻止攻击**。`c`(内容站) / `m`(管理端) / `kych.net`(API) 同属一个 eTLD+1(同站),`SameSite` Cookie 不会阻止同站跨源请求,CORS 也只阻止读取响应、不阻止带凭据的写请求被发出。因此后端对所有写接口增加了 Origin 白名单校验(仅放行管理端 origin),挡住内容站 XSS 冒用管理员会话发起写操作。这层防护仍以「内容作者可信」为前提;若要允许不可信作者,需要让 `api` 使用完全独立的站点(不同 eTLD+1)并对内容页加 CSP,而不是只靠子域划分。 ## 界面 - 内容端顶栏:左侧站点图标,图标右侧为目录树按钮,中间为可编辑导航链接(管理端「站点设置」维护),右侧为主题切换与管理端入口. - 管理端顶栏:左侧站点图标,图标右侧为目录树按钮,中间为功能导航(内容/邀请码/用户/站点设置),右侧为头像菜单(用户设置/网站管理/前往内容端)与主题切换. - 两端共用浅色、深色两套主题,基于 CSS 变量实现,选择持久化在 localStorage. - 内容站正文使用自托管的 `LXGW WenKai Screen`;管理端编辑器使用 CodeMirror 6,按格式高亮. - 管理端 Markdown/HTML 预览在浏览器端渲染,Wikidot 预览走服务端 ftml,统一放进无脚本 sandbox iframe. - 用户头像为上传的 SVG 文件,由服务端校验确为纯矢量:必须是合法 XML 且根元素为 `svg`,至少包含一个矢量图形,禁止内嵌/外链位图、`<script>`、`<foreignObject>`、事件属性、DTD 与实体声明、`<animate>`/`<set>` 等属性动画元素,`href` 只允许指向文档内图元(`#xxx`);内容上限 256 KB,传输上限 257 KB. ## 技术栈 | 层 | 选型 | | --- | --- | | 后端框架 | Rust + Axum + Tokio | | 静态生成 | Askama 模板 + `build` 子命令 | | 内容渲染 | pulldown-cmark / typst / ftml / CSS | | 数据库 | PostgreSQL + SQLx | | 认证 | webauthn-rs(Passkey) + totp-rs(TOTP) | | 会话 | tower-sessions + Postgres store(schema `tower_sessions`,表 `session`) + HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Strict Cookie,登录后轮换会话 ID,有效期 8 小时 | | 命令行 | clap | | 管理前端 | React + TypeScript + Vite | | 数据与表单 | 原生 fetch + React state | | 样式 | 原生 CSS | | 部署 | EdgeOne（内容 CDN）+ EdgeOne Pages（管理端） | | 项目/Git | PostgreSQL Git 对象 + Git smart HTTP + LFS | ## 目录结构 ```text . ├── src/ │ ├── main.rs # 入口与 clap 子命令分发 │ ├── config.rs # 环境变量配置 │ ├── db.rs # 连接池与迁移 │ ├── models.rs # 领域模型(用户/邀请码/内容/站点设置) │ ├── service.rs # 数据库访问层,API 与 CLI 共用 │ ├── auth.rs # Passkey / TOTP / 认证流程 │ ├── render.rs # markdown / html / typst 渲染 │ ├── svg.rs # 上传头像的 SVG 校验 │ ├── rate.rs # 登录/注册接口的有界内存限流 │ ├── api.rs # Axum 路由、会话、CORS、Origin 校验 │ ├── build.rs # 静态站生成 │ ├── mcp.rs # MCP Streamable HTTP 只读服务器 │ ├── project.rs # 项目管理 │ ├── collab.rs # 分支/PR/讨论协作 │ └── git/ # PostgreSQL Git、LFS、smart HTTP ├── templates/ # Askama 模板(layout / index / page) ├── migrations/ # SQLx 迁移(当前 0001–0011) └── admin/ # 管理前端(独立 Vite 工程) ``` ## 命令行 ```text kych-net serve # 启动 HTTP 服务 kych-net build --out dist # 生成静态站 kych-net build --only xef/index.html # 只编译一页(管理端保存时调用) kych-net db migrate # 执行迁移 kych-net invite create --uses 1 --expires 7d kych-net invite list kych-net invite revoke <code> kych-net user create --admin # 创建管理员并输出 TOTP 密钥 kych-net user create # 创建普通成员 kych-net user list kych-net user disable <user> kych-net user enable <user> kych-net passkey reset <user> kych-net gc --project <项目名> # 清理不可达 Git 对象与孤立 LFS 文件 ``` ## 中文命令行 同一个二进制 `kych-net` 同时提供中英文两套命令。英文命令直接给 clap；中文命令先被翻译成英文参数，再交给同一个 clap 解析器——因此两者走完全相同的执行路径和同一个 service 层，不需要第二个二进制，也不需要在 PATH 里另找程序。 中文命令按中文语序书写，且**连写、不加空格**： ```text kych-net 启动服务 kych-net 生成静态站到public kych-net 创建邀请码可用三次有效期七天 kych-net 作废邀请码ABCD1234 kych-net 创建管理员爱丽丝 kych-net 创建用户爱丽丝设为管理员 kych-net 重置爱丽丝的通行密钥 ``` 项目只保留**用户名**这一个名字（`display_name` 已移除）；用户名支持中文、日文与 emoji，注册、用户列表和通行密钥的展示名都用它。中文不像英文靠空格分词，程序先去掉空白，再按中文短语切出命令名、数量、时长、所属与参数；支持中文数字（`三次`）、中文时长（`七天`、`永不过期`）和多种说法（`运行服务`、`撤销邀请码`、`解禁用户`）。 `kych-net --help` 打印完整帮助：上半是 clap 的英文子命令列表，下半是中文命令一览，两边共用同一份子命令定义。 ### 中文名「跨越晨昏」：在服务器环境变量里设置别名 中文命令名由**服务器环境变量/初始化文件里的别名**提供，不改动二进制与源码名。最直接的是 `alias`： | 场景 | 写入位置 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | 所有登录用户（推荐） | 新建 `/etc/profile.d/kych-net-alias.sh` | `alias 跨越晨昏='kych-net'` | | 单个用户 | `~/.bashrc` / `~/.zshrc` / `~/.profile` | 同上 | | 仅当前会话 | 直接执行 | `alias 跨越晨昏='kych-net'` | 前提是 `kych-net` 所在目录已在服务器环境变量 `PATH` 里（例如装到 `/usr/local/bin`；若放在自定义目录，在同一份脚本里先加 `export PATH=/opt/kych-net:$PATH`）。重新登录后： ```bash alias 跨越晨昏 # 确认别名已生效 跨越晨昏 创建邀请码可用三次有效期七天 ``` **一处要注意**：`alias` 是 shell 内置命令，**不是环境变量**，不会出现在 `env` 或 `systemctl show -p Environment` 里；systemd 的 `Environment=`、Docker 的 `ENV`、`/etc/environment` 这些只能设置变量的地方写不了 `alias`。服务托管与容器场景改用 PATH 目录里的**同名链接**作为命令别名，效果一样且不依赖 shell： ```bash ln -sfn /opt/kych-net/kych-net /usr/local/bin/跨越晨昏 export PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH # 通常已默认包含 ``` 中文解析实现在 `src/cli_cn.rs`：只依赖标准库，不新增任何依赖，内含单元测试（`cargo test cli_cn`）。它把原始参数翻译成英文参数交给 clap，不 fork 子进程，因此中文命令的启动开销与英文命令完全一致。 ## 注册与登录 - 注册必须持有有效邀请码.邀请码可由 CLI 或管理员在管理前端生成,支持设置使用次数与有效期. - 邀请码由 CSPRNG 生成、Base32 编码,长度不少于 16 字符(约 80 bit 熵). - 注册用户默认为普通成员;管理员通过 `kych-net user create --admin` 创建. - 普通成员可管理内容与个人设置;邀请码、用户管理、站点设置仅管理员可见. - 登录支持通行密钥(Passkey)与 TOTP 动态验证码,用户注册后可绑定任一或全部. - 会话存放于 HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite Cookie,不落地到前端存储;登录或注册成功后会轮换会话 ID,避免会话固定. - 会话记录存在 Postgres(schema `tower_sessions`,表 `session`),由 `serve` 启动时自动建表,每 5 分钟清理过期行;`kych-net db migrate` 不涉及它,但数据库角色需要有建 schema 的权限.换成集中存储后,进程重启不再让所有人掉登录,多实例也能共享会话,内存也不再随会话数无上限增长.代价是每个带 Cookie 的请求多一次按主键的会话读. - 登录相关接口有限流(按用户名与客户端 IP 双路计数):`login/start` 每用户名 10 次/分钟、`totp/login` 每账号 5 次/15 分钟(成功即清零)、注册每 IP 10 次/分钟,超额返回 429.限流是进程内的,重启清零、多实例各自计数,要跨实例统一得换集中存储. - 客户端 IP 默认取 TCP 对端地址;只有确实只经可信 CDN/反代进来时才设 `TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS=1` 改读 `X-Forwarded-For`——这个头任何人都能伪造,信错了等于让攻击者自己挑额度. - 绑定 TOTP 时新密钥先进 `pending_secret`,输入正确验证码确认后才替换旧密钥;中途放弃不会把原来能用的 TOTP 打死. - `login/start` 与 `totp/login` 的失败响应统一成同一条消息:这两个接口匿名可调,"用户不存在""账号已禁用""没绑定通行密钥"如果是可区分的,就等于在向外枚举用户名和每个人的 2FA 配置.真实原因只进日志. - 过期的 `auth_flows` 由 `serve` 内的后台任务每 60 秒清理一次;`login_start` 每次调用都会插一行,不清理就会被匿名请求撑爆. - 注册改为「凭证通过才落库」:`/api/auth/register` 只读校验邀请码并把用户资料暂存在认证流程里,`/api/auth/register/finish` 校验 Passkey 成功后才在一个事务内扣邀请码、建用户、存凭证.浏览器取消仪式不再消耗邀请名额,也不会留下没有凭证的孤立用户;撞用户名由唯一约束兜底. - 修改凭证需要 step-up:`totp/setup`、`passkey/setup`、`passkey/setup/finish` 要求会话在最近一次真实认证的 5 分钟内;过期后管理端会弹窗要求输入 TOTP 或使用通行密钥重新确认,验证成功后自动重试原操作.只拿到旧 cookie 或只读到 `/api/me` 的攻击者无法把受害者的二次验证换绑到自己设备上.`totp/confirm` 不要求 step-up(pending 密钥只能由已 step-up 的 setup 产生),但每账号限 5 次/15 分钟. - 管理员启停账号有护栏:不能禁用自己的账号,也不能禁用最后一个可用管理员(同一事务内锁行判断,并发互关时后提交者失败).`kych-net user` CLI 不受此限制,保留为应急入口. - 请求体上限显式声明:全局 2 MiB,头像 257 KB,不再依赖框架默认值. ## MCP 服务器 MCP 使用标准 **OAuth 2.1**：MCP 客户端通过动态客户端注册、授权码 + PKCE 登录 KychNet 账号，拿到短期 access token 和 refresh token。不再使用静态 Bearer token。 公网地址是 **`https://kych.net/mcp`**；`api.kych.net` 只是回源 Host，不能作为 MCP 或 Git 的客户端地址。 ### 端点 - 资源元数据：`https://kych.net/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` - 授权服务器元数据：`https://kych.net/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` - 动态注册：`POST https://kych.net/oauth/register` - 授权：`GET https://kych.net/oauth/authorize` - Token：`POST https://kych.net/oauth/token` - MCP：`https://kych.net/mcp` ### 登录 客户端第一次连 `/mcp` 会收到 `401` 和 `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata=...`，然后自动完成发现和注册，并打开 KychNet 授权页。授权页使用现有账号 + 动态验证码登录；登录后确认权限即可。 普通成员和管理员都可以读写 MCP；项目 Git 提交使用当前登录用户作为提交身份。授权页会明确列出读取内容、写入内容、读取项目、写入项目四项权限。 ### 工具 - 只读：`list_pages`、`get_page`、`search_content`、`site_info` - 内容写入：`save_content`、`delete_content` - 项目读取：`list_projects`、`list_project_files`、`read_project_file` - 项目写入：`write_project_file`、`delete_project_file` ### 客户端安装 MCP 客户端需要支持 **Streamable HTTP + OAuth**。不要给客户端配置静态 `Authorization` 头。 #### Claude Desktop 编辑： - macOS：`~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` - Windows：`%APPDATA%\\Claude\\claude_desktop_config.json` ```json { "mcpServers": { "kych-net": { "url": "https://kych.net/mcp" } } } ``` 保存后完全退出并重启 Claude Desktop，首次连接会在浏览器打开授权页。 #### Claude Code ```bash claude mcp add --transport http kych-net https://kych.net/mcp ``` #### Cursor 项目级 `.cursor/mcp.json`，或全局 `~/.cursor/mcp.json`： ```json { "mcpServers": { "kych-net": { "url": "https://kych.net/mcp" } } } ``` #### VS Code / GitHub Copilot MCP `.vscode/mcp.json`： ```json { "servers": { "kych-net": { "type": "http", "url": "https://kych.net/mcp" } } } ``` #### Trae Trae 目前不原生执行 MCP OAuth，直接填远程 `url` 会得到 401。用 `mcp-remote` 作为本地 stdio 桥接，由它完成浏览器 OAuth，再把工具转给 Trae。 先确认本机有 Node.js 22+ 和 `npx`。在 Trae 的 **设置 → MCP → 手动配置** 中加入： ```json { "mcpServers": { "kych-net": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://kych.net/mcp"] } } } ``` 也可以直接编辑全局配置： - macOS：`~/Library/Application Support/Trae/User/mcp.json` - Windows：`%APPDATA%\Trae\User\mcp.json` - Linux：`~/.config/Trae/User/mcp.json` 保存后首次连接会在浏览器打开 KychNet 授权页。`mcp-remote` 会在本地缓存 token；不要额外配置 `Authorization` 头。 #### DSH / DeepSeek Harness DSH 直接用本仓库自带的插件 `dsh-mcp-kychnet`（见 `plugins/dsh-mcp-kychnet/`）接入。 插件本身只是配置 bundle，OAuth 2.1 的全部流程交给 [`dsh-mcp-oauth-client`](https://github.com/fangzaozao/dsh-mcp-oauth-client) 完成， 因此是原生的 Streamable HTTP 连接，不需要 `mcp-remote` 之类的 stdio 桥接。 ```bash dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/plugins/dsh-mcp-kychnet ``` 重启 `dsh web` 后，**设置 → 插件** 里会出现「KychNet 站点」，**设置 → MCP** 里会出现 `mcp-kychnet`。首次调用 `mcp__kych-net__*` 工具时会打开授权页；工具与上面的「工具」 一节一一对应。 不使用插件、直接写 Cordis overlay 时，把下面的 `insert` 合并到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`（只对该 profile 生效），或 `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`（本机所有 profile 生效）： ```yaml - insert: - id: mcp-kychnet name: dsh-mcp-oauth-client config: entryId: mcp-kychnet manager: false serverName: kych-net transport: streamable-http resourceUrl: https://kych.net/mcp authType: oauth scope: content:read content:write project:read project:write ``` > 老版本 DSH 如果既没有 bundle 支持也没有带 OAuth 的 MCP 客户端，才需要退回 > `npx -y mcp-remote https://kych.net/mcp` 的 stdio 桥接。桥接只解决 OAuth，不改变 > KychNet 的权限模型；登录用户仍然是 Git 提交身份。 ### 自检 未带 token 请求 `/mcp`，应得到 401 和发现地址： ```bash curl -i https://kych.net/mcp \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" ``` 也可以直接检查元数据： ```bash curl -sS https://kych.net/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource curl -sS https://kych.net/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server ``` ### 故障排查 - `401`：还没有完成 OAuth，或 access token 过期；客户端应自动刷新； - `403`：请求 `Host` 不是 `kych.net`/localhost，或反向代理未正确传 Host； - `404`：路径不是 `/mcp`，或 nginx 未转发； - 客户端只支持 stdio：当前服务是 Streamable HTTP，需要支持远程 HTTP MCP 的客户端。 ### 撤销授权 撤销某个用户的全部 MCP 授权： ```sql DELETE FROM oauth_tokens WHERE user_id = '<用户 UUID>'; ``` 撤销所有 MCP 授权： ```sql DELETE FROM oauth_tokens; ``` access token 一小时内自然过期；refresh token 最长 30 天。数据库迁移 `0012_oauth` 创建客户端、授权码和 token 表。 ## 项目与 Git - 项目管理在管理端「项目」页,数据落在 PostgreSQL 的 Git 表和 `LFS_ROOT` 文件目录; - 仓库地址:`https://kych.net/git/<项目 slug>.git`; - Git smart HTTP 和 LFS 都通过 `kych.net` 的 nginx `/git/` 反代; - 匿名可以 clone 公开仓库,写操作使用 Git token; - 迁移 `0009_projects` / `0010_lfs` 创建项目、对象、refs、commits、PR、讨论与 LFS 索引; - `kych-net gc --project <slug>` 清理不可达对象。 ## 开发 ```bash # 后端 cp .env.example .env # DATABASE_URL / ADMIN_ORIGIN / WEBAUTHN_RP_ID / WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN cargo run -- db migrate cargo run -- serve # 生成静态站 cargo run -- build --out dist # 管理前端 cd admin && pnpm install && cp .env.example .env && pnpm dev ``` 开发时 `VITE_API_BASE_URL` 留空,`/api` 由 vite 代理转发到后端。生产构建前必须把它设为 API 服务的完整 origin(例如 `https://kych.net`),因为管理前端是独立静态站,没有同源 `/api` 可转发;后端 CORS 与写接口 Origin 白名单均以 `ADMIN_ORIGIN` 为准。 ## 构建与部署 1. [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml) 在 push、PR 和手动触发时运行测试,并编译 Linux 二进制;推送 `v*` 标签时自动创建 Release. - `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`:依赖系统 glibc,在 Ubuntu 26.04 x86-64 runner 上构建并 strip 符号表. 2. 管理端保存内容后会自动编译当前页(改路径时同时删除旧产物);「站点设置 → 整站重建」或 `kych-net build --out dist` 重建全站.Typst 页面同时产出 `.pdf`.构建会先渲染到内存,全部成功后才清理旧的 `.html/.pdf` 并写入新路径(不再统一放 `posts/`),中途失败不会破坏现有站点. 3. 内容站 `dist/` 由 EdgeOne 加速;管理前端构建为独立静态产物,由 EdgeOne Pages 发布. 4. 服务器 nginx 只把 `/api/`、`/git/`、`/mcp` 等后端路径反代到 `127.0.0.1:8080`;`api.kych.net` 只作为回源 Host. 5. 项目 Git 对象存 PostgreSQL,LFS 文件存 `LFS_ROOT`;systemd 需要该目录的写权限. ## 约定 - 内容以数据库为唯一事实源,构建直接读库,不调用线上 API. - 站点名称、图标与顶栏导航存于 `site_settings`,由管理端编辑,构建时读取. - 内容路径允许嵌套目录,路径段只允许 Unicode 字母/数字、`-` `_`;目录主页必须显式写出文件名,例如 `/xef/index` 归一化为 `xef/index.html`;不再接受 `/xef/`.页面可写 `/reff/93df/l.html`,也可写 `.md/.typ/.wj` 由扩展名决定格式,但最终都输出 `.html`,同一路径只保留一条.`/api` 与 `/css` 保留;`index.html` 固定为网站主页,可编辑不可删除.路径总长上限 512 字节、单段上限 200 字节;链接中的非 ASCII 路径段按 `%XX` 编码,磁盘文件名保持原始 UTF-8. - 自定义 CSS 使用 CSS 格式,路径必须写成 `/css/theme` 或 `/css/theme.css`,输出 `css/theme.css`;页面要在正文最前面显式声明才会加载: ```text --- css: /css/theme.css, /css/wikidot.css --- ``` 只有声明了 `css:` 的页面才会生成对应的 `<link rel="stylesheet">`;CSS 文件本身不会出现在内容站目录树里. - 技术栈中的内容渲染包含 pulldown-cmark、Typst、ftml;管理端和技术栈表不再单独维护 CSS 项. - 模板与 API 共用同一套领域模型,避免两端口径漂移. - Typst 在当前进程内编译,由 `VirtualPath::resolve(root)` 加 canonicalize 双重校验把文件读取限制在 `CONTENT_ROOT` 内,避免内容作者通过 `#include` 读到构建机上的任意文件;父目录校验之外还会对目标文件本身做 `symlink_metadata` 判断,内容目录里的符号链接一律拒绝(否则 `link.png -> /etc/passwd` 会被 `fs::read` 跟进去).生产仍建议放进断网容器并加 CPU/内存限额,构建机上的 `.env` 与云凭据不要落在可读目录. - Wikidot 由 [ftml](https://docs.rs/ftml) 渲染,`[[include]]` 在构建时从数据库预取 Wikidot 页面并限制 8 层递归;`ftml` 是 AGPL-3.0,因此本项目也按 AGPL-3.0 分发,见 `LICENSE`. - 编译缓存尚未实现;目前每篇 Typst 内容会分别编译 `PagedDocument`(出 PDF)与 `HtmlDocument`(出 HTML)各一次. - 静态产物保持平台中立:只用相对路径、不写死域名,重定向与 404 分别在各平台配置. - 静态资源使用哈希文件名并长缓存,HTML 短缓存;压缩交给 CDN.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DeepSeek Harness plugin: opencode usage ring

A small circular gauge for the sidebar footer of the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) desktop app. It shows how much of your **opencode Go plan** is left, for the three limits opencode tracks: the rolling 5-hour window, the week, and the month.

![The ring in the sidebar footer](docs/ring.png)

Three rings, one per window:

| Ring | Window | Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| inner | 5-hour | blue `#4f8cff` | a full ring is a full allowance |
| middle | weekly | yellow `#e3b341` | the ring drains as you spend |
| outer | monthly | violet `#a78bfa` | |

Any ring turns **red `#e5484d`** only when that window has **20% or less left**, or when opencode reports a rate limit. Nothing else uses red.

Click the circle for the same numbers as text, with reset times:

```
opencode usage                            Updated 20:05
Usage source: opencode Go plan
---------------------------------------------------------
5-hour limit                                98% left
resets in 1 h 42 min

Weekly limit                                96% left
resets in 13 h 58 min

Monthly limit                               98% left
resets Dec 3
```

The dot in front of each row is the colour of its ring.

## How the numbers are made

opencode publishes your plan usage itself. The plugin asks for it and draws it — no counting, no estimating, no scraping.

```
DSH client half  ──GET /opencode-usage-ring/data──▶  DSH host half
        ▲                                                   │
        └────────────── JSON, cached 60 s ──────────────────┘
                                                            │
                                        GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage
                                        Authorization: Bearer <your opencode key>
```

The host half reads the key opencode already stored in `%USERPROFILE%\.local\share\opencode\auth.json` (the `opencode-go` entry, or the `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` environment variable when that file has none). The response looks like this:

```json
{
  "usage": {
    "rolling": { "status": "ok", "percent": 2,  "resetsAt": "2026-11-08T11:48:28.000Z" },
    "weekly":  { "status": "ok", "percent": 4,  "resetsAt": "2026-11-09T00:00:00.000Z" },
    "monthly": { "status": "ok", "percent": 2,  "resetsAt": "2026-12-03T18:06:43.000Z" }
  }
}
```

`percent` is how much is **used**, so the ring draws `100 - percent`. If a request fails, the last good reading stays on the card with its timestamp instead of emptying the circle.

Nothing is written anywhere: one GET request leaves the machine every 60 seconds at most, and the key is never logged or displayed.

## Requirements

- The DeepSeek Harness desktop app (developed against `0.2.2-rc.1`).
- opencode with an opencode Go plan, already signed in (`opencode auth login`).

## Install

Get the code first:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/lancelotmolatelo-cpu/deepseek-harness-plugin-opencode-usage-ring.git
```

### Easiest: let DSH install it

Open a DSH session and ask:

> Install the plugin bundle from `C:\path\to\opencode-usage-ring`.

The agent runs the plugin manager's `install_bundle`, which links the folder into your profile, adds the bundle to the profile's bundle list, and enables it. The circle appears in the sidebar footer immediately; if it does not, reload the page with `Ctrl+R`.

### Manual

1. Copy this folder somewhere permanent, for example `C:\plugins\opencode-usage-ring`.
2. Open `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json` and add two entries:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@local/opencode-usage-ring": "link:C:/plugins/opencode-usage-ring"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "@local/opencode-usage-ring"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

3. In that same folder run `pnpm install` (it makes the `link:` dependency real).
4. Restart DSH.

The Plugins page then lists **opencode usage ring** with its icon and description.

## Build it yourself

A DSH plugin is a small npm package with **two halves**: a host half that runs in the app's Node process, and a client half that runs in the Web GUI. They talk over one local HTTP route.

### 1. The manifest: `package.json`

```json
{
  "name": "@local/opencode-usage-ring",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    ".": "./index.js",
    "./client": "./client.js",
    "./locale/*.json": "./locale/*.json",
    "./icon": "./icon.svg"
  },
  "files": ["index.js", "client.js", "cordis.patch.yml", "locale/*.json", "icon.svg"],
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
    "client": {
      "platform": "web",
      "immediately": true,
      "inject": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

- `dsh.bundle.patch` names the YAML file that inserts the plugin row.
- `dsh.client` says the browser half exists, targets the Web GUI, and should activate immediately.
- `inject` only orders activation after the sidebar packages. No Harness package is imported — the client half uses plain React from the page's module table.

### 2. The loader row: `cordis.patch.yml`

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: opencode-usage-ring
      name: '@local/opencode-usage-ring'
```

This is how the bundle adds itself to the app's plugin graph.

### 3. The host half: `index.js`

It exports `apply(ctx)`. Inside, wait for the web server service and register one route:

```js
export function apply(ctx) {
  useService(ctx, 'webServer', (webServer) => {
    ctx.effect(() => webServer.register({
      kind: 'exact',
      path: '/opencode-usage-ring/data',
      handler: handleRequest,
    }));
  });
}
```

`ctx.get('webServer')` is a snapshot of the moment it is called, so `useService` retries for up to ten seconds instead of silently giving up when the server activates later. Everything registered inside `ctx.effect` is removed when the plugin unloads.

The handler is plain Node: read the stored key, call the usage endpoint, cache the answer for a minute.

```js
const response = await fetch('https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage', {
  headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, accept: 'application/json' },
  signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12000),
});
```

The full file also covers: finding `auth.json` on Windows and Linux, mapping the three windows, a cache that survives a failed request, and friendly error text for a refused key or a dead connection.

### 4. The client half: `client.js`

The browser loads it as a module factory. React comes from the page:

```js
window.__ModuleLoader__.load({
  id: '@local/opencode-usage-ring',
  factory(require) {
    const React = require('react');
    const h = React.createElement;
    // ... component code ...
    return {
      inject: ['slots'],
      apply(ctx) {
        ctx.slots.inject('sidebar.footer.action', () =>
          ctx.slots.register(
            { name: 'sidebar.footer.action', id: 'opencode-usage', order: 10, label: 'opencode usage' },
            UsageRing,
          ),
        );
      },
    };
  },
});
```

`sidebar.footer.action` is the additive seat beside the Settings row at the sidebar foot — the only spare seat there that does not replace shipped UI. `ctx.slots.inject` is declaration-aware, so this works whether the sidebar activates before or after the plugin.

The component itself:

- polls the host route every 60 seconds, and again on window focus;
- draws three `<circle>` elements with `stroke-dasharray`, one per window;
- renders the card as a `position: fixed` panel placed from the button's `getBoundingClientRect()`, so the sidebar's scroll container cannot clip it;
- closes the card on an outside click or `Escape`;
- registers its strings with `ctx.locale` so the card can be translated.

Styling follows the app: surfaces, borders and text use the theme's `--dsw-alias-*` tokens; only the gauge arcs use fixed colours, because a gauge has to read the same on a dark and a light sidebar.

### 5. Display metadata: `locale/` and `icon.svg`

The Plugins page shows a bundle before it is activated, so it needs a title, a description and an icon that do not depend on running code:

```json
{ "meta": { "title": "opencode usage ring", "description": "A circle beside the sidebar account row that shows how much of the opencode Go plan is left for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly limits." } }
```

Both are exported from `package.json` (`./locale/*.json`, `./icon`).

### 6. Check it

With the plugin installed, the route answers on its own:

```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:51437/opencode-usage-ring/data -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content
```

The port is whatever the app chose; the GUI URL in the app's runtime context shows it.

## Customise

Everything below lives in `client.js`.

| What | Where | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Ring colours | `TONES` object | blue / yellow / violet |
| Red threshold | `LOW_LEFT_PERCENT` | `20` |
| Ring order | the `rings` array in `RingGlyph` | month outer, 5-hour inner |
| Poll interval | `REFRESH_MS` | `60 * 1000` |
| Card width | `CARD_WIDTH` and `.ocur-card` | `264px` |

You can check the colour logic without the app: the threshold applies per window, so a window at 15% left draws red while a window at 96% keeps its own colour.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause and fix |
|---|---|
| No circle at all | The sidebar is collapsed or hidden. Expand it — the circle lives in the footer, next to the account row. |
| Circle shows a dashed grey ring | The route has no answer yet; the first request was still running. It fills in within a second. |
| `The opencode Go API key was refused` | The stored key is stale. Run `opencode auth login` again. |
| `Could not reach opencode.ai` | No network, or a proxy blocking the request. |
| `Last reading 10:55` in yellow | The newest request failed; the card keeps the previous numbers instead of emptying. |
| Card will not stay open | Another plugin that replaces the sidebar footer may be fighting for the same seat. |

## Licence

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The native host reads existing OpenCode auth and sends a Bearer token to the usage service; its raw data route lacks a demonstrated owner admission boundary. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-cad — CAD Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

![dsh-cad banner](docs/img/banner.svg)

[![homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/homepage-dsh--cad-4D6BFE)](https://lau-mars.github.io/dsh-cad/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepseek-ai%2Fdsh?label=dsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2022-4D6BFE)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![occt](https://img.shields.io/badge/occt-7.9.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/opencascade-ts)
[![occt.ts](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/occt.ts?label=occt.ts)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt.ts)
[![ansatz](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ansatz-wasm?label=ansatz)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ansatz-wasm)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A CAD plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
an **embedded 3D/2D CAD viewer** plus a **native parametric modeling tool family**
(OCCT kernel) in the Web UI, letting the agent build and inspect CAD geometry
step by step — "model while you watch".

## Preview

A full modeling session, end to end: the agent builds a parametric assembly
from plain chat — a 120×80×8 base plate with R5 rounded corners, then four
bolt instances placed at the corners — while the resident CAD panel tracks
every step live (parts tree with per-instance colors, ViewCube, "装配体"
assembly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports
as a structured STEP document and the agent verifies it by reading the file
back — 2 solids, 3 products, 2 assembly usages, 1,125.00 mm³:

![dsh-cad assembly session](docs/img/assembly-preview.png)

## Downloads

Cumulative downloads from the npm registry, refreshed daily by CI:

![npm cumulative downloads](docs/img/downloads-cumulative.svg)

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ⚙️ Kernel chain: cadorange → occt.ts | Modeling goes through **[cadorange](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/cadorange)** (the agent-native CAD runtime wrapping the occt.ts/OCCT WASM; public API + the supported `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for meshing/HLR/wire construction); the direct occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier — `DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one explicitly (the opencascade.js tier was removed in v0.15.1, −64MB install). The old "no editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD viewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the resident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation |
| 🌗 Dark-mode surfaces | Every rendered surface follows the host theme — viewport slab, DXF/drawing strokes, the Three.js grid / XYZ triad / feature edges / default mesh color / sketch overlays, and the ViewCube plate; a theme flip restyles mounted viewers live. Overrides: `--dsh-cad-bg`, `--dsh-cad-stroke`, `--dsh-cad-paper` |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edges / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Parametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-edge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take **curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not a mesh approximation. `cad_loft` sections accept **curves** too: point loops, `{through}` splines or planar `{profile}` chains; `smooth: true` fits a **periodic B-spline** through point loops — one continuous B-spline lateral face instead of planar strips meeting at G0 creases |
| ✏️ Named sketches | Standalone named profiles (Sketch1…) kept in the document (`cad_sketch_new` / `edit` / `list` / `delete`); extrude/revolve/sweep reference them **by name**, and `cad_sketch_edit` rewrites the definition in place + replays the log, rebuilding every dependent feature — the parametric loop. Sketches render as Onshape-style **blue curves + plane frame** in the viewport (refreshing live on edit), listed in a left-side **feature tree** (sketches + features, eye-toggle visibility, click-to-highlight bodies) over the Part tab |
| 🗂️ Codex-style document tabs | The resident display panel gets a tab strip with a "+" menu: **Part** (Part Studio, the default) / **Assembly** (instance insert/move/remove) / **Drawing** (true hidden-line sheets); tabs are closable and keep their state |
| 🔩 Joint-driven assemblies | The build123d joint family (rigid/revolute/linear/cylindrical/ball/planar/polar): `cad_assembly_joint` defines, `cad_assembly_connect` pairs-and-solves (parent fixed, child repositioned onto the joint frames), `cad_assembly_drive` drives motion values with cascading re-solve (motion studies), `cad_assembly_explode` for exploded views; the assembly-tree panel gains a JOINTS section (kind/current value/pairing link). Pure main-thread placement algebra — kernel-independent, replays from the op log |
| 📥 STEP assembly import | `cad_step_import` imports a STEP document as an assembly: names, nesting and instance placements survive, identical geometry dedupes into one body referenced by N instances (a bolt pattern is one body); files cache as content-addressed workspace assets so op-log replay stays self-contained (cadorange kernel) |
| 📁 Multi-document file space | Named documents per workspace (`.dsh-cad/docs/`), each session bound to its own active document — new sessions start empty instead of inheriting leftovers; a folder button in the panel lists every document (preview / delete), and `cad_doc_new` / `cad_doc_open` manage the modeling target from chat |
| 📐 Engineering drawings | GB first-angle layout: front / top / left views + isometric, true OCCT hidden-line removal via the **occt.ts** kernel (an npm dependency, dashed); sheet frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale series; exports SVG / DXF |
| 🔗 Constraint solving & motion | **Ansatz** geometric constraint solver (**one command: `npm install ansatz-wasm`** — a wasm dependency, no Rust toolchain, no native binary): entity/constraint modeling (assembly instances ↔ rigid3 poses mapped automatically), solve-with-writeback, full DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics (LLM-oriented), and parametric kinematic sweeps (`cad_constraint` / `cad_solve` / `cad_motion`) |
| 📐 Geometry measurement | Exact volume (mm³), bounding box, triangle counts, DXF layers |
| 📤 On-demand export | STEP (parametric) / STL (mesh); files are written only when the user asks |
| 🖥️ Resident CAD panel | A permanent panel right of the conversation: Codex-style tabs (Part / Assembly / Drawing), tracking the latest model in real time while modeling. A host-independent liveness poll (`GET /dsh-cad/docs` → per-document op count) keeps the viewport following modeling ops even when the conversation meta pipeline goes stale, and auto-returns from a file preview |
| ⚡ Zero-copy render pipeline | worker mesh → in-memory binary → three.js typed arrays; zero base64 / zero intermediate files / zero per-step disk writes |
| 💾 Modeling document persistence | Operation log (JSON) + debounced disk mirror; automatically replayed to restore state after a process restart |
| 🖼️ Image → profile | PNG sketch/screenshot → Otsu binarization → contour tracing → extrusion-ready polygon (`cad_image_profile`) |
| 🔌 FreeCAD executor | Run the same op family on an external FreeCAD console (STEP in/out); requires a local FreeCAD install |
| ☁️ Onshape executor | Run the same op family on **Onshape** over its signed REST API — zero local install; every op compiles to a **standard Onshape feature** pushed into the target Part Studio (no Feature Studio setup). Readback is three-tier: cheap per-part STL by default, `readback: "step"` for exact-BRep-derived named meshes via a server-side STEP translation, or `readback: "none"` — build only and return the document link (~3 calls, quota-friendliest). Exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid). Quota-aware errors distinguish credential problems from free-plan cooldowns; the Onshape document URL is always surfaced |

## Installation

The plugin is published to npm — one line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad
```

The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automatically, so there is nothing to configure by hand.

### Version requirements

- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
  the badge row above and the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
  the prose so they never go stale

### Install from source (dev mode)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LAU-MARS/dsh-cad.git
cd dsh-cad
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # deps include occt.ts (true-HLR drawing kernel, ~20MB wasm)

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh web                                  # let the first launch init the profile, then Ctrl-C

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cad

dsh web
```

The patch insert ships as `cordis.patch.yml` in the package root and is applied by the installer via the same `dsh.bundle` manifest.

Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and you are ready — for example:

- “open bracket.stl” → `cad_view`
- “model a 100×60×5 plate, punch a ⌀20 hole in the middle, R2 fillets on the four
  corners, add a ⌀16 boss 20 tall, export plate.step”
  → `cad_create_prim` + `cad_boolean` + `cad_fillet` + `cad_export`, with the 3D tab
  updating live at every step
- “build a snowman” → spheres + a cone nose + a cylinder hat (precise `at`/`axis` placement)
- “add two more b1, one rotated 90 degrees” → `cad_assembly_insert` + `cad_assembly_move`, the Assembly tab updates live
- “make an A3 drawing of b1 and export dxf” → `cad_drawing` (three views + iso + dashed hidden lines + dimensions) → `cad_export` `.dxf`

## Modeling Tool Family

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cad_view` | Open a CAD file and render it in the viewer (resident panel) |
| `cad_info` | Read-only geometry metadata (format / counts / bounding box / units / layers) |
| `cad_create_prim` | Primitives (mm, Z-up); `at` for placement, `axis` for orientation (exact axis-angle rotation) |
| `cad_sketch_new` | Create a named sketch (Sketch1…): {start, segments} / {circle} / flat points loop — referenced by name from the profile features |
| `cad_sketch_edit` | Redefine a sketch (回改): the definition op is rewritten in place and the log replayed — every referencing feature rebuilds |
| `cad_sketch_list` | List the document's sketches (name / form / size) |
| `cad_sketch_delete` | Delete a sketch (refused while features still reference it) |
| `cad_extrude_profile` | Extrude a closed XY-plane profile along +Z into a solid — inline points/segments/circle or a named sketch (`sketch`) |
| `cad_loft` | Loft: skin a solid through successive closed sections (each a [x,y,z,…] loop in its own plane, or a curve/`profile` section); sections may differ in shape and point count; `smooth` fits a periodic B-spline through point loops for a **crease-free** skin; `ruled` for straight sides |
| `cad_revolve` | Solid of revolution: revolve a closed profile around an axis (profile coords = (radius, height); curve segments supported — rounded rims exact); optional `angle`; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_chamfer` | Chamfer: bevel every sharp edge with one equal distance (mm) |
| `cad_pattern` | Pattern: linear (`delta` spacing) or circular (principal axis + `at` point + sweep angle); creates copy bodies, fuse afterwards for one body |
| `cad_shell` | Shell: hollow to a wall thickness (inward, outer skin preserved); `open` lists outward normals of the faces to open (empty = sealed). Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_draft` | Draft: tilt the walls `angle` degrees about a neutral plane (mold release); `direction` is the pull direction, walls auto-selected by default. Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_sweep` | Sweep: pipe a closed 2D profile along a 3D [x,y,z,…] path; the profile is auto-placed on the start plane, so no manual orientation; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_boolean` | fuse / cut / common (classic hole punching: plate cut cylinder) |
| `cad_fillet` | Constant-radius fillet on all sharp edges |
| `cad_transform` | Translate / Euler rotate / mirror |
| `cad_volume` | Exact BRep volume (mm³) |
| `cad_drawing` | Engineering drawing: front/top/left + isometric views, dashed hidden lines, frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale, A4/A3 |
| `cad_assembly_insert` | Insert a body into the assembly as a placed instance (`at` position, `rotate` orientation) |
| `cad_assembly_move` | Set an instance's absolute placement |
| `cad_assembly_remove` | Remove an instance from the assembly (the body stays) |
| `cad_assembly_joint` | Define a joint on an instance (build123d family: rigid/revolute/linear/cylindrical/ball/planar/polar), frame in the instance's local coordinates |
| `cad_assembly_connect` | Pair joints to place a child: the parent stays fixed, the child is repositioned so both joint frames coincide (optional connect-time drive value) |
| `cad_assembly_drive` | Drive a joint's motion value and re-solve every pairing (one motion-study step; ranges enforced) |
| `cad_assembly_solve` | Re-solve all pairings at current joint values (after moving a parent manually) |
| `cad_assembly_explode` | Exploded-view factor (instances push radially from the assembly center; view-state only, exports/drawings stay assembled) |
| `cad_assembly_info` | Read the assembly state: placements + joint labels/types/values + pairings + explode factor |
| `cad_step_import` | Structured STEP import: names, part structure and placements survive; identical geometry dedupes into one body referenced by N instances |
| `cad_constraint` | Declare the constraint model: entities (assembly-instance bindings) + constraints (distance/angle/mate/coaxial…), persisted in the op log |
| `cad_solve` | Solve with Ansatz and write poses back; returns DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics |
| `cad_motion` | Kinematic sweep: drive one constraint value from `from` to `to`, solve frame by frame, apply the last pose, return the motion table |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / STL / DCPRT (the native replayable part document) to a workspace path; `target: "assembly"` writes the assembly STEP, `target: "drawing"` writes the sheet as SVG / DXF |
| `cad_delete` | Delete a body |
| `cad_docs` | List the workspace's modeling documents (id / name / bodies / updated, active marked) |
| `cad_doc_new` | Create a named document and make it the session's modeling target (start multi-part projects here) |
| `cad_doc_open` | Open an existing document (by id or name) as the session's modeling target — bodies replay exactly |
| `cad_doc_rename` | Rename a document |
| `cad_doc_delete` | Permanently delete a document (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `cad_freecad` | Run an op program on an external FreeCAD executor (optional STEP input / export) |
| `cad_fusion` | Run an op program on an external Fusion 360 executor (GUI bridge; optional export) |
| `cad_onshape` | Run an op program on the Onshape cloud (signed REST API): creates or drives a document, returns its URL; `readback: "step"` for exact BRep meshes; exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid) |
| `cad_image_profile` | PNG → contours → extrusion-ready polygon points |
| `cad_script` | Deterministic script evaluation for geometry math (profile point arrays, arc coordinates): `js` runs in-process (Node vm — works even when the host shell is unavailable), `py` uses a system Python |

After every modeling step: **the chat result row updates in place** (stable viewId +
versioned URL), and the resident panel's "Part" tab tracks the latest model in real time.

## Connectors (roadmap)

Modeling runs on the **occt.ts kernel** via cadorange (OCCT in the browser —
zero install). The connectors below refer to **external CAD engines** acting as
executors for the same tool family, planned for future support:

| Connector | Suite | Platform | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Built-in kernel** | CAD modeling kernel based on OCCT + WebGL, runs in the browser — zero install | All platforms (WebGL rendering) | ✅ Built-in |
| FreeCAD | open-source parametric suite — natural local executor via its Python API (console + GUI window modes) | Windows / macOS / Linux | ✅ Available (needs local install) |
| Fusion 360 | Autodesk CAD/CAM — resident add-in + spool bridge (no headless; the Fusion window doubles as a viewer) | Windows / macOS | 🧪 Experimental (`cad_fusion`) |
| SolidWorks | Dassault Systèmes industry-standard 3D CAD, COM/.NET automation | Windows only | 🚧 Windows demo scaffold (`scripts/solidworks-bridge/`) |
| Onshape | PTC cloud-native SaaS CAD, fully in the browser — signed REST API (cad.onshape.com or chamber hosts); every op compiles to a standard Onshape feature pushed into the Part Studio, results read back as per-part STL + mass properties, the cloud is the viewer | All platforms (browser) | ✅ Available (`cad_onshape`; set `DSH_ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY` / `DSH_ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY`) |
| ZW3D（中望3D） | ZWSOFT all-in-one CAD/CAM | Windows / Linux | 🚧 Planned |
| GstarCAD 3D（浩辰3D） | Gstarsoft 3D CAD | Windows | 🚧 Planned |

All external engines implement the same **GeometryExecutor contract** (`available()` /
`run(opProgram) → meshes`), so the WebGL display layer never changes — swapping a
backend changes only the quality of the produced geometry.

## Architecture

```
cad_view(path)                        modeling tools (cad_create_prim, …)
  → import worker (occt-import-js)      → modeling worker (occt.ts WASM via cadorange)
  → CadScene JSON (base64-f32)          → exact BRep geometry + meshing
  → GET /dsh-cad/scene/<id>            → in-memory binary scene (f32/u32 packed)
                                        → GET /dsh-cad/bin/<docId>
            ↓ session presentationMeta (viewId + versioned URL) ↓
        browser card + persistent "3D" tab (three.js / SVG, Z-up, XYZ axes)
```

- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
  (cadorange over the occt.ts wasm) are separate, both lazily started
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
  zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed only on service
  restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<workspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
  are restored by replay after a restart
- **Drawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
  `npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT removal, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
  a hard error. Kernel APIs: `hiddenLines()` true hidden-line
  removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
  without MEMFS, tessellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
  `hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
  bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame. Kernel
  dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
  `occt.ts` dependency (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
  pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/../opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
  checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
  **`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, single package ~538KB, zero deps) —
  installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wasm` alone
  upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
  Resolution: the npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
  sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node. The solver speaks one JSON envelope
  contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`) surfaced
  verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
  degrees) map bidirectionally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
  exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability is staged
  (point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs
  no changes as it grows
- **Kernel chain**: modeling goes through **cadorange** (agent-native CAD
  runtime; public build123d-style API for prims/curve-segment profiles (TRUE
  B-spline interpolation)/loft/sweep/revolve/booleans (cleaned by default)/
  fillet/chamfer/shell/draft/native mirror/centroid, plus the supported
  `cadorange/occt` escape hatch for viewer tessellation, engineering-drawing
  HLR (zero STEP hops, one wasm session) and wire construction); the direct
  occt.ts adapter stays as the fallback tier (`DSH_CAD_KERNEL` pins one; see
  docs/cadorange-integration.md for the verb-by-verb mapping). Editing after
  shelling is seamless. Assembly STEP export writes a **structured document**
  (cadorange
  `exportStepAssembly`): one root product plus one named, placed child
  per instance — instance separation survives the file (STL stays a single
  fused mesh). Instance separation stays in
  the assembly scene/document for the fuse paths.
  Face selection matches `describe()` plane normals (outermost along ±normal)
- **Client**: esbuild single-file CJS factory (three.js inlined ~560KB, react provided
  by the host module table), Z-up CAD convention, empty scene with XYZ axis labels
  and a ground grid always displayed

## Theming (dark mode)

The viewer follows the host appearance automatically. DSH publishes the theme as
`color-scheme` on `<html>` plus `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; the plugin resolves
that (falling back to `prefers-color-scheme`) and themes every surface the host
tokens cannot reach:

- the viewport slab behind the transparent WebGL canvas and 2D scenes,
- default 2D entity strokes (DXF / engineering-drawing entities),
- the Three.js ground grid, XYZ axis triad/labels, feature edges, default mesh
  color and sketch overlays,
- the ViewCube face plate (canvas texture).

A theme flip restyles mounted cards and the resident panel live — no reload and
no lost camera. Engineering drawings loaded as SVG keep a white sheet; in dark
mode it is framed as paper on the dark slab instead of filling the viewport.

Hosts can override the surfaces the plugin owns; an explicit definition wins in
either theme:

| CSS variable | Applies to | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dsh-cad-bg` | viewport background (any CSS `background` value) | light `#f5f6f8→#e9ecf0`, dark `#1b1b1c→#151517` |
| `--dsh-cad-stroke` | default 2D entity stroke | `#4c5561` light / `#c8ced6` dark |
| `--dsh-cad-paper` | drawing paper behind SVG sheets | `#ffffff` |

```css
:root { --dsh-cad-bg: #0b0d10; }          /* flat canvas in both themes */
```

## Tests

```sh
npm test                             # full suite: converters / modeling worker (exact volume assertions) / DCPRT round-trip / FreeCAD + Onshape executors / image profiles / binary pipeline / document persistence
node test/route-check.mjs            # JSON scene routing layer
node test/visual/serve.mjs           # browser card/tab visual verification page (http://127.0.0.1:3987)
```

Representative assertions covered: the boolean-punched volume exactly equals the
analytic value (28429.20 mm³), L-shaped profile extrusion 3000 mm³, volumes and
bounding-box flips of sphere/cone/torus placed with `at`/`axis`, 8-byte alignment
of the binary packing, an STL export round-trip (export → read back by the
phase-1 parser), and a DCPRT document round-trip (serialize → replay on the
OCCT worker → exact bounds).

## Known Limitations

- DWG (closed-source) is unsupported; DXF bulge arcs are approximated by chords;
  glTF/3MF viewing is not implemented (the structure is reserved)
- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge selection is unstable under
  embind); chamfer is not implemented
- Sketch extrusion supports polygon profiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
  boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
  panel itself) does not respond to components registered later, so the persistent
  view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot, the official composition)
- The host reads CAD files via node:fs (the platform fs service supports UTF-8 text
  only and cannot carry binary data)
