**DSH Orchestrator**
**强模型主脑规划 + 便宜模型统一打工 —— DeepSeek Harness 的「硬隔离调度模式」插件** [![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.9.0-4176E6?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/SShiRkiT/dsh-orchestrator) [![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-dsh--plugin-4176E6?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Web%20GUI%20%7C%20Desktop-5c6bc0?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/SShiRkiT/dsh-orchestrator) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-339933?style=flat-square&logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org) [![module](https://img.shields.io/badge/module-ESM-F7DF1E?style=flat-square&logo=javascript&logoColor=black)](package.json) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2ea44f?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/SShiRkiT/dsh-orchestrator?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/SShiRkiT/dsh-orchestrator/stargazers) **简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) · [核心差异](#为什么有了原生-subagent-和-agent-team还需要这个插件) · [核心特性](#核心特性) · [安装](#安装) · [配置说明](#配置说明)
--- ## 为什么有了原生 `subagent` 和 `Agent Team`，还需要这个插件？ DSH 客户端自带了 `subagent` / `workflow`，官方也有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`（Agent Team），但它们在实际高强度开发中仍有三个痛点——而这正是 **DSH Orchestrator** 独有的设计核心： | 痛点场景 | 原生 `subagent` / 官方 `Agent Team` | DSH Orchestrator（本插件独有） | | --- | --- | --- | | **如何省钱配模型？**
*(最核心差异)* | **无独立子代理面板**：子代理要么默认继承昂贵的主模型，要么靠主模型每次调用时自己传参选模型（容易忘传或乱选，改默认模型还得改静态配置） | **双路由独立面板 + 强制锁定便宜模型**：在 UI 面板直接把 Main Agent 设为昂贵强模型（如 `gemini-4-argon-high`），把 Subagent 统一锁死为廉价快模型（如 `gemini-3.8-flash`），改完下一次委派立即生效 | | **主代理总忍不住自己动手？** | **靠自觉（软提示词）**：主代理 / Team Lead 手里依然握有 `read`、`edit`、`bash` 等全套工具，聊几轮就经常脱轨亲自去读文件、跑命令，瞬间撑爆主上下文 | **白名单式驱动（Whitelist-Driven Hard Gate）**：主代理默认仅放行 11 项规划与派发核心工具（`allowedTools`），其余一切宿主读写/终端工具及未来新增的 MCP/第三方插件工具一律自动隐藏并在执行层强制拦截（连 `run_code` 嵌套偷调也拦），**逼迫 Main Agent 100% 只做规划与验收，Subagent 100% 只干苦力活** | | **便宜模型干活卡死/跑偏怎么办？** | **运行期黑盒**：派出后只能干等结束或超时，或者靠 `wait_agent` 阻塞轮询 | **零 Token 后台巡检唤醒**：后台定时静默扫描子代理事件日志（不调模型、零 Token 消耗），超时或卡壳时自动汇总摘要唤醒主代理，由强模型发消息精准纠偏 | | **大批量同构任务怎么跑？** | 原生 `workflow` 让模型手写任意 JS 脚本，容易失控且模型路由不统一 | **声明式 `dispatch` 流水线**：`items × stages` 结构化扇出与多阶段流水线，单项失败隔离、支持 JSON Schema 强校验，全部 Worker 强制走便宜的子代理路由 | --- ## 核心特性 ### 1. 强模型当 Main Agent，便宜模型当 Subagent（独立面板、即时生效） 在输入框下方的**「调度模式」专属面板**中，主代理与子代理的模型路由完全解耦： - **主代理（Main Agent）**：配置为你最强的旗舰模型（例如 `gpt-astra-6`、`claude-opus-5.5` 等），专门负责需求澄清、任务切分、途中纠偏与最终结果验收。 - **子代理（Subagent）**：配置为能力稍弱但极其便宜、高吞吐的模型（例如 `deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`gpt-luna-6` 等），**所有通过 `dispatch` 派出的 Worker 强制共用这条便宜路由**（除非用户在当前消息里明确点名要求临时换模型）。 - **防烧钱保护**：如果未配置子代理模型，派发时会直接报错拦截，**绝不静默回退去烧昂贵的主代理模型**。 ![调度模式面板](docs/images/dispatch-panel.png) *调度模式面板：左侧独立配置主代理（如 `gemini-4-argon-high`）与子代理（如 `gemini-3.8-flash`）各自的模型、思考强度及巡检间隔；右侧 Allowed Tools（白名单式驱动）实时拉取宿主全部工具（含 MCP 与其他插件工具），勾选即放行给主代理、未勾选（含新装插件工具）默认自动禁用，无需重启，下一条消息立即对当前会话生效。* ### 2. 主代理「规划与验收」、子代理「纯粹 Work」的白名单式硬性闸门 不同于靠 Prompt 劝主模型“多用子代理”，本插件在 DSH 工具层装了两道闸门、采用**白名单式驱动**：模型可见的工具面由 `tools.definitions()` 的包装按请求现读白名单裁掉（`installToolSurface`，`lib/tool-surface.js`），执行期再由 `tools.guard` 拒绝表外调用。主代理面上不调用 `tools.restrict`——它只能藏住继承来的全局工具（agent 自己 scope 里注册的原生 `subagent`、`ops_*` 藏不住），而且每次 `restrict`/dispose 都广播 `tools/change`、让工具表来回抖动；`restrict` 只保留给 dispatch 认领的指挥层（`lib/secretary-authority.js` 经 `restrictEach` 使用）。 - **主代理被彻底收缴执行工具**：`DEFAULT_ALLOWED_TOOLS` 默认只放行 11 项规划、派发与会话只读工具——`dispatch`、`send_message`、`interrupt_agent`、`todo_write`、`ask_user_question`、`compress` 与 5 项只读会话日志工具。所有文件读写（`read` / `edit` / `write` / `apply_patch`）、搜索（`grep` / `glob`）、终端（`bash` / `pwsh`）、网页抓取、原生 `subagent` / `workflow`，以及未来新增的任何 MCP / 第三方插件工具，一律自动隐藏并在执行层强制拦截（连 `run_code` 嵌套偷调也拦）。需要额外放行时，在面板右侧 Allowed Tools 勾选即可。 - **子代理独享完整工具链**：被派出的 Worker 不受闸门限制，在各自独立的上下文中读写文件、跑测试、看报错，完工后只把干净的结论交回主代理验收。 - **一键随时切换**：需要主代理临时亲自操作时，关掉面板上的「启用调度模式」开关即可立刻恢复主代理的全部工具，无需重开会话。 ### 3. 零 Token 后台巡检与强模型动态纠偏 便宜模型充当 Subagent 时，偶尔会在复杂的 shell 转义或报错上打转。插件内置了纯日志驱动的后台巡检器： - **零额外 Token 消耗**：后台定时器直接读取运行中 Worker 的会话事件日志（不调用任何 LLM），按设定的巡检间隔（默认 600 秒）汇总它的运行时长、轮次、新增工具调用与最后输出，合并成一条通知唤醒主代理。 - **强模型一眼把关**：主代理收到巡检摘要后，只需极少 Token 即可做出决策： - **A) 进展正常**：回复一行 `巡检：正常` 结束回合，让子代理继续跑； - **B) 途中纠偏**：调用 `send_message` 直接向运行中的子代理注入修正指令（指明正确写法或跳过卡点）； - **C) 及时止损**：调用 `interrupt_agent` 中断失控的子代理（若后续再用 `send_message` 重新唤醒它，巡检会自动重新接管并重置通知计数）。 ![巡检通知与纠偏示例](docs/images/patrol-notice.png) *巡检通知与纠偏实录：便宜的子代理卡在了 shell 引号和反斜杠转义上，巡检机制按间隔唤醒主代理后，主代理通过 `send_message` 直接给出正确写法完成纠偏。* ### 4. 唯一派发入口 `dispatch`：任务卡 + 单任务 / 批量 派发前先交一张**任务卡**：`goal`、`doneDefinition`、`files`、`deps`、`verify`、`fallback`（`items` 可选，默认 1）。缺任一字段、涉及不可逆写或删除、条目数超过 4——任一条成立即判 `high`，必须先过评审；低风险卡直接放行。 - **单任务**：省略 `items` / `stages`，派一个自包含任务。同一回合多次调用即可并行启动多个 Worker；插件统一注入简体中文回复指令，并要求它在收尾时直接输出最终总结、禁止调用 `send_message` 向父代理汇报。 - **批量**：给定 `items`（1–64）× `stages`（1–8），走 `maxConcurrency`（1–16，默认 4）的逐条目无屏障流水线，支持阶段级 JSON Schema 强校验与单项失败隔离；批量路径当前同步返回全部结果。 > **破坏性变更**：`delegate` 与 `orchestrate` 不再注册，旧提示词里的这两个名字不会被接受。改写方式是「同一句话换成 `dispatch`，再补上任务卡字段」。 ### 5. 派发前的盲评闸门与四段流水线 高风险卡在 worker 启动之前，先由一个**零上下文评审者**判一次——它只看任务卡，看不到主代理的对话与推理： - **三态结论**：`BLOCK` / `IMPROVE` / `PASS`。`PASS` 合法，但必须列出查了哪几项（完成定义、写白名单、验收命令、回退策略），不允许为产出而编造问题。 - **`BLOCK` 就是停**：一个 worker 都不启动，错误消息带回 `failureMode`（原计划会失败的具体机制）与 `target`，主代理据此重规划；一次派发只评一次，不自动重评、不自动改写。 - **四段**：`plan → review → dispatch → settle`。`settle` 标记落定、保留会话日志、把该派发从巡检到期集摘除；日志不删，重试与复盘仍能读到原轨迹。 - **评审路由**：面板里单独一栏，留空即跟随子代理路由；最近一次结论直接显示在面板上。 ### 6. Master 层：AI 记忆、状态索引与跨会话消息（默认关闭） 这一层是附加功能，四个开关默认全关；关着时四个 master 功能都不产生用户可见输出。不过一个 host-only 的状态投影单元和一个只读端点始终注册（端点关闭时不返回任何 worker 数据），理由见 ADR 0008 的「后果」。打开后多了四样东西： - **AI 记忆（`masterMemoryEnabled`）**：插件在自己的存储域 `orchestrator_memory` 里累积条目，并在每个会话注入一段带「AI 记忆，非用户指令」标注的紧凑索引（首行标注 + 一行计数 + 每条一行）。上限 **200 条 / 索引 25 KiB**，先到者为准；写超限直接报错并要求先精简，不静默截断。它与 `~/.dsh` 下你手写的 `AGENTS.md`、`memory/topics` 完全分离——插件只读引用你的记忆树，从不写它。 > 当前版本只接线了「存储域 + 索引注入」，还没有记忆的写入/检索工具，模型侧入口待后续票；此时打开开关看到的是空索引。 - **Master 状态面板（`masterPanelEnabled`）**：输入框右侧的「Master 状态」按钮，按六态（Working / Needs input / Idle / Completed / Failed / Stopped）分组列出 worker 与会话标题摘要，只读、可收起；没有 worker 时显示「暂无 worker」，开关关闭时按钮不渲染。 - **常驻 master 会话（`masterSessionEnabled`）**：以固定 id `orchestrator-master` 建一个**无 cwd** 的根会话，落盘在 `sessions/_no-cwd/` 下（该路径来自 spike 在 `DSH_HOME` 重定向下的验证；真实宿主目录尚未验证，见 ADR 0008），重启时按 resume 复用同一个，不会越开越多；通知经 `followup` 投喂、投喂后立即 flush，卸载时先 flush 再 dispose（否则缓冲的事件会静默丢掉）。 > 当前版本没有调用方给它投通知：会话与契约已就绪，接线待后续票。 - **跨会话消息（`masterMessagingEnabled` / `masterInboundPolicy`）**：纯文本信封 `{ id, from, to, text, createdAt }`，**不带发送方历史**（额外塞进去的 `history` / `files` 会被丢弃）；单条 ≤ **8192 字节**、接收方排队 ≤ **16 条**，越界报错；入站策略 `accept` 直接投递、`hold` 停进队列、`refuse` 丢弃。接收方空闲时开一轮新回合，运行中则投在两次 step 之间，投完立即 flush。 > 当前版本没有发消息的工具，`hold` 也还没有投递触发点，消息会停在队列里等后续接上。 --- ## 环境要求 | 项目 | 要求 | | --- | --- | | **宿主环境** | DeepSeek Harness Desktop / Web GUI | | **Node.js** | `>= 22`（内置于 DSH Desktop 运行时） | | **插件形态** | Cordis 后端服务补丁（`cordis.patch.yml`）+ Web GUI 客户端扩展（`lib/client.js`） | | **界面语言** | 中 / 英双语自适应（`zh-CN` / `en-US`） | --- ## 安装 在 DSH 插件页选择从 GitHub 添加，或使用 CLI： ```text SShiRkiT/dsh-orchestrator#main ``` ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add SShiRkiT/dsh-orchestrator#main ``` 装完后请**完全退出并重新打开 DSH**（客户端插件在启动时组合，不支持热更新）。 --- ## 配置说明 配置项均为 volatile（动态热配置），在面板中修改后立即生效，无需重启 DSH；例外是 master 层的两个安装型开关（`masterMemoryEnabled` / `masterSessionEnabled`），它们在插件挂载时读取，改动要重载插件： | 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | 调度模式总开关。关闭时立即对当前会话恢复主代理全部工具。 | | `workerProvider` / `workerModel` | `""` | 子代理默认模型路由（必填，未配置时派发直接报错，绝不静默继承主代理模型）。 | | `workerReasoningEffort` | `""` | 子代理思考强度，留空则由所选模型自行决定默认值。 | | `reviewProvider` / `reviewModel` | `""` | 评审者路由。两项都填才覆盖，否则整体跟随子代理路由——不做半套拼路由。 | | `reviewReasoningEffort` | `""` | 评审者思考强度，留空由所选模型决定。 | | `lastReview` | `""` | 最近一次评审的 `{ verdict, target, at }` 摘要，由插件写入、面板只读。 | | `allowedTools` | 11 项内置白名单 | 白名单式驱动：主代理仅可使用列表内的工具，其余宿主/MCP/插件工具自动隐藏并禁用；面板右侧 Allowed Tools 可直接勾选放行或取消勾选禁用，下一条消息即刻生效。 | | `superviseEnabled` | `true` | 子代理后台巡检总开关。 | | `superviseIntervalSeconds` | `600` | 巡检间隔（秒），范围 10–86400，运行中修改立即生效。 | | `superviseMaxNoticesPerChild` | `3` | 每个子代理最多发送几次巡检通知（0–20；`0` 关闭巡检，除非同时打开 `superviseUnlimited`）。 | | `superviseUnlimited` | `false` | 打开后忽略上面的次数上限，一直巡检到子代理停止、交付或结束；设置页的「无限巡检」开关写的就是这个键。 | | `superviseNotifyOnNoProgress` | `false` | 子代理日志无新活动时是否仍然发送通知。 | | `masterMemoryEnabled` | `false` | AI 记忆层：打开存储域并注入紧凑索引。**挂载时读取**，改动需重载插件。 | | `masterPanelEnabled` | `false` | Master 状态面板。关闭时按钮不渲染，服务端端点只返回空投影。 | | `masterSessionEnabled` | `false` | 常驻 master 会话（无 cwd 根会话）。**挂载时读取**，改动需重载插件。 | | `masterMessagingEnabled` | `false` | 跨会话消息开关。逐次读取；关闭时投递以 `disabled` 拒绝，不碰接收方。 | | `masterInboundPolicy` | `accept` | 入站策略：`accept` / `hold` / `refuse`；未知值判 `unknown-policy` 拒绝，不悄悄当成 `accept`。 | > 注：主代理的默认模型保存在宿主的 `agent-default-model` 中，由同一个「调度模式」面板直接读写，对新创建的会话生效；子代理模型改动从下一次委派起立即生效。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 [SShiRkiT](https://github.com/SShiRkiT)

# dsh-session-purge

[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 社区第三方插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系；触点均为 Harness 内部实现面（非文档化 API）。
> 兼容基线：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` **0.2.2-rc.1**（Windows x64，nightly 渠道；0.2.1-rc.3/rc.5 于 2026-10-26/30 逐触点审计；0.2.2-rc.1 于 2026-11-09 复核宿主触点并实测 list 路由，删除/脱敏未在真机重跑）。nightly 更新可能**静默破坏兼容**——升级 DSH 后先运行 `node --test test/purge.test.mjs`（应 41/41）。

> [!WARNING]
> **删除即永久，无回收站**；脱敏只改写本地日志文件，**不能替代密钥轮换**。

管理 DeepSeek Harness 会话数据的两个操作：

- **永久删除**：磁盘日志 + 投影缓存 + 工作区记账 + 工具输出临时文件，级联清除全部子代理会话；
- **原地脱敏**：把敏感值（完整值/前缀）掩码写入会话 zstd 日志，保留历史，帧结构不变。

## 入口

| 入口 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 设置 → **会话清理** | 按工作区分组的会话列表：单会话删除（行内两段确认，Enter/Esc/10 秒撤防）、脱敏对话框、「删除工作区」（组头按钮，两段确认；成员运行中整体 409 拒绝；部分失败保留工作区并逐条报告）、搜索与"仅缓存记账"筛选；无 header 的纯磁盘目录也会列出（标记「仅磁盘日志」） |
| 会话行"…"菜单 | 末尾「删除」项（官方槽位 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`），删除该行会话且不切换当前对话 |

完成对话框报告释放字节、级联数与临时清扫摘要；对话框配色全部取宿主主题 token，跟随深浅色。

## 页面布局重置

客户端无内置入口；「会话清理」面板底部提供指令（F12 → Console 粘贴执行；重载后空白则手动重启客户端）：

```js
['dsh.sidebar-right.v1','dsh.sidebar-browser.v1','dsh.workspace.view.v5','dsh.conversation.contentWidth','dsh.trajectory'].forEach(p=>Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k=>k.startsWith(p)).forEach(k=>localStorage.removeItem(k)));
location.reload();
```

只清布局白名单（前缀匹配覆盖按会话键），不动快捷键、草稿、终端与计划任务。备选：更宽 `localStorage.clear()`；更严（精确边界 + 旧启动标记键）：

```js
['dsh.sidebar-right.v1','dsh.sidebar-browser.v1','dsh.workspace.view.v5','dsh.conversation.contentWidth','dsh.trajectory.duration','dsh.trajectory.jsonStringWrapping','dsh.session-purge.reset-layout-on-boot'].forEach((p)=>Object.keys(localStorage).filter((k)=>k===p||k.startsWith(p+'.')).forEach((k)=>localStorage.removeItem(k)));location.reload()
```

## 删除语义

```
ctx.get('sessions')                              → 活会话：flush（驻留对象在无代理持有时再驱逐）
ctx.get('storageDomain') → 'session_projcache'   → 投影缓存行（域 + 文件双层）
ctx.get('storageDomain') → 'workspace'           → 工作区记账 + 归档/置顶集合（域 + 文件双层）
$DSH_HOME/sessions/<projectKey>/<id>/            → 磁盘日志目录
%TEMP%/dsh-{subprocess,spill,acl-skill,...}-*    → 内容提及该会话 id 的工具输出目录（归因清扫）
header.parentSession === id                      → 子代理级联
ctx.emit('api-session/removed')                  → 通知全部客户端刷新
```

- 顺序：先删日志并验证删净，再清记账（半删会话不会掉出分组）；清理后逐层事后验证，未净显式报错，可直接重试；
- 工作区记录另走 harness 的 `workspaceRegistry.delete()`（pendingMutation 协议，进程在删除过程中退出也能在下次启动收尾）；无该服务时降级路径写同样的标记，记录删除失败会回滚 order；
- 护栏：会话 id 须匹配 `session-<uuid>`、裸 uuid 或桥接 id（不区分大小写）；**运行中拒绝（409）**；级联深度上限 `MAX_CASCADE_DEPTH = 8`，超出以 `cascadeTruncated: true` 显式报告；仅驻留不拒绝（先 `flush` 再清盘）；路径必须落在预期根内；**符号链接一律拒删**；全走 Node `fs`，不经 shell；
- 布局护栏：删除/脱敏前用宿主 `sessionPersistence.stat().location` 交叉核对日志位置；位置落在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/` 之外、或不在待删目录内时以 **503 拒绝**（fail-closed，避免"清掉账目/改写旧文件但真实日志还在"）；无该 API 的老宿主跳过这项检查；
- 目标不存在时仍幂等：session 返回 `ok` 并在报告里带 `existed: false`（客户端提示"原本已不存在"）；workspace 的 `workspaceRecordDeleted` 为 `false`，不会谎称删掉了记录；
- 纯磁盘残留：目录存在但 header 与投影行都缺失的会话也会出现在列表（`headered: false`，客户端标记「仅磁盘日志」），可单独删除；其子代理归属无法判断；
- `live[]` 每项为 `{ sessionId, flushed, evicted, existed }`：`flushed: true && evicted: false` 表示宿主仍驻留该会话，客户端会提示彻底消失需重启；
- TEMP 清扫按**内容归因**（目录内容提及会话 id 才删），受文件数/字节预算约束（超限报 `budgetHit`）；整棵级联只扫一次，各会话 `tempSweep[].dirs` 之和可能大于实际删除数（客户端摘要用去重合计 `tempSweepTotal`）。

## 脱敏语义

逐帧解压 → 替换 → 逐帧重压缩，帧数与行结构不变；写回前落备份、写回后完整校验（内容一致 + 敏感值绝迹 + 帧数一致），失败自动回滚；**成功即删备份**。备份清理失败不回滚（避免把脱敏结果还原成明文）；报告 `backupResidual`/`backupError`，完成对话框也会列出未删除的备份路径；单文件失败不中断其余文件。

- `secrets`：完整值（6–512 字符，至多 64 项）→ 掩码 `[REDACTED:xxxx…lenNN]`（保留前 4 位与总长）；6–8 位短值会泄露大半，建议改用 `prefixes` 或直接轮换；
- `prefixes`：已知前缀（4–32 位 `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`，至多 64 项），保留前缀、清除其后连续的字母/数字/`_`/`-`；
- 仅"运行中"拒绝（409）；请勿对**当前正查看**的会话执行（界面状态未验证）；
- 需 Node ≥ 23.8 的 zstd API（运行时检测；不满足时该路由 501，其余功能不受影响）。

## 目录结构与接口

```
dsh-session-purge/
├── package.json          # 包清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle 层：向 profile 插入插件行
├── lib/index.js          # 宿主半：删除/脱敏管线 + 四个同源 HTTP 路由
├── lib/client.js         # 客户端半：对话框 / 设置面板 / 侧栏行菜单
└── test/purge.test.mjs   # 单元测试（假 ctx + 临时 DSH home）
```

信任模型与宿主 `api-request-trust` 一致：授权主体必须为 loopback；`sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 一律拒绝；`Origin` 存在时必须等于该主体（桌面端经 `dsh-app://` 转发会剥离 Origin，故缺失即放行）。

```
GET  /_dsh/session-purge/list             → { ok, sessions: [...] }（行含 workspaceId / workspace / headered）
POST /_dsh/session-purge/delete           → { sessionId } → { ok, deleted[], freedBytes, projRows, wsRefs, tempSweep[], tempSweepTotal, live[], descendants[], cascadeTruncated, existed }
POST /_dsh/session-purge/delete-workspace → { workspaceId } → { ok, workspaceId, workspaceTitle, deleted[], failures[], freedBytes, projRows, wsRefs, tempSweep[], tempSweepTotal, workspaceRecordDeleted, cascadeTruncated }
POST /_dsh/session-purge/redact           → { sessionId, secrets?, prefixes? } → { ok, files[], totalReplacements, backupsResidual, failures }
```

## 安装（会修改 DSH profile）

克隆或下载本仓库（无 npm 依赖），然后**二选一**：把 `dsh-session-purge` 放入 profile 的 bundles 列表，或在目标 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中 `insert` 一行 `name: 'dsh-session-purge'`。二者都做会加载两次。桌面版实测无需重启（`dsh-hmr` 热加载插件行）。

## 测试

```powershell
node --test test/purge.test.mjs
```

当前 **41/41**（Node 24.21；无 zstd 的运行时跳过脱敏用例）。

## 已知限制（如实）

- **无回收站**；不回收 `attachments` 引用计数；
- TEMP 清扫是内容归因：从未提及会话 id 的输出会留存；
- **删除当前正查看的会话宿主不拦**（无窗口守卫），其后界面表现未经端到端验证；
- 子代理不在面板列出（清理依赖主会话级联）；对话页的子代理家族条目是父日志的派生投影，删除后界面残留到重建（磁盘与记账已净）；无 header 的孤儿子代理会以「仅磁盘日志」行列出，可单独删除，但无法按父级级联；
- 驻留会话删除后：宿主仍持代理对象则保守跳过，客户端提示"宿主仍驻留该会话，彻底消失需重启客户端"；幽灵行留到下次重启；
- Electron 渲染缓存可能短期保留已渲染内容（推断，未端到端验证）；
- 端到端验证：0.2.0-rc.2 真机验证三个路由与两个入口；0.2.1-rc.3 起为逐触点静态审计（2026-10-26）；0.2.2-rc.1 于 2026-11-09 复核宿主触点并实测 list 路由，删除/脱敏与"运行中拒绝"等守卫尚未在真实数据上重新触发过。

变更历史见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)（自 0.3.4 起记录）。

# dsh-llm-antigravity-acp

[Tiếng Việt](./README.vi.md) | [中文](./README.md)


把本机已登录的 Google Antigravity CLI（`agy`）作为 DeepSeek Harness 的一级模型 provider 接入。模型出现在输入框右下角的模型选择器里，与 DeepSeek、GLM 等直连 provider 同级使用；工具、权限、压缩、子代理全部由 DSH 负责。

## 工作方式

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    DSH[DSH agent loop] -->|stream| A[AntigravityAdapter]
    A -->|ACP v1 stdio| F["agy acp --process-per-session"]
    F -->|每个会话独立 worker| W[模型会话]
    W -->|HTTP MCP tools/call| B[127.0.0.1 MCP 桥]
    B -->|挂起，交给 DSH 执行| DSH
```

| 环节 | 做法 |
|---|---|
| 进程 | 由 `ctx.subprocess` 启动本机官方 `agy acp`，凭据留在官方进程与系统凭据库（macOS 钥匙串 / Windows 凭据管理器） |
| 客户端标识 | ACP `clientInfo.name` 使用 `jetbrains.dsh`。Antigravity 只向 JetBrains / Zed / Xcode 等白名单客户端下发 Claude 与 GPT-OSS 模型；普通客户端名称只看到 Gemini |
| 隔离 | 独立 `--gemini-dir`（默认 `$DSH_HOME/cache/antigravity-acp`），不加载用户全局规则、技能、MCP；`dsh-bridge` agent 以 `tools: []` + `excludeDefaultComponents: true` 去掉全部内置工具 |
| 工具 | DSH 工具经每会话独立的 MCP 端点暴露为 `mcp_dsh_<name>`；调用挂起，当前 DSH step 以 `finish(tool-calls)` 结束，DSH 审批并执行后在下一 step 回填，原 ACP turn 继续生成。会话创建时冻结 MCP `tools/list` 声明以固定前缀保住 Gemini 隐式缓存；中途按需解锁或禁用工具不重建会话，实时更新宿主白名单并经 `<harness_tool_update>` 增量下发 Schema，由内置 `dsh_call_tool` 原地调用 |
| 长时工具 | agy 对单次 MCP 调用有 180 秒上限且 Gemini 隐式缓存存在空闲 TTL；默认超过 85 秒（`relayAfterMs`）的调用先返回“仍在运行”提示，模型调用 `dsh_await_result` 继续等待同一结果并刷新缓存活跃度，DSH 侧只看到一次工具调用 |
| 历史 | 同一 DSH 会话复用同一 ACP 会话，只发送新增输入；压缩、编辑或历史回退时按 DSH 历史重建（`<dsh_history>` 转录 + 最新输入）。重放按字节预算保留尾部：解锁时 2.2MB，未解锁时 160KB（低于 agy 单条 `USER_INPUT` 的 192KB 截断线），从最旧消息开始省略并在块内标注，最新用户输入始终完整保留 |
| 系统提示 | 首次经 `_meta.antigravity.systemPrompt.append` 注入；声明 `systemPromptUpdate: in-history`，后续变化作为 `<system_update>` 增量发送 |

> 背景：Antigravity 的 ACP 服务按 `clientInfo.name` 白名单下发第三方模型（JetBrains / Zed / Xcode 可见，其余客户端只看到 Gemini），见 [antigravity-cli#1318](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/issues/1318)；CLI 的 `agy models` 与 `agy -p --model` 本身已支持这些第三方模型。插件因此只在 ACP 握手里使用白名单标识，不修改官方二进制，也不接管登录态。模型与套餐矩阵见 [Choose a model](https://antigravity.google/docs/models/)。

## 原生体验对照

| 能力 | 实现 |
|---|---|
| 上下文窗口 | 按模型分别声明：Gemini 4 Argon / 3.8 Flash 与 Claude Opus 5.5 在解锁后为 `1,048,576`（输入、思考、输出共享）；未解锁时统一按 `256,000`。不预扣 `defaultMaxTokens`；DSH 默认在窗口的 80% 触发压缩。解锁脚本同步打开 Gate 4A/4B（解除 `getMaxTokensForStep` 与 `DefaultSerializer.stepToMessage` 原 64K / 192KB 单步 `USER_INPUT` 上限），支持完整重放大体量历史上下文 |
| 思考强度 | `Low` / `Medium` / `High` 三档，映射 ACP `thought_level`，同会话内切换不重建 |
| 思考流 | `agent_thought_chunk` → reasoning 块 |
| 用量与上下文表盘 | 经 `node:sqlite` 只读读取本机 `$home/agy/conversations/<sessionId>.db` 的 `steps` 表（`step_type = 15` Protobuf `ModelUsageStats`），在每个 `tool-calls` 步与最终 `stop` 步逐步精确上报真实单步不相交 `TokenUsage`（`inputTokens` 为未命中缓存输入，缓存读/写与输出独立计入总量，首步无命中时显式携带 `cacheReadTokens: 0`），直接点亮 DSH 多步用量面板与底部圆环 `ContextMeter`；无会话库环境自动回退至轮末归一化用量 |
| 子代理 | 每个 `(sessionId, purpose)` 一个 ACP 会话，父会话等待工具期间子代理并发运行；`spawn` / `fork` / `team` / `workflow`、标题生成、压缩摘要互不阻塞 |
| 长输出 | `max_tokens` 停止时在同会话自动续写（默认 3 次） |
| 图片 | DSH 附件以 ACP 图片块发送；工具返回的图片以 MCP 图片内容回填 |
| 取消与重试 | 取消发送 `session/cancel` 并释放挂起调用；错误映射到 `AUTH` / `QUOTA` / `RATE_LIMIT` / `TIMEOUT` / `TRANSPORT` / `SERVER`，由 `dsh-llm-retry` 退避重试 |
| 额度 | 输入框旁药丸优先显示当前模型组每周剩余比例，点击展开可查看每周与 5 小时窗口详情及重置倒计时（`agy -p /usage`，不消耗模型额度）；设置页同步按每周优先展示套餐额度、连接状态、上下文与解锁状态 |
| 设置行 | 上下文窗口、默认思考、超长续写三项在设置页与模型菜单里都是同一套行式控件：左侧标签、右侧当前值与 `›`，点开在同一张卡片内展开候选值（当前项打勾），选中即通过 `configure` 生效，菜单不关闭；不再使用绿色描边胶囊 |

## 安装

前提：已安装官方 `agy` CLI（`>= 1.5.0`，旧版先执行 `agy update`）并在终端运行过一次完成登录。

### 方式一：直接从 GitHub 插件仓库子目录安装（预编译产物，免本地构建）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/shivertuan16-hash/dsh-plugin.git#main&path:/dsh-llm-antigravity-acp"
```

### 方式二：从本地目录或源码仓库安装

```sh
cd plugins/dsh-llm-antigravity-acp
npm run build
cd ../..
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/dsh-llm-antigravity-acp
```

重启 Web 后，在模型选择器的 **Antigravity** 分组中选择模型，并在右侧选择思考档位。

安装插件不会改写官方 `agy`。上下文窗口默认仍是 256K。要放到约 1M，另外使用同仓库的 [`agy-context-unlock`](../agy-context-unlock)，把 `agy-patch.py` 放到 `~/.gemini/antigravity/tools/agy-patch.py`（Windows 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\antigravity\tools\agy-patch.py`）。插件下次启动时，`autoPatch` 会去这个路径查找并调用它；找不到就保持官方的 256K。`agy` 升级后插件启动时会自动检查并重打补丁。

| 模型 | 上下文 | 思考档位 |
|---|---|---|
| Gemini 4 Argon | 1,048,576（解锁后；未解锁 256,000） | Low / Medium / High |
| Gemini 3.8 Flash | 1,048,576（解锁后；未解锁 256,000） | Low / Medium / High |
| Claude Opus 5.5 | 1,048,576（解锁后；未解锁 256,000） | Low / Medium / High |
模型目录以 ACP `session/new` 返回的 `models.availableModels` 为准：套餐没有开通的模型不会显示。Claude Sonnet 5.5 与 GPT-OSS 120B 默认在 `catalog.ts` 的 `HIDDEN_MODEL` 中隐藏；删除对应 id 即可重新显示。

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `antigravity` | 路由 id |
| `command` | 空 | `agy` 绝对路径；空则在 macOS / Linux 查找 `~/.local/bin/agy` 与 `PATH`，在 Windows 查找 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin\agy.exe`、`~/.local/bin/agy.exe` 与 `PATH` |
| `home` | 空 | 隔离目录；空则 `$DSH_HOME/cache/antigravity-acp` |
| `contextWindow` | `0` | 全局覆盖窗口；`0` 按模型选择：Gemini/Claude 解锁后 1,048,576、否则 256,000（可在设置页即时修改） |
| `defaultEffort` | `high` | 请求未带档位时使用（可即时修改） |
| `autoPatch` | `true` | 启动前用本机 `agy-patch.py` 检查上下文解锁，未解锁时应用 |
| `patchScript` | 空 | 解锁脚本；空则 `~/.gemini/antigravity/tools/agy-patch.py` |
| `maxLiveSessions` | `16` | 同时保留的 ACP 会话上限 |
| `idleSessionTtlMs` | `1800000` | 空闲会话回收时间 |
| `parkSettleMs` | `250` | 并行工具调用归并窗口 |
| `relayAfterMs` | `85000` | 长耗时工具返回“仍在运行”中继提示前的等待时间（毫秒，`5000..165000`），用于在 Gemini 缓存 TTL 过期与 `agy` 180 秒上限前续期保活 |
| `longDecodeContinuations` | `3` | 自动续写次数（可即时修改） |
| `warmup` | `true` | 加载时启动进程并读取模型目录 |

## 限制

- Claude 依赖 ACP 客户端白名单。插件使用 `jetbrains.dsh` 标识换取第三方模型目录；若上游收紧该白名单，模型列表会退回 Gemini。
- Claude 的额度、速率限制和可用性随 Antigravity 套餐变化，插件不额外做路由或降级。
- Claude Sonnet 5.5 与 GPT-OSS 120B 仍可被已保存的会话选中并正常运行，但不会出现在模型选择器里。
- ACP 无采样参数通道，`temperature`、`stop`、`maxTokens` 不生效。
- 逐步精确用量依赖 Node 内置 `node:sqlite` 与 `agy` 本地会话库 `steps` 表；若运行环境缺少二者，自动回退为轮末按调用次数归一化的 `TokenUsage`。
- 隔离目录保留 `manage_task`、`list_resources`、`read_resource` 三个 agy 无副作用工具；其余内置工具不可用，原生权限请求一律拒绝。

## 测试

```sh
npm run build && npm test
```

测试使用 `tests/fake-agy.mjs` 模拟 `agy acp` 与 MCP 客户端，覆盖流式思考与正文、精确用量、工具挂起与回填、并行工具、会话复用与重建、子代理并发、长时工具续等、追加输入、取消、长输出续写、辅助会话与图片输入。

## 社区

本项目在 [LINUX DO](https://linux.do) 社区进行开源推广，感谢社区佬友的交流、反馈与建议。

[Tiếng Việt](./README.vi.md) | [中文](./README.md)

基于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的插件组合包。每个目录可以用 `path:` 单独安装。

| 目录 | 内容 |

# GitChat **Conversations are trees. Your context should be too.** A Git-like conversation tree for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): fork any turn, inherit the full context, and manage branches visually — without leaving the chat. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2ea44f?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-%E2%89%A5%200.2.1--rc.3-4d6bfe?style=flat-square)](#requirements) [![React Flow](https://img.shields.io/badge/React%20Flow-12-ff0072?style=flat-square)](https://reactflow.dev) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node-22%2B-339933?style=flat-square)](#requirements) [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-early%20preview-f59e0b?style=flat-square)](#roadmap) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md) > **New to Git/GitHub?** Read the [beginner's click-by-click guide](GITHUB_GUIDE.md) (Chinese, Windows) for creating a public repo, authenticating, pushing, and keeping it updated.
![GitChat conversation tree](docs/gitchat-overview.png) ## The idea Every long conversation eventually forks. You ask a coding agent to fix a flaky motor driver. It tries three approaches. One works, two fail. A week later, the useful part is buried under a linear transcript, and the road not taken is gone. You compare two architectures, two prompts, two models. The chat window makes you choose one and erase the other. You want to keep the winning context and still explore “what if we changed only the encoder?” — but every new question drags the whole history forward. **GitChat makes context a first-class object.** A conversation is a tree, not a line. Any turn can become the root of a new branch, and every branch carries the exact context that led to it. ## See it move

Standalone preview of the exact GitChatView: inspect a turn → hover an action → fork → switch to dark mode → archive and restore. The theme switch is preview-only.

## Why Git-like | Linear chat | GitChat | |---|---| | One timeline; history is a scrollbar | A tree of turns with visible parentage | | “Branching” means retyping the context | Fork copies the exact root → turn prefix into a real child session | | Model context is implicit and fragile | Every branch inherits a deterministic DSH event prefix | | Failed experiments pollute the main thread | Archive the dead end; restore it later | | Sharing means copying prose | Export the whole tree as structured JSON | ## Not a Webview DSH is not VS Code. It has no Webview layer and no `postMessage` bridge for plugins. GitChat is a **native dual-face DSH plugin**: - the **host half** reads session logs and serves `/gitchat/*` routes; - the **browser half** mounts a React component directly into the existing `conversation.view` slot; - React Flow + Dagre render the tree; the DSH theme, locale, session, and model layers are reused. That means no iframe, no custom CSP dance, no duplicate chat UI, and no second model integration. The plugin inherits the shell’s CSP and injects its stylesheet through the same `style[data-plugin-css]` mechanism as official plugins. ### CSP - **Native plugin:** runs inside the DSH GUI and inherits the shell CSP; there is no separate document to configure. - **Standalone preview:** ships a strict policy — `default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'`. `style-src 'unsafe-inline'` is only for React Flow’s transform styles. - **If you ever wrap this in an iframe:** you would additionally need `frame-src`, `script-src`, `style-src`, and a `postMessage` protocol. GitChat deliberately avoids that layer. ## The 30-second tour 1. **Open GitChat.** On a session with at least one turn, click **GitChat** next to Chat / Trajectory. 2. **Click a node.** The inspector shows the user prompt, assistant reply, model, timestamp, tool-call count, and fork point. 3. **Hover any action.** Every toolbar button and detail action has a theme-aware tooltip that explains what it does — including *why* a disabled fork is disabled. 4. **Fork from here.** GitChat calls `sessions.fork({ sessionId, atSeq: turn.endSeq })`. The child inherits the exact event prefix and opens as a normal DSH session. 5. **Archive a dead end.** The branch and all fork descendants are archived (not deleted), then can be restored from the same view. 6. **Export.** Download the full tree JSON or write a snapshot under `~/.dsh/plugin-data/dsh-gitchat/exports/`. | Inspect | Hover | |---|---| | ![Inspector](docs/gitchat-overview.png) | ![Tooltip](docs/gitchat-tooltip.png) | | Dark / dynamic-range mode | Archive & restore | |---|---| | ![Dark mode](docs/gitchat-dark.png) | ![Archived branch](docs/gitchat-archived.png) | ## Features - **Tree-first conversation** — one node per turn, colored fork edges, Dagre layout, React Flow pan/zoom/minimap. - **Real context inheritance** — branches are real DSH child sessions; no hand-built `messages` arrays. - **Fork from any closed turn** — click a node, then *Fork from here*. Running turns are intentionally not forkable. - **Open session** — jump to the session that owns an ancestor or sibling turn. - **Non-destructive archive** — subtree archive with rollback on failure; archived branches are muted and restorable. - **Full-tree JSON** — export includes archived branches; the snapshot is a read model, not a raw log dump. - **Theme-native UI** — light, dark, and dynamic-range themes; semantic DSH tokens instead of hard-coded colors. - **Hover / focus tooltips** — portaled, collision-aware, and readable in every theme. - **Live refresh** — while a turn is running, the tree refreshes every 7 seconds; idle trees do not poll. - **Chinese + English** — locale dictionaries registered through the DSH locale service. - **Responsive** — the inspector becomes an overlay on narrow screens. ## Under the hood ### Branch = DSH fork ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Pick a turn
turn/end seq] --> B[sessions.fork atSeq] B --> C[Child session
exact event prefix] C --> D[deriveMessages
root → turn context] D --> E[Normal DSH agent
tools / models / permissions] ``` DSH’s fork copies the inclusive event prefix, writes `session/end-seed`, closes any open turn, and records `parentSession`. GitChat never reconstructs the model context by hand. ### Tree = derived read model ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph Host[Host half] SQ[sessionQuery.readSession] --> P[parseSession] P --> T[buildGitChatTree] T --> R["/gitchat/tree"] W[workspaceRegistry.archiveSession] --> A["/gitchat/archive"] end subgraph Browser[Browser half] V[GitChat View] --> RF[React Flow + Dagre] V --> API[api.ts] end API --> R API --> A ``` For every session in the fork lineage, the host reads the event log and its exact `inheritedEventCount`: - inherited events are not duplicated as nodes; - each session contributes only its own turns; - a child’s first own turn attaches to the parent turn containing the fork boundary; - nested forks walk up the lineage; - empty forks become “empty branch” nodes; unreadable logs become error nodes. ### Archive is not delete DSH has no public session-delete API. “Delete branch” archives the target and its fork descendants through `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession(id, { stopActivity: true })`, rolls back already-archived sessions on failure, and remains restorable. Session logs stay on disk.

### Theme tokens, not guesses A subtle DSH detail worth documenting: `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` is a **contrast** token — dark in light mode, light in dark mode. Using it as a blue CTA fill and pairing it with `#fff` text produced white-on-white buttons in dark mode. GitChat now uses the correct semantic pairs: ```css /* accents that should stay blue */ --gc-brand: var(--dsw-alias-button-info-fill, #4d6bfe); /* CTAs: fill and label always flip together */ --gc-primary-fill: var(--dsw-alias-button-primary-fill); --gc-primary-fg: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary-inverted); --gc-primary-hover: var(--dsw-alias-button-primary-hover); ``` ### Tooltips that explain disabled actions Native `title` attributes are slow, and disabled buttons do not fire pointer events in every browser. GitChat wraps each action in a small `GcTooltip`: - shows on hover **and** keyboard focus; - portals to ``, so it is never clipped by the view or inspector; - flips above/below based on available space; - reads DSH tooltip tokens for light/dark contrast; - is intentionally below the modal layer, so an open dialog always wins. ## Requirements - **DeepSeek Harness** `>= 0.2.1-rc.3` (developed against the `0.2.1-rc.5` plugin/session APIs). - **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. - **pnpm** 11+ for development. - A DSH profile such as `desktop` or `web`. - Network access for devDependencies at build time; the plugin has **no runtime npm dependencies**. ## Quick start ```bash git clone https://github.com/shuirongshen/dsh-git-fork-chat.git cd dsh-git-fork-chat pnpm install pnpm build ``` Artifacts: - `lib/index.js` — host half (ESM). - `lib/client.js` — browser half, wrapped for DSH’s lazy-CJS module loader. - `preview/` — a standalone preview with an in-memory mock controller. The repository already contains built `lib/` and `preview/` artifacts, so the standalone preview can run without installing dev dependencies: ```bash node scripts/preview-server.mjs # open http://127.0.0.1:5177/ ``` ## Install into DSH > This repository is installed as a **linked profile plugin**, not a VS Code extension. You need a local clone and a DSH profile. ### 1. Link the package ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add link: ``` If `dsh` is not on `PATH`, use the CLI shipped with the app: ```powershell # Windows & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" ` plugin --profile desktop add link: ``` Quote the path if it contains spaces. ### 2. Add the profile bundle Edit `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (on Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`) and append `"dsh-gitchat"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`: ```json { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-gitchat" ] } } } ``` **This step is required.** `dsh plugin add` only installs the package. The package’s `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml`) is applied only for entries in `dsh.profile.bundles`; that patch inserts `ui-gitchat` into the profile tree. ### 3. Restart DSH Close and reopen DeepSeek Harness, open a session with at least one turn, and click **GitChat**. ### 4. Verify ```bash dsh --profile desktop --dump-config | grep -i "ui-gitchat\|dsh-gitchat" ``` On Windows PowerShell: ```powershell dsh --profile desktop --dump-config | Select-String "ui-gitchat|dsh-gitchat" ``` ### Uninstall 1. Remove `"dsh-gitchat"` from `dsh.profile.bundles`. 2. `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-gitchat`. 3. Restart DSH. ## Usage | Action | What it does | |---|---| | Click a node | Inspect the turn and its metadata | | Fork from here | Create a real child session with the exact root → turn context | | Open session | Navigate to the session that owns this node | | Archive branch | Archive the branch and all fork descendants; logs stay on disk | | Restore branch | Restore an archived branch from “Show archived” | | Show archived | Reveal archived branches as muted nodes | | Export JSON | Download the full tree, including archived branches | | Save to disk | Write a snapshot under `~/.dsh/plugin-data/dsh-gitchat/exports/` | | Refresh / Fit / Re-layout | Reload, fit the viewport, or discard drag positions | ## Use cases ### Debug a coding agent without losing the good timeline The agent tried three fixes. Approach #2 is the only one that works, but you want to keep exploring from the last known-good turn. Fork there, keep `main` clean, and archive the failed experiments. ### Compare architectures, not just answers Write one root brief, fork it three ways: “event-driven”, “state machine”, “polling”. Each branch keeps the same requirements and constraints but diverges in the solution. Compare the model’s reasoning side by side. ### Keep the winning context for a long task Long sessions accumulate context that is expensive to recreate. Fork at the point where the context is best, then start the next phase with that exact prefix. ### Teach, demo, and hand off A tree is an argument map. Export it as JSON, or show the branches in the GitChat view. A teammate can see which alternatives were tried and why they were abandoned. ### Explore model / prompt changes Fork the same turn with a different prompt or model selection. The parent context is identical, so the comparison is actually controlled. ## Security and boundaries - **Loopback only** — `/gitchat` rejects non-loopback requests with 403. - **No shell, no user paths** — the only file write goes to a fixed plugin-data directory with a sanitized filename. - **No HTML injection** — message text is rendered as React text, never `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. - **No model-facing surface** — GitChat registers no tools and writes no system prompt. It reads logs, calls `sessions.fork`, and archives sessions. - **64 KiB JSON body cap**; JSON only. - **Subagent sessions are excluded**; the root session cannot be archived. - **Archive is non-destructive**; DSH has no public delete-session API. ## Limits - No true session deletion; archive only. Logs remain on disk and in DSH’s archive list. - JSON is a **read-model snapshot**, not a raw event-log backup. Messages are capped at 20,000 characters; tool calls are stored as counts. - Large trees are capped at 80 sessions / 800 turns, with a `truncated` flag. - Live refresh is polling (7 s while a turn is running), not server push. - Loopback only; remote Web/paired access is rejected. - DSH’s session/slot APIs are evolving; upgrading DSH may require updates to `src/host/dsh.ts` and `src/client/adapter.ts`. - Corrupt or migration-required logs surface as unreadable placeholders rather than disappearing silently. ## Development ```bash pnpm typecheck # tsc --noEmit pnpm test # in-process Node test runner pnpm build # host + browser bundles pnpm preview # standalone preview bundle ``` Tests cover event parsing, single/nested forks, empty and archived branches, every `/gitchat` route, loopback rejection, the client module wrapper, `apply`, and slot registration. A small utility can inspect a real DSH v4 log: ```bash node scripts/inspect-session.mjs ``` ## Repository layout ```text src/host/ Cordis host plugin, /gitchat routes, tree & lineage derivation src/client/ React Flow view, DSH adapter, API, Dagre layout, tooltips, i18n, CSS src/shared/ host ↔ browser wire types preview/ standalone preview with an in-memory controller test/ unit and integration tests scripts/ build / preview / test / inspect-session docs/ screenshots, demo GIF, publishing guide cordis.patch.yml profile bundle patch inserting ui-gitchat ``` ## Roadmap - [x] Native DSH view, forks, archive/restore, JSON - [x] Theme-native light/dark/dynamic-range buttons - [x] Hover/focus tooltips for every action - [x] Standalone preview and demo GIF - [ ] Branch comparison view (side-by-side transcripts) - [ ] Search across branches - [ ] Optional true-delete with explicit confirmation and backup - [ ] More model-provider presets ## Contributing Issues and PRs are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, test, and review guidelines. For release steps, see [docs/PUBLISHING.md](docs/PUBLISHING.md). ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Bundled third-party notices: [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). ## Acknowledgements - [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) for the plugin, session, slot, and theme architecture. - [React Flow](https://reactflow.dev) for the graph surface. - [Dagre](https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre) for layered tree layout. - Every long debugging session that deserved a better branch.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-local-markdown-notes

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH) plugin that puts a folder of Markdown
files into a sidebar panel inside the Web UI: browse the tree, read, edit with auto-save, search
the whole folder — and keep the Git context of every file in view (status, diff against `HEAD`,
per-line blame) without ever touching the repository.

The panel is local-first: files stay where they are on disk, nothing is copied, synced or uploaded.

## Features

- **Folder panel** — import any number of local folders (a Git repo or a plain directory); a
  recursive tree lists every Markdown file, one click opens it next to the conversation.
- **Edit with auto-save** — the editor saves while you type, and keystrokes typed while a save is
  already in flight are not dropped (they are re-sent after the write settles).
- **Markdown rendering** — headings, tables, lists, task lists, links, images, footnotes, callouts
  (`> [!NOTE]`), strikethrough and fenced code blocks with syntax highlighting (shell,
  PowerShell, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C/C++, SQL, JSON, YAML and more).
- **Outline beside the preview** — every heading is listed down the right edge and jumps to its
  section on click; a `[TOC]` line renders the same list inline.
- **Maths and diagrams, offline** — `$…$` and `$$…$$` are typeset with a bundled KaTeX, and
  ` ```mermaid ` fences are drawn with a bundled Mermaid. Both ship inside the plugin as lazy
  chunks, so the preview works with no network at all.
- **Read-only Git context** — a file's status against `HEAD`, a diff with per-line change bars,
  and line blame for the current file. The plugin only runs `git status`, `git diff` and
  `git blame`; it never commits, stages, checks out or rewrites history.
- **Search across folders** — full-text search over every imported folder, with the hit list
  jumping straight to the matching line.
- **Agent tools** — the same content is available to the model through six tools:
  `notes_projects`, `notes_list`, `notes_read`, `notes_write`, `notes_append`, `notes_search`.

## Install

```bash
# from GitHub (recommended while the package is not on npm)
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:sisyphus1212/dsh-local-markdown-notes
```

Then restart the app and its host (**Help → Restart App and Host**). A page reload is not enough:
plugin bundles are rebuilt only when the application and the host process restart together.

Manual install: copy this directory into
`~/.dsh/profiles/<your-profile>/node_modules/@local/local-markdown-notes` and make sure
`dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json` lists `@local/local-markdown-notes`.

## Usage

1. Open the **Local Markdown Notes** panel from the sidebar.
2. Add a folder — any directory with Markdown files; if it is a Git repository the Git features
   light up automatically, otherwise the editor and search still work.
3. Pick a file, edit it, and use the search box to find text across every imported folder.

## Requirements

- DSH with Cordis 4.x (`@deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.1`).
- `git` on `PATH` for the status/diff/blame features (optional — the panel works without it).

## How it is built

- Host half — `index.js` and `lib/*.js`: registers the six tools and a storage domain through the
  host's existing `dsh-storage-domain` service. It deliberately does **not** mount its own storage
  stack (mounting a second `domain` storage throws `storage form 'domain' is already mounted` and
  takes the whole app down).
- Browser half — `client.js`: prebuilt and committed, declared through `dsh.client` in
  `package.json`. The two heavy engines ride along as package-local lazy chunks
  (`client.katex.js`, `client.mermaid.js`): they register through the host's module loader and are
  fetched only when a note actually contains a formula or a diagram.
- `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`, which inserts exactly one row
  (this plugin) and nothing else.

## 中文简介

把本机的 Markdown 文件夹做成 DSH 侧边栏里的笔记面板：树形浏览、就地编辑（自动保存）、全文检索，
并在不改动仓库的前提下显示 Git 状态、与 `HEAD` 的差异（逐行变更标记）和逐行 blame。
预览支持脚注、Callout、任务列表、图片、删除线、表格对齐；右侧列出全文目录（点条目跳转），
文档里写 `[TOC]` 会在原位生成同样的目录；公式用内置 KaTeX 排版、```mermaid 图用内置 Mermaid 绘制，
两者作为懒加载 chunk 随插件离线可用。
插件同时向模型提供 `notes_*` 六个工具，因此对话里也能直接读写这些笔记。

安装：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:sisyphus1212/dsh-local-markdown-notes`，
然后「帮助 → 重启应用与 Host」。

# dsh-rea English | [简体中文](README.zh.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/sqhc/dsh-rea/releases) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) > **Unofficial.** This repository is an independent DeepSeek Harness bundle. It is > not affiliated with, endorsed by, or published by the REA project. It contains > no REA source code: at runtime it installs the official > [`rea-agents`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/rea-agents) package from npm and > connects its MCP server to the Harness. See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md). A configuration-only [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) bundle that connects the REA reverse-engineering MCP server. Once installed, the agent can call REA tools as `mcp__rea__` — inspect native binaries, app bundles, JavaScript/Electron applications, managed assemblies, websites, packet captures, firmware images, and runtime behavior. ## Origin and provenance - **Upstream project:** [REA — Reverse Engineer Anything](https://github.com/morluto/rea) by **morluto**, MIT-licensed. The npm package is [`rea-agents`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/rea-agents); documentation lives at [rea.tools](https://rea.tools/). - **This repository:** , maintained by [sqhc](https://github.com/sqhc). It is a packaging layer, not a fork. - **Relationship:** unofficial integration. It turns the `rea-mcp` registration that REA's own `rea setup --client dsh` writes into an installable DSH bundle with locale metadata and an icon. No REA source code, binaries, or artwork are copied; the official package is fetched from npm at runtime. - **Packaging contract:** DeepSeek Harness's `dsh.bundle.patch` format and the harness-shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`. ## What this bundle actually does The bundle inserts one row into the Harness plugin composition: ```yaml - insert: - id: rea-mcp name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' config: serverName: rea transport: stdio command: npx args: ['-y', 'rea-agents@6.7.0', 'mcp'] ``` `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` is shipped with DSH. REA is not vendored, forked, or rebuilt here — the official npm package runs as a local stdio MCP server. ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness with the shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (verified with `0.2.1-rc.2`). - Node.js and npm on the Harness process `PATH`. REA officially supports Node.js 22.x (>=22.19), 24.x (>=24.11), or 26+. Node.js 20 can start the server but is outside REA's supported range. - Network access on the first launch so `npx` can fetch `rea-agents@6.7.0`. - macOS is what this bundle was verified on. Linux should work the same way. Windows is untested; native REA providers also have their own prerequisites. ## Version compatibility | REA version | Bundle version | DSH version (verified) | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | `rea-agents@6.8.0` | `0.2.0` | `0.2.1-rc.2` | **Current**; 229 tools, Node 22.23+/24.22+/26+ (excl. 23/25) | | `rea-agents@6.7.0` | `0.1.0` | `0.2.1-rc.2` | Baseline; 207 tools, compact input schema, output schema off | | `rea-agents@6.x.x` | `0.1.x` / `0.2.x` | `0.2.x` | Patch versions only; pin exact REA version in `cordis.patch.yml` | *Always read REA release notes before upgrading. Tool names and schemas are part of the model-facing contract.* ## Release Notes ### v0.2.0 (2026-10-27) — REA 6.8.0 **Changes** - Upstream REA updated from 6.7.0 → 6.8.0 - Tool count: 207 → **229** (+22 new tools: Agent Environments, GPU/BEAM/Python/Unity/Godot/Node.js SEA/devicetree, PE/ELF deep inspection, Retained Summaries) - Catalog size: 214 KiB → **295 KiB** (+38%) - Max schema (`inspect_analysis_view`): 7.4 KB → **15.2 KB** (2×) - Node.js engine requirement tightened: **22.23.4+ / 24.22.1+ / 26.12.1+** (Node 23/25 explicitly unsupported) - Bundle size: 28 MB → 49 MB (first `npx` download slower) **Migration** 1. Update `cordis.patch.yml`: `rea-agents@6.8.0` 2. Ensure Node.js ≥ 24.22.1 (or 22.23.4 / 26.12.1) on the Harness PATH 3. Reinstall/reload bundle and run `node scripts/preflight.mjs` **Known risks** - Windows: untested (known limitation) - Node 24.21.x will fail preflight — upgrade Node or pin to 22.23.4+ - Catalog token cost ~76k tokens (compact input); disable bundle when not reverse-engineering ## Install Clone this repository, then ask the Harness agent to install the bundle directory with `plugin_manager` (`action: install_bundle`). The agent needs the absolute path to the checkout. Installing changes the current DSH profile and survives restarts. Before installing, you can run the preflight script: ```bash node scripts/preflight.mjs ``` It checks the Node version and npm cache, performs an MCP initialize + `tools/list` handshake against `rea-agents@6.7.0`, and reports the tool count and catalog size. It also warms the npx cache, which makes the first Harness launch much faster. ## First launch The first launch may take a while because `npx` downloads REA. The bundle starts with `failOnStartupError: false` and automatic reconnect, so a slow first download does not disable the row; calls fail until the server is ready. Check the Harness log if no REA tools appear after a few minutes. ## Verify Ask the agent to call `mcp__rea__binary_session` with no arguments. It reports the current target/provider/server identity without starting analysis. A healthy result identifies the REA server version (`6.7.0`). ## Tool catalog and context cost REA advertises 207 tools. Rendering the complete catalog would cost several megabytes, so this bundle always sets: - `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=compact` — bounded input schemas; REA still validates calls against the full canonical contract. - `REA_MCP_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=off` — output schemas are omitted from discovery; REA still validates structured results server-side. Measured at REA 6.7.0: about **215–230 KiB of tool JSON (~55–57k tokens)**. With deepseek-flash's 1M-token context this is acceptable, but it is a real fixed cost on every request while the plugin is enabled. Disable the bundle when you are not doing reverse engineering. If you prefer the full advertisement and your model route accepts it, change `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE` to `full`. Do not combine `full` input with output schemas unless you have measured the cost: the complete catalog is ~3.4 MB. ## Configuration Edit `cordis.patch.yml` in the checkout and reinstall/reload the bundle. | Key | Value | Why | |---|---|---| | `serverName` | `rea` | Tool prefix `mcp__rea__` | | `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Native analysis and provider startup can exceed the 60 s default | | `failOnStartupError` | `false` | A slow first npx download should reconnect, not fail the row | | `NPM_CONFIG_CACHE` | `!!js` → `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-rea/npm` | Avoid `EPERM` from a root-owned `~/.npm`; override with `DSH_REA_NPM_CACHE` | | `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE` | `compact` | Keep the advertised catalog bounded | | `REA_MCP_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE` | `off` | Remove multi-megabyte output schemas | ## Troubleshooting ### `npm error code EPERM` / root-owned npm cache The `NPM_CONFIG_CACHE` expression in the patch points npx at `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-rea/npm` (or `/cache/dsh-rea/npm` when the profile directory is available), falling back to `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-rea/npm`. In the verified Desktop profile it resolved to `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-rea/npm`. If you need a different directory, set `DSH_REA_NPM_CACHE` in the environment of the Harness process (requires a Harness restart), or replace the `!!js` expression with a literal path. We do not recommend `sudo chown -R` on your whole npm cache just for this plugin. ### No `mcp__rea__*` tools - Run `node scripts/preflight.mjs`; it isolates Node/npm/REA problems from DSH. - Check that `npx` resolves to a Node version REA supports. - Check that the `rea-mcp` row is active and not `disabled`. - If the row failed to load, reload the bundle or restart the Harness. ### Duplicate REA registration Do **not** also run `rea setup --client dsh` for this profile. Both registrations would use `serverName: rea`; the MCP client rejects the duplicate and one tool set disappears. Pick one integration and remove the other. ### Use a specific Node installation The patch runs `npx` from `PATH`. To pin a Node 24 installation instead, replace the command with that Node binary and point `args` at the installed REA launcher (`/rea-agents/scripts/rea.mjs`, then `mcp`). Restart the Harness after editing. ### Optional: REA workflow skill REA also publishes an agent skill. Its own setup can install it into `~/.agents/skills`, which DSH discovers: ```bash npx -y rea-agents@6.7.0 setup --skill --dry-run npx -y rea-agents@6.7.0 setup --skill --yes ``` This is independent of the MCP connection provided by this bundle. ## Upgrade REA 1. Read the REA release notes for MCP tool changes. 2. Change the pinned version in `cordis.patch.yml` (for example `rea-agents@6.7.1`). 3. Reinstall/reload the bundle and re-run `node scripts/preflight.mjs`. Tool names and schemas are part of the model-facing contract; changing them invalidates prompt caches and may break saved sessions that reference old tool names. ## Uninstall Ask the Harness agent to remove the `dsh-rea` bundle with `plugin_manager` (`action: remove_bundle`), or disable it with `set_bundle` when you only want to pause it. Uninstalling the bundle does not remove npm's npx cache or the optional `~/.agents/skills` copy; remove those separately if you want them gone. ## Limitations - MCP prompt templates are not supported by `dsh-mcp-client`; REA's six guided prompts are not exposed through this bundle. Tools work normally. - `dsh-mcp-client` exposes tools only after discovery; a crashed npx child keeps the last tool set listed until reconnect exhausts its budget. - REA native providers (Hopper, Ghidra, IDA, JADX, Frida, …) require their own installations. The bundle does not install or license them. - Windows behavior is untested here. ## Security and legal REA analyzes local artifacts and can launch external helper programs. Only use it on software you are authorized to inspect, and review REA's own [DISCLAIMER](https://github.com/morluto/rea/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md) and [SECURITY](https://github.com/morluto/rea/blob/main/SECURITY.md) policies. This bundle adds no telemetry and stores no credentials. REA is MIT-licensed by its authors. This repository's configuration, docs, and artwork are MIT-licensed as well; see [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Workspace code editor

A DSH Web profile bundle that adds a **Code editor** card to the right-sidebar
guide. The card opens a workspace file browser with a small text editor for
UTF-8 files.

## What it does

- Browses the current Session's workspace directories through the existing
  `workspaceFiles` Remote namespace.
- Opens and edits UTF-8 text files up to 1 MiB / 20,000 lines.
- Saves through one authenticated Host endpoint, using the file version read
  from disk for optimistic conflict detection.
- Respects the Session file policy: a `read-only` Session can browse and edit
  its local buffer but cannot save.
- Keeps unsaved drafts in memory while the plugin stays loaded, keyed by
  Session and path. Drafts survive tab switches and closing/reopening the
  editor tab; a page reload loses them. A restored draft is saved against the
  version it was based on, so newer disk content produces a conflict instead of
  being overwritten.

The editor has no syntax highlighting, language server, diff view, git
integration, file creation, rename, or delete. It is a user surface only: it
registers no agent tool, prompt section, or session event.

## Install

Requires a DSH Web profile with the built-in right Sidebar. From the pinned
release:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:sredevopsorg/dsh-plugins#code-editor-v0.1.0&path:/plugins/code-editor"
```

Or from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/code-editor
```

If an earlier draft was linked as `@local/dsh-code-editor`, remove it first so
both editor tabs do not register:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @local/dsh-code-editor
```

Restart DSH after installing or removing the bundle.

## Use

1. Install the bundle (see above) and restart DSH if needed.
2. Refresh the Web GUI if the guide card is not visible yet.
3. In the right sidebar, open the guide and pick **Code editor**.
4. Pick a directory row to enter it, or a file row to open it.
5. Edit and press **Ctrl/Cmd+S** or the Save button.

## Host write endpoint

`POST /__dsh-code-editor/write`

```json
{
  "sessionId": "session-123",
  "path": "src/app.ts",
  "content": "full file text",
  "expectedVersion": "opaque version from readBytes",
  "force": false
}
```

The endpoint:

1. applies Connection browser authentication and Host/Origin trust, and accepts
   only the shared browser Peer (API Peers are refused);
2. requires a live Session and a body no larger than 8 MiB;
3. resolves the Session workspace root and refuses any target outside it;
4. refuses a missing path, a non-regular file, or a final symlink;
5. refuses writes when `ctx.sandboxPolicy.resolve({ session })` is `read-only`;
6. writes with `fs.writeText` and `{ kind: 'replaceIfVersion' }`, unless
   `force` is true.

Success returns `{ "ok": true, "operation": "create"|"update", "version": "…" }`.
Conflicts return HTTP 409 with a `stale` code and the current version when it can
be re-read. Other failures use `{ "ok": false, "code": "…", "message": "…" }`.

## Development

```sh
npm test        # host route and packaging tests
npm run check   # node --check on both entry points
```

The package is authored in this directory and installed with
`dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/code-editor`; the profile patch is never
edited by hand.

# DSH Plugins

Custom **skills and plugins** for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/sredevopsorg), maintained by [sredevopsorg](https://github.com/sredevopsorg).

The repository publishes two things:

- **Skills** — `SKILL.md` instruction bundles packaged by the **skills plugin** under [`plugins/skills/skills/`](plugins/skills/skills/). Install that one plugin and every skill is registered; [`install.sh`](install.sh) remains a legacy/manual symlink alternative.
- **DSH plugins** — self-contained bundles under [`plugins/`](plugins/), installed from this repository's release tags **or** browsed from the repository's [plugin market index](#the-plugin-index-discover).

| Kind | What it is | Where it lives here |
|---|---|---|
| **Skill** | A `SKILL.md` (or flat `<name>.md`) instruction bundle loaded on demand by the model or with `/name`. Skills are packaged and served by a DSH skill-provider plugin. | [`plugins/skills/skills/`](plugins/skills/skills/) |
| **Plugin** | A Cordis plugin package loaded into a DSH profile (`dsh plugin …`). | [`plugins/`](plugins/) |
| **Tool** | A model-facing tool registered by a plugin via `ctx.tools`, shipped inside a plugin package. | [`plugins/entire/`](plugins/entire/) |

The repository also publishes [`index.json`](index.json), a **format-1 plugin market index** that [@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-plugin-market-bundle](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) reads in the Web **Plugins → Discover** tab.

> Verified against `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.2.x**, currently **`0.2.2-rc.1`**. The CLI version gate is strict, so check `dsh --version` before reporting plugin issues. Bundle patches are checked against the installed DSH by `scripts/validate-bundles.mjs`.

---

## Contents

### Skills

All nine skills ship in the single [`skills`](plugins/skills/README.md) plugin. Install it
(see [Installing the skills](#installing-the-skills)) and the catalog lists every row below.

| Skill | Surface | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| [`software-architecture`](plugins/skills/skills/software-architecture/SKILL.md) | model + user | Choosing the simplest sufficient design, patterns to apply or skip, engineering practices, tool/skill selection |
| [`fullstack-development`](plugins/skills/skills/fullstack-development/SKILL.md) | model + user | Container-based Python and Node.js/TypeScript backends, frontends, monorepos, Docker, e2e testing |
| [`supabase`](plugins/skills/skills/supabase/SKILL.md) | model + user | Anything touching Supabase: DB, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, CLI, MCP, logs, debugging |
| [`supabase-postgres-best-practices`](plugins/skills/skills/supabase-postgres-best-practices/SKILL.md) | model + user | Postgres schema, migrations, RLS, indexes, locking, query plans — load *before* touching a database |
| [`ghost-theme-development`](plugins/skills/skills/ghost-theme-development/SKILL.md) | model + user | Authoring Ghost Handlebars themes: templates, contexts, helpers, settings, routing, GScan |
| [`ghost-theme-modern-frontend`](plugins/skills/skills/ghost-theme-modern-frontend/SKILL.md) | model + user | Wiring a Ghost theme to Vite, Tailwind CSS, and React/Vue/Svelte islands |
| [`helm-chart-development`](plugins/skills/skills/helm-chart-development/SKILL.md) | model + user | Creating, editing and improving Helm charts: templates, values.yaml, helpers, hooks, CRDs, subcharts |
| [`kubernetes-kubectl-operations`](plugins/skills/skills/kubernetes-kubectl-operations/SKILL.md) | model + user | Safe kubectl operations, cluster triage, and opt-in Kubernetes MCP inspection |
| [`github-actions-security-audit`](plugins/skills/skills/github-actions-security-audit/SKILL.md) | model + user | Auditing and hardening GitHub Actions workflows: token permissions, script injection, `pull_request_target`, action pinning, runners, supply chain |

### Plugins and tools

| Plugin | Kind | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| [`code-editor`](plugins/code-editor/README.md) | bundle + web editor | Browsing a Session's workspace and editing UTF-8 files from a right-sidebar tab, with sandbox-aware saves and optimistic conflict detection |
| [`entire`](plugins/entire/README.md) | bundle + tool | Reading Entire sessions, checkpoints, search, trails, and code history, plus capturing DSH sessions as Entire checkpoints |
| [`peak-rate-footer`](plugins/peak-rate-footer/README.md) | bundle + web footer | A green/orange footer showing whether DeepSeek API usage is currently billed at peak or off-peak rates, with a local clock, next-change countdown, and in-footer time-zone picker |
| [`skills`](plugins/skills/README.md) | bundle + 9 skills | Installing every skill in this repository as one plugin: a packaged skill provider serving the architecture, fullstack, Supabase/Postgres, Ghost theme, Helm, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions skills |
| [`superagent`](plugins/superagent/README.md) | bundle + web panel | A vendored fork of DeepSeek Harness's `dsh-superagent` research prototype: a proactive agent for one GitHub repository (optionally Feishu) that runs tickets in their own DSH sessions and answers in the original conversation |

---

## Repository layout

That directory is also what `npm pack` ships: a repository skill outside `plugins/skills/skills` is not installable and fails [`scripts/validate-skills.mjs`](scripts/validate-skills.mjs).

---

## Requirements

- **DSH** — `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh …`, or a global `dsh` install (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`). The Discover flow additionally needs the experimental **Custom plugin indexes** bundle (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-plugin-market-bundle`), enabled from the Web Plugins page.
- **Node.js ≥ 18** and **npm/npx** — for the Ghost and Helm toolchain scripts, `npx gscan`, and the optional Kubernetes MCP server (`npx -y kubernetes-mcp-server@latest`).
- **Ghost 6.x + `gscan`** — only for the two Ghost theme skills.
- **Helm 3+** — only for `helm-chart-development`. No cluster or network needed;
  `scripts/verify-chart.mjs` shells out to `helm lint` and `helm template`.
- **`kubectl` + a kubeconfig** — only for `kubernetes-kubectl-operations`. The skill
  inspects and, with explicit confirmation, changes a cluster;
  `scripts/verify-kube-access.sh` is a read-only preflight and accepts
  `--kubeconfig <path>`. Set `KUBERNETES_MCP_KUBECONFIG` to an absolute path for a
  dedicated, preferably read-only kubeconfig; when the optional Kubernetes MCP row is
  enabled, it passes that value to the server as `KUBECONFIG`. Without it, the server
  uses `KUBECONFIG` or `~/.kube/config`.
- **Entire CLI** (`entire`) on `PATH` — only for the `entire` plugin. It records agent sessions and
  checkpoints and backs every tool; session capture additionally needs the `entire-agent-dsh`
  binary and `entire agent add dsh` in the target repository. Search, trails, and recap also need
  an authenticated login and OS keyring access.
- **`git`** and **`pnpm` 9 or newer** — only when installing DSH plugin packages from this
  repository (`dsh plugin …` forwards to pnpm; `path:` subdirectory installs need pnpm 9).
  No npm publish is involved. `superagent` also fetches its two runtime dependencies
  (`zod`, `proper-lockfile`) from the npm registry.
- **A DSH Web profile** — only for the Web plugins: the built-in right Sidebar for
  `code-editor`, whose browser bundle contributes a right-sidebar tab and whose Host half
  serves the browser-only workspace write endpoint, and the built-in bottom frame seat for
  `peak-rate-footer`, whose Client module contributes the rate-status footer.
- **Node.js 22.19+ or 24+, `git`, GitHub CLI 2.48+, `tmux`, and Python 3.8+** — only for the
  [`superagent`](plugins/superagent/README.md) fork, whose managed-service script and
  executor sessions need them. It requires a Web profile (the management panel is a web
  plugin) and its own `stateDir` configuration; `SETUP.md` in the plugin drives the
  deployment. Its optional session capture additionally needs the `entire` plugin in the
  same profile and `entire agent add dsh` in the target repository — see
  [`docs/entire-dsh-audit.md`](docs/entire-dsh-audit.md) for the current root causes.

---

## Installing the skills

Every skill is packaged in one plugin, [`plugins/skills`](plugins/skills/README.md). Its
bundle patch inserts one host-wide row, and that row registers a skill provider on
`ctx.skills` that discovers and serves the packaged `plugins/skills/skills/` directory.
Installing the plugin is the supported path: no filesystem root to configure and no
per-skill symlink to maintain.

### Option A — install the skills plugin (recommended)

From this local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/skills
```

Or from the pinned GitHub release (the tag is immutable, so the contents are reproducible;
quote the `&` or the shell will split it):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:sredevopsorg/dsh-plugins#skills-v0.1.0&path:/plugins/skills"
```

Or add the repository's [plugin index](#the-plugin-index-discover) source once and install
the version from the **Discover** card. `dsh --profile web list` shows the installed
package and `dsh --profile web --dump-config` composes the tree without booting. Restart a
running DSH after installing; the skill catalog is built at startup.

The packaged provider uses the standard bundled rank `600` and `source: bundled`. A
project-local or user filesystem root still wins duplicate-name precedence (ranks 100–500),
so a project can override a packaged skill of the same name.

### Option B — `install.sh` (legacy/manual alternative)

For setups that cannot install a plugin, [`install.sh`](install.sh) links the same packaged
skills from `plugins/skills/skills/` into a DSH filesystem root:

```bash
./install.sh                                   # all skills -> ~/.dsh/skills
./install.sh --project /path/to/your/project   # -> <project>/.dsh/skills (rank 100)
./install.sh ghost-theme-development \         # only a subset
             ghost-theme-modern-frontend
./install.sh --dry-run                         # show what would change
./install.sh --uninstall                       # detach again
```

It links each skill by symlink, skips anything that is not a managed link, and refuses to
overwrite real files. After installing into the user root, restart DSH so the catalog is
rebuilt. A user-root link has rank 400, which beats the packaged provider's rank 600, so
`--uninstall` hands a skill back to the plugin.

### Option C — manual symlinks

```bash
# into a project (rank 100)
PROJECT=/path/to/your/project
mkdir -p "$PROJECT/.dsh/skills"
for d in plugins/skills/skills/*/; do
  [ -f "${d}SKILL.md" ] || continue
  ln -sfn "$PWD/${d%/}" "$PROJECT/.dsh/skills/$(basename "$d")"
done

# or into the user root (rank 400), available from every project
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills
for d in "$PWD"/plugins/skills/skills/*/; do
  [ -f "${d}SKILL.md" ] || continue
  ln -sfn "${d%/}" ~/.dsh/skills/
done
```

### Option D — configure `customSkillDirs`

Point the filesystem provider at the packaged skills directory in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
  config:
    customSkillDirs:
      - /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugins/plugins/skills/skills
```

The provider watches roots, so new, renamed, or deleted skills appear without restarting
DSH. **Restart DSH** after changing `customSkillDirs` itself, since that is plugin
configuration.

### Using a skill

- **Model-invoked** — skills with `modelInvocable` appear in the session catalog; the agent calls the `skill` tool with the exact kebab-case name before acting.
- **User-invoked** — type `/` in the composer and pick a skill, or type `/software-architecture` directly.

`install.sh` deliberately skips `docs/ghost-themes.md` and any `_`- or `.`-prefixed entry, so repository documentation is never registered as a skill.

---

## Installing plugins

Every plugin under [`plugins/`](plugins/) ships as a self-contained DSH bundle (two are
no-toolchain plain ESM; the forked `superagent` commits its build output). Two install paths
resolve to the same package:

### From Discover (plugin index)

Add the repository's index once; **Discover** then lists every published plugin version and
installs it after confirmation:

1. Open **Plugins** in the Web sidebar and switch on **Custom plugin indexes** under
   **Experimental plugins**.
2. Select **Discover → Add index source** and enter:

   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sredevopsorg/dsh-plugins/main/index.json
   ```

3. Pick a plugin and version and confirm the install. Each entry pins its exact Git commit.

The index and its maintenance are documented in [`docs/plugin-index.md`](docs/plugin-index.md).

### From a pinned GitHub release tag

The same package installs with pnpm's Git subdirectory parameter, pinned to an immutable
release tag:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:sredevopsorg/dsh-plugins#entire-v0.2.0&path:/plugins/entire"
```

Quote the spec: the shell must not interpret `&`. Replace `web` with your profile.
`dsh --profile web list` shows the installed package, and
`dsh --profile web --dump-config` composes the tree without booting.

Requirements, full-URL and commit-pinned variants, update/uninstall commands,
and troubleshooting are in
[`docs/installing-plugins-from-github.md`](docs/installing-plugins-from-github.md).
For local development, install a checkout instead:
`dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/entire`.

---

## Quick start — Ghost theme toolchain

`scaffold-theme.mjs` generates a GScan-clean theme wired for Vite, optional Tailwind, and optional React islands. It needs only plain Node ≥ 18.

```bash
# Scaffold a Vite + Tailwind + React-islands theme
node plugins/skills/skills/ghost-theme-modern-frontend/scripts/scaffold-theme.mjs \
  --name my-theme --out ./themes --react

cd themes/my-theme
npm install
npm run build
npm test          # build + GScan

# Fuller pre-flight: build → GScan → zip → archive assertions
bash "$OLDPWD/plugins/skills/skills/ghost-theme-modern-frontend/scripts/verify-theme.sh" .
```

```bash
node plugins/skills/skills/ghost-theme-modern-frontend/scripts/scaffold-theme.mjs --help
```

Flags: `--name`, `--out`, `--react`, `--no-tailwind`, `--force`.

---

## Authoring a skill

Create `plugins/skills/skills/<kebab-case-name>/SKILL.md` (directory bundle) or `plugins/skills/skills/<kebab-case-name>.md` (flat file). A directory bundle may include any supporting files; nested `**/SKILL.md` files are **not** discovered.

Skills **must** live inside the packaged plugin. `scripts/validate-skills.mjs` fails when a
`SKILL.md` exists anywhere outside `plugins/skills/skills` (including a resurrected
top-level `skills/`), when the package manifest does not ship the skills directory, when
`npm pack --dry-run` would omit a packaged skill file, or when two skills share a name.
That is what keeps "every new or edited skill" inside the single installable plugin.

Frontmatter:

```yaml
---
name: my-skill                     # required — must match the kebab-case directory/file name
description: >-                    # required — shown in the catalog, capped (~500 chars)
  One paragraph on what the skill does and when it should trigger.
whenToUse: >-                      # optional — extra routing guidance
  Use when …
metadata:                          # optional, free-form
  author: sredevopsorg
  version: "1.0.0"
disable-model-invocation: false    # optional — keep out of model-facing catalogs
user-invocable: true               # optional — keep out of `/` commands
---
# Skill title

Instructions…
```

Rules the skill provider enforces (identical to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` and the packaged provider in `plugins/skills/index.js`):

- `name` and `description` are mandatory; a skill missing either is dropped.
- `*invocable` keys accept YAML booleans and `true/false`, `yes/no`, `on/off`, `1/0`. A rejected spelling drops the **whole skill** with a warning.
- Prefer `disable-model-invocation: true` for human-only workflows and `user-invocable: false` for model-only ones.
- Keep `description` trigger-focused — it is the only thing the model sees before loading the body.

Conventions used in this repo:

- One skill per concern; put long material in `references/` and load it from `SKILL.md`.
- Frontmatter first line, fenced by `---`; no BOM, no leading blank line.
- The `name` must match its directory (or flat-file) name exactly — `scripts/validate-skills.mjs` enforces this.
- Skills live only in `plugins/skills/skills/`; the packaged provider serves them, so there is nothing to copy or symlink.
- Scripts live in `scripts/`, are dependency-light, and document `--help`.
- Cite upstream sources in the body when guidance is derived from official docs.

After adding or editing a skill, run `node scripts/validate-skills.mjs` and
`cd plugins/skills && npm test` before committing; see [Verifying](#verifying).

---

## Plugins and tools

A DSH plugin is an npm package that Cordis loads; a **bundle** additionally declares its patch layer:

```json
{
  "name": "@sredevopsorg/dsh-<name>",
  "type": "module",
  "exports": { ".": "./index.js" },
  "engines": { "dsh": "^0.2.1-rc.2" },
  "dsh": {
    "manifestVersion": 1,
    "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" }
  }
}
```

`engines.dsh` is the compatibility gate the installer, the market index, and the launcher enforce; omit it and an unsupported DSH version installs silently and fails later at activation. A bundle that only adds configuration needs no `index.js` or `.` export — declare the patch, plus `./package.json`, `./locale/*.json`, and `./icon.svg` for management and market display.

Install and select it into a profile — from Discover, from GitHub with a pinned release tag, or from a local checkout while developing:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:sredevopsorg/dsh-plugins#code-editor-v0.1.0&path:/plugins/code-editor"
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:sredevopsorg/dsh-plugins#entire-v0.2.0&path:/plugins/entire"
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:sredevopsorg/dsh-plugins#peak-rate-footer-v0.1.0&path:/plugins/peak-rate-footer"
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:sredevopsorg/dsh-plugins#skills-v0.1.0&path:/plugins/skills"
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:sredevopsorg/dsh-plugins#superagent-v0.1.2&path:/plugins/superagent"
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/code-editor # local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/entire   # local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add ./plugins/peak-rate-footer # local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web list
dsh --profile web --dump-config                 # inspect the composed tree, no boot
```

`dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm. See
[Installing plugins from GitHub](docs/installing-plugins-from-github.md) for the
tag scheme, pinning, and troubleshooting, and [Publishing the plugin index](docs/plugin-index.md)
for how a released version reaches Discover.

Conventions this repository follows:

```
plugins/<name>/
├── package.json          # name, license, engines.dsh, exports, dsh.bundle.patch
├── cordis.patch.yml      # plugin rows / config
├── index.js              # plugin entry: export apply() / inject / (optional) Config
├── <support>.js          # plain-ESM support modules, imported relatively
├── locale/en.json        # display title + description for management and market surfaces
├── icon.svg              # optional, referenced by package.json "icon"
├── test/                 # unit tests where the plugin has logic to test
└── README.md             # configuration table + observable behavior
```

[`entire`](plugins/entire/README.md) and [`skills`](plugins/skills/README.md) ship plain ESM
with **no dependencies and no build step**. That is deliberate: a workspace-linked plugin
cannot resolve bare `@deepseek-ai/*` specifiers unless its manifest declares them as
`peerDependencies`, so a dependency-free package keeps `dsh plugin add` free of both a
toolchain and install-script approval.

[`superagent`](plugins/superagent/README.md) is the deliberate exception: it is a vendored
fork of an upstream TypeScript project, so it keeps that project's `tsdown` build and
`vitest` suites for development. Its **built `lib/` is committed**, which keeps the Git
install toolchain-free (no build or lifecycle script runs when pnpm fetches it); CI
rebuilds it and fails when the committed output drifts from the source. Its importable
surfaces resolve inside its own package, and its bundle rows name the package itself, so
the plugin loads from a profile like any other bundle.

The [`skills`](plugins/skills/README.md) bundle is the packaging pattern for skills: its
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts one host-wide row, `index.js` registers a provider via
`ctx.skills.registerProvider`, and the Markdown skill bundles ship inside the npm package
unchanged. The provider uses the literal bundled rank `600` (`BUNDLED_SKILL_RANK`) instead
of importing `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`, precisely so the package stays dependency-free; see
the plugin README for the trade-off.

Model-facing tools are registered from a plugin via `ctx.tools`; they should declare a JSON-schema input, fail with actionable messages, and never leak stack traces.

---
